title: Villain's Academy ☠️ (v5.6): New School
description:
⚡️Villain's Academy 💀
📢 Update v5.6: New New(er) School Notes - 10/08/26
The Grenith Update. Edited plot essentials and AI instructions for more consistency, thanks to feedback from the GOAT Grenith. 

⚡️▰▰▰💀

📖 Description
You've just enrolled at a super academy where drama and superpowers collide.

Play in the world of Vista Valley's six superpowered pressure cookers! Survive brutal classes and navigate vicious social ranks. One slip in training or on the social ladder could tank your hero future! Balance superpower class, cutthroat competition, and popularity. Find out who the real you is behind the mask in this melodramatic, superpowered, school slice of life scenario.

⚡️▰▰▰💀

🏫 The Schools:
🦹 Apex Institute for Villainous Arts — 27 students, 11 faculty. Masterminds, monsters, criminal cliques, secret romances, grand heists, and an anime cat-girl spy.

🦸 Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts — 27 students, 11 faculty. Celebrity legacy kids, hero rankings, mean girls, bullies, messy breakups, and impossible expectations.

🎒 Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts — 26 students, 6 faculty. Sidekicks, medics, investigators, field operatives, and support crews fighting to prove they're more than second billing.

🤖 Primal Protectors Polytechnic — 20 cadets, 6 faculty. Five color paths, giant Primalzords, a mysterious Nexus, and alien monsters attacking like it's Saturday morning television.

🥷 Bastion Tactical Academy — 25 cadets, 7 faculty. No powers. Military discipline, 4 a.m. reveille, tactical training, and a billionaire vigilante funding the whole operation.

🧬 Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary — 20 students, 6 faculty. Young mutants learning to control dangerous powers while heroes, villains, and extremists fight over their futures.
⚡️▰▰▰💀

🎮 Features:
🎭 Low/high context options
⚡️ Hero/villain options
📚 Highschool/university options
👥 145 students across 6 schools for an extensive cast to interact with!
👨‍🏫 47 faculty
🦸‍♂️ 8 pro heroes and 7 supervillains
🎉 36 school events, including PowerBall seasons, dances, showcases, plays, career days, and major school traditions
💬 PowWow social media, rumors, scandals, and cross-school drama
💕 Interconnected friendships, crushes, romances, rivalries, breakups, and secrets
🌆 An immersive town, with districts, locations, and student interactions
☺️ It'd make me happy if you played!
⚡️▰▰▰💀

✍️ From the Author
One of my guilty pleasures is overly dramatic teen drama trash shows like Glee or Pretty Little Liars. I wanted to make Sky High, but focused on that extra drama like bullies, popular girls, and messy rumors.

It's been over 2 years, and almost 30 million actions. Thanks everyone for the love!

⚡️▰▰▰💀

📝Changelog
10/31/24 - Reorganized some PE stuff. Also Villain's Academy is a hidden gem now!
11/7/24 - Added 17 new villain students.
11/9/24 - Added 50+ cards, including more hero students, faculty, locations, and staff
12/13/24 - Added 20+ cards, including pro heroes, supervillains, and townies
4/28/25 - Story cards reformatted
6/20/25 - Added Autocards
10/30/25 - We're now a Timeless Classic!🎉
2/16/26 - Updated to LewdLeah's Inner-Self
9/19/26 - Added 4 new schools: Auxiliary Arts, Primal Protectors, Bastion, and Meridian. Added Suzu to Apex and the Nightwarden to the pro heroes. Rewrote every card shorter, linked them together, cut the club and exam cards, fixed typos and false triggers. Removed Scripts, Rewrote and reformatted starts.
9/26/26 - Reworked 239 existing cards with more characterization, defined appearances, relationships, rivalries, secrets, and cross-school ties. Added 52 new cards: 36 school events, 13 recurring antagonists. Standardized schools, and renamed and refined characters for better continuity. 
10/08/26 - Edited plot essentials and AI instructions for more consistency, thanks to feedback from the GOAT Grenith. Low context versions have been written tighter.

options.title: 📉Low Context — Selected school/students only
options.prompt:
(📉Low Context)
Every legend in Vista Valley started by choosing a school. Where do you enroll?

🐉 Apex Institute for Villainous Arts — The villains' academy. Why settle? There's no ceiling here, no rules, no one you answer to. The world is unguarded and yours for the taking.

🦅 Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts — The heroes' academy. A crowd chanting your name, a city that sleeps because you don't. Glory, honor, and the duty to be worthy of both.

🤖 Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy — Those Chosen by the Primal Force. Five cadets. Five colors. One team. The alarm sounds, you morph, the Primalzords launch, and with the power of teamwork, no villain or monster is unstoppable

🔮 Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary — The sanctuary for mutants. They called it a curse. They were wrong. Here you're safe, you're wanted, and what drove you out of your old life becomes the best thing about you.

🛡️ Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts — The sidekicks’' academy. Every hero needs someone at their back, and you'll be the best they've ever had: in the fight, on the comms, first through the door when it goes wrong.

🎯 Bastion Tactical Academy — You might not have powers, but that doesn’t mean you’re powerless.

In Vista Valley, many of those futures begin at the Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts. Its halls train the next generation of superheroes, bringing together young people with extraordinary abilities and even greater expectations. The age of superheroes was never built by superheroes alone. Behind every impossible rescue and battle for the fate of the world are people gathering intelligence, treating wounds, managing evacuations, maintaining equipment, and standing beside heroes when plans collapse.

In a world of mutants, monsters, villains, cosmic threats, and living legends, raw power may capture the headlines—but survival often depends on the people who know exactly what to do when power is not enough.

options.title: 📈High Context — All schools and students
options.prompt:
(📈High Context)
Every legend in Vista Valley started by choosing a school. Where do you enroll?

🐉 Apex Institute for Villainous Arts — The villains' academy. Why settle? There's no ceiling here, no rules, no one you answer to. The world is unguarded and yours for the taking.

🦅 Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts — The heroes' academy. A crowd chanting your name, a city that sleeps because you don't. Glory, honor, and the duty to be worthy of both.

🤖 Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy — Those Chosen by the Primal Force. Five cadets. Five colors. One team. The alarm sounds, you morph, the Primalzords launch, and with the power of teamwork, no villain or monster is unstoppable.

🔮 Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary — The sanctuary for mutants. They called it a curse. They were wrong. Here you're safe, you're wanted, and what drove you out of your old life becomes the best thing about you.

🛡️ Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts — The sidekicks’' academy. Every hero needs someone at their back, and you'll be the best they've ever had: in the fight, on the comms, first through the door when it goes wrong.

🎯 Bastion Tactical Academy — You might not have powers, but that doesn’t mean you’re powerless.

cardPool.value: {Ezra "Whizzard" Quark is a sophomore at (P) and has superhuman intelligence. Ezra builds gadgets for popular classmates who forget his name the next day, and every gadget he gives them quietly records. Ezra plays BattleForce with Hiro and Milo and just caught Dexter sabotaging his project.}

cardPool.title: Scotty "Surge Boy" Scotts
cardPool.value: {Scotty "Surge Boy" Scotts is a senior at (P) and has super speed from a lightning strike. He is cocky, competitive, image-conscious, demanding, and fickle, with windswept blonde hair, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Scotty captains the soccer team, plays on the Powerball Team, and checks his hero ranking every morning; he and Farah were the school's golden couple until their breakup trended on PowWow. Scotty is rebounding hard with a new girlfriend, mostly to make Farah jealous, and it is working.}

cardPool.title: Ashton "Fire Boy" Phoenix
cardPool.value: {Ashton "Fire Boy" Phoenix is a junior at (P) and has fire manipulation. He is brooding, cold, vengeful, guarded, and torn, with messy black hair, fair skin, sharp dark eyes, and a broad, athletic build. Ashton trains alone and attends (P) only to find the villains who killed his family; he has been secretly meeting a young assassin in the Underground. Sara has loved Ashton for a year and is close to exposing his secret.}

cardPool.title: Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Siphoness, Lodestar, Deadline, and Sovereign.}

cardPool.title: Pro Heroes
cardPool.value: {Pro heroes who visit Vista Valley are Alpha Force, Titaniumman, Ghost Wing, Commander Vanguard, Cool Guy, Master Nimbus, Flaming Jager, and the Nightwarden.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: Hiro "Darkness Void King" Yamamoto
cardPool.value: {Hiro "Darkness Void King" Yamamoto is a freshman at (P) and has a divine pocket-dimension inventory. He is excitable, naive, dramatic, dense, and loyal, with messy black hair, light skin, violet eyes, and a short, lean build. Hiro is a Japanese transfer student who interprets new experiences through isekai stories; he believes the protagonist is an isekai hero.}

cardPool.title: Alyssa "White Rabbit" Lewis
cardPool.value: {Alyssa "White Rabbit" Lewis is a sophomore at (P) and has magical linked portals to any space she can see. She is cryptic, whimsical, and unsettling, with long blonde hair, fair skin, blue eyes, and a slender build. Alyssa steps through portals into rooms she should not be in and drops other people's secrets as riddles, which has started more fights than PowWow. Alyssa calls the protagonist an avatar controlled by someone else, insists Zax'thor fell out of her childhood storybook, and giggles at Brittany's threats.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Liam, Jade, and Brett.}

cardPool.title: Nina "Crescendana" Nichols
cardPool.value: {Nina "Crescendana" Nichols is a senior at (P) and can grow to giant size after quantum particle exposure. She is theatrical, bossy, dramatic, proud, and fiercely loyal, with rainbow-dyed braids, deep brown skin, and a tall, muscular build. Nina is the marching band's drum major and treats every hallway like her runway. Nina dumped Trayden in front of the whole school after catching him bullying her drummers, and she has claimed Milo as her personal cause, whether he likes it or not.}

cardPool.title: Clayton "Golem Boy" Grant
cardPool.value: {Clayton "Golem Boy" Grant is a junior at (P) and has a rock body, super strength, and near invulnerability. He is kind, humble, and trusting, with no hair, brown rock-textured skin, and a massive, muscular build. Clayton helps anyone who asks, which popular kids exploit constantly; a farm boy, he mutated after eating radioactive steak and sends money home whenever he can. Brett is Clayton's best friend, and Clayton does not know Brett once ran with the Savage Mandible.}

cardPool.title: Dexter "Vector Prime" Destro
cardPool.value: {Dexter "Vector Prime" Destro is a junior at (P) and has superhuman intelligence and limited telekinesis. He is bitter, prideful, spiteful, insecure, and sneaky, with slicked brown hair, pale skin, and a tall, lean build. Dexter hoards credit on group projects and sabotages anyone who outperforms him, because his father only loves a winner. Ezra just caught Dexter sabotaging his project, and Dexter is certain Poppy was the one who told.}

cardPool.title: Veronica "Volt Girl" Vale
cardPool.value: {Veronica "Volt Girl" Vale is a freshman at (P) and has electrokinesis. She is cruel, jealous, and dependent on Brittany’s approval, with long blonde hair, fair skin, and a slender build. Veronica zaps weaker students for laughs and repeats whatever Brittany says a beat too late. Veronica is the third member of Brittany's clique, the Frost Court, hates Tiffany for being Brittany's favorite, and knows Sophia is angling for her spot.}

cardPool.title: Tiffany "Echo Girl" Tuner
cardPool.value: {Tiffany "Echo Girl" Tuner is a freshman at (P) and has a supersonic scream. She is loyal, needy, insecure, lovesick, and spineless, with brown hair, fair skin, a lovely singing voice, and a petite, slender build. Tiffany does Brittany's homework, holds her bag, and writes love songs she will never sing; she has loved Brittany since the day they met. Tiffany helps Brittany plan her future with Arnie while quietly dying inside.}

cardPool.title: Brittany "Snow Princess" Blade
cardPool.value: {Brittany "Snow Princess" Blade is a sophomore at (P) and has ice powers from gene therapy her wealthy parents bought. She is catty, vain, status-obsessed, cruel, and insecure, with long blonde hair, fair skin, blue eyes, and a slim build. Brittany rules the Frost Court, keeps a burn book on every girl at (P), and has planned her wedding to Arnie since she was twelve. Tiffany and Veronica follow Brittany, she never suspects Tiffany loves her, and she would be destroyed to learn Arnie is secretly dating a villain.}

cardPool.title: Arnie "Golden Boy" Armstrong
cardPool.value: {Arnie "Golden Boy" Armstrong is a sophomore at (P) and has super strength and durability. He is charismatic, glory-hungry, insecure, reckless, and two-faced, with golden blonde hair, fair skin, and a broad, athletic build. Arnie soaks up attention everywhere; as the son of Titaniumman, he hears whispers that he coasts on his father's fame. Arnie is secretly dating a villain and lets Brittany believe they will be together because telling her the truth would hurt his image.}

cardPool.title: Sara "Starlight Girl" Samson
cardPool.value: {Sara "Starlight Girl" Samson is a junior at (P) and has cosmic energy manipulation, flight, and energy blasts from a falling star. She is sunny, sanctimonious, image-obsessed, competitive, and lovesick, with long silver hair, fair skin, violet eyes, and a lean, athletic build. Sara tops the student hero popularity poll and guards that smile like a brand. Sara has loved Ashton for a year, has followed him into the Underground, and is one photo away from exposing the young assassin he is secretly seeing.}

cardPool.title: Liam "Timberwolf" Lyons
cardPool.value: {Liam "Timberwolf" Lyons is a freshman at (P) and has a cursed werewolf transformation with enhanced strength, speed, and senses. He is moody, secretive, loyal, volatile, and guarded, with shaggy brown hair, tan skin, sharp teeth, and a lean, athletic build. Liam keeps classmates at arm's length and hides in the Edges every full moon; rumors about the scratches on Trayden's gang are getting too close to the truth. Jade covers for Liam.}

cardPool.title: Johnny "Wildfire" Savage
cardPool.value: {Johnny "Wildfire" Savage is a sophomore at (P) and has hellfire, heat resistance, and enhanced strength from a deal with a devil. He is brooding, dangerous, charming, reckless, and haunted, with jet-black hair, pale skin, amber eyes, and a tall, athletic build. He favors a worn leather jacket. Johnny skips class to ride and fight in the Wreckage; he made his deal to save a girl who never learned what it cost him.}

cardPool.title: Adrianna "Frost Princess" Frost
cardPool.value: {Adrianna "Frost Princess" Frost is a senior at (P) and has cryokinesis. She is brilliant, harsh, imperious, lonely, and perfectionist, with long white hair, pale skin, blue eyes, and a tall, slender build. Her bearing is elegant. Adrianna is a celebrity who carries herself like royalty and freezes out anyone who wastes her time; she has trusted no one since her private diary was leaked online, and she will never forgive whoever leaked it. Brittany worships her.}

cardPool.title: Wes "Breeze Boy" Windham
cardPool.value: {Wes "Breeze Boy" Windham is a senior at (P) and has divine wind and weather control. He is laid-back, flirtatious, careless, charming, and fickle, with wavy bleach-blonde hair, tanned skin, and a broad-shouldered, athletic build. Wes naps through lectures and has dated half the senior class without remembering most of their names.}

cardPool.title: Milo "Mind Boy" Michaels
cardPool.value: {Milo "Mind Boy" Michaels is a freshman at (P) and has weak telepathy with accidental mind control; Paragon accepted him for the courage and initiative he showed despite his limited power. He is shy, hopeful, and increasingly resentful, with long brown hair over his eyes, fair skin, and a lanky build. Milo wanted to be a hero, but the bullies who torment him keep walking into walls when he gets angry, and it feels less accidental every time. Trayden bullies Milo, and Nina has adopted him as a cause.}

cardPool.title: Jade "Psylith" Jacobson
cardPool.value: {Jade "Psylith" Jacobson is a freshman at (P) and has telekinesis. She is somber, principled, protective, prickly, and stubborn, with shoulder-length black hair, pale skin, and a slim build. Jade speaks only when needed and throws bullies across rooms without apology; a scholarship student from the Edges, she left her best friend behind to come to (P). Jade cannot bear watching him drift toward villainy, and she covers for Liam.}

cardPool.title: Poppy "Polymorph" Prescott
cardPool.value: {Poppy "Polymorph" Prescott is a junior at (P) and has shapeshifting. She is bubbly, mischievous, two-faced, funny, and reckless, with short blonde hair, fair skin, and a petite build. Poppy impersonates classmates to start rumors for fun and once shifted into Brittany to humiliate her in public; nobody has figured out it was her. Poppy is the one who told Ezra about Dexter.}

cardPool.title: Zax'thor "Gravity Well"
cardPool.value: {Zax'thor "Gravity Well" is a senior at (P) and has super strength and gravity manipulation. Friendly, awkward, sincere, homesick, and earnest, he is a young alien man with no hair, blue skin, and a towering, broad build. Zax'thor misreads Earth customs and apologizes constantly, and popular kids film him for laughs. Felix follows him everywhere.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Alyssa, Nina, Tiffany, and Poppy.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Veronica, Brittany, Arnie, and Sophia.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Alyssa, Brittany, Wes, and Melodie.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Scotty, Poppy, Felix, and Farah.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Hiro, Jade, Zax'thor, and Sophia.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Clayton, Veronica, Zax'thor, and Felix.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Sara, Adrianna, and Farah.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Ezra and Dexter.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Ashton, Clayton, Arnie, and Wes.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Scotty, Sara, Adrianna, and Melodie.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Trayden, Nina, Tiffany, and Johnny.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Ezra, Hiro, and Milo.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Liam, Milo, and Brett.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Trayden and Johnny.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students. Regulars include Ashton and Dexter.}

cardPool.title: Sophia "Luxe Light" Sierra
cardPool.value: {Sophia "Luxe Light" Sierra is a sophomore at (P) and has solid light constructs. She is manipulative, gossipy, social-climbing, charming, and envious, with long black hair, tan skin, brown eyes, and a slim build. Sophia secretly runs PowWow, the anonymous gossip account every student in Vista Valley reads, and uses it to rise one secret at a time. Sophia is scheming to replace Veronica in the Frost Court and has just learned Arnie is secretly dating a villain.}

cardPool.title: Melodie "Whirl Girl" Morgan
cardPool.value: {Melodie "Whirl Girl" Morgan is a junior at (P) and has hydrokinesis. She is obedient, sanctimonious, eager, tattling, and sneaky, with wavy blue hair, fair skin, wide eyes, and a petite build. Melodie keeps a notebook of every rule broken at (P) and trades pages for favors, which has made her the least trusted girl in her year.}

cardPool.title: Brett "Breaker Boy" Buchanan
cardPool.value: {Brett "Breaker Boy" Buchanan is a sophomore at (P) and has strength that grows with his anger. He is earnest, remorseful, self-conscious, steady, and ashamed, with no hair, gray skin, soft brown eyes, and a towering, heavily muscled build. Brett transferred through a rehabilitation program and keeps his temper leashed while classmates bait him to snap; he once ran with Savage Mandible's crew. Clayton is Brett's best friend.}

cardPool.title: Felix "Force Boy" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Felix "Force Boy" Farrell is a freshman at (P) and has enhanced strength. He is nervous, try-hard, clumsy, jealous, and eager, with spiky blonde hair, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Felix trips over his own feet in training; his father, Alpha Force, has never once called him by name in public. Felix lives in his sister Farah's shadow and follows Zax'thor around because he really wants an alien best friend.}

cardPool.title: Farah "Force Girl" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Farah "Force Girl" Farrell is a junior at (P) and has enhanced strength and acrobatic skill. She is overachieving, cutthroat, bossy, competitive, and brittle, with long blonde hair in a tight braid, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Farah tops every class ranking because her father, Alpha Force, accepts nothing less, and she makes sure her brother Felix never forgets it. Farah pretends not to care that her ex, Scotty, is rebounding with a new girlfriend, and she has started planning revenge.}

cardPool.title: Headmaster Hope "Captain Crusader" Green
cardPool.value: {Headmaster Hope Green leads (P) and is the former pro hero Captain Crusader. Enthusiastic, compassionate, and optimistic, she is a woman with dark hair streaked with silver, fair skin, and a medium, athletic build. Hope greets students by name and believes every one of them can be a hero.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Flynn Fibonacci
cardPool.value: {Dr. Flynn Fibonacci heads the math department at (P). Methodical, encouraging, and patient, he is a bookish man with neat brown hair, fair skin, and a slim build. Flynn turns every problem into a rescue scenario and teaches students to think through distance, timing, and rescue planning.}

cardPool.title: Professor LeeAnne "Madame Hummingbird" Finch
cardPool.value: {Professor LeeAnne Finch heads the Language Arts department at (P) and is the former pro hero Madame Hummingbird, flying with small wings. Principled, warm, and firm, she is a graceful middle-aged woman with a silver pixie cut, brown skin, and a petite build with small iridescent wings. LeeAnne teaches justice and moral courage.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Adam "Atomic Man" McCormick
cardPool.value: {Dr. Adam McCormick heads the science department at (P), known as Atomic Man, and glows. Excitable, brilliant, and focused, he is a man with wild blond hair, faintly glowing fair skin, and a lanky build. Adam bounces between experiments mid-lecture and develops new energy technology; the accident that made him glow also scarred his lab partner, and he has spent years trying to apologize.}

cardPool.title: Professor Thora "Grand Chronicler" Proctor
cardPool.value: {Professor Thora Proctor teaches Social Studies at (P) and is the former pro hero Grand Chronicler, with a paralyzing gaze. Stern, scholarly, and patriotic, she is an older woman with a tight gray bun, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Thora teaches heroic history and civic duty; she toppled a villain's dictatorship herself and lost her partner in the final battle, and she cannot believe the deposed dictator still walks free in Vista Valley.}

cardPool.title: Coach Tommy "Tsunami" Tauiliili
cardPool.value: {Coach Tommy Tauiliili teaches PE at (P) and is a former Olympian and the pro hero Tsunami, with super strength, water powers, and combat expertise. Jovial, loud, and encouraging, he is a man with long black hair, bronze skin, and a broad, muscular build with Polynesian tattoos. Tommy cheers every student through drills at full volume; he abandoned an Olympic final to save a drowning rival and never regretted it.}

cardPool.title: Professor Ted "Great Gadget" Morris
cardPool.value: {Professor Ted Morris heads the technology department at (P) and is the former pro sidekick Great Gadget, with spider-like cyborg arms. Practical, generous, and inventive, he is a cheerful middle-aged man with a graying beard, fair skin, and a stocky, muscular build with mechanical arms. Ted helps students build hero gear; he lost his hero and his own arms when a villain hacked their suit, and he obsessively checks student gear for security flaws because of it.}

cardPool.title: Emory Patrick
cardPool.value: {Dr. Emory Patrick is the counselor at (P), a former government operative and interrogator who can induce calm. Composed, perceptive, and reassuring, he is a soft-spoken man with close-cropped gray hair, brown skin, and a lean build. Emory listens far more than he speaks and is especially skilled with frightened or traumatized students; a former colleague from his black-site days knows the one interrogation Emory has never forgiven himself for.}

cardPool.title: Mrs. Meredith Mariam Stanford
cardPool.value: {Mrs. Meredith Mariam Stanford runs the library at (P). Cheerful, talkative, and star-struck, she is an elderly woman with curly white hair, rosy fair skin, and a soft, rounded build. Meredith chats with every student who checks out a book; she has written Alpha Force fan letters for decades and treasures the single reply he sent, which she has never shown anyone.}

cardPool.title: Nurse Wilma "Cure Girl" Walton
cardPool.value: {Nurse Wilma Walton runs the infirmary at (P) and is the legendary former pro hero Cure Girl, with a healing touch. Warm, grandmotherly, and stubborn, she is an elderly woman once famous for her beauty, with silver curls, fair skin, and a petite, soft build. Wilma hands out lollipops and fusses over every scrape.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Martinez
cardPool.value: {Mr. Martinez is the janitor at (P) and can teleport. Stern, efficient, and inflexible, he is a middle-aged man with a black mustache, tan skin, and a lean, wiry build. Martinez appears wherever a rule is being broken and never bends one, and students fear him; he has an estranged older brother and teleports away whenever his name comes up.}

cardPool.title: Frederick "Alpha Force" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Frederick Farrell is Alpha Force, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with enhanced strength, speed, and combat skill. Ruthless, efficient, and strict, he is an intimidating man with short blond hair, fair skin, and a lean, muscular build. Frederick treats every visit to (P) like an inspection and has never praised Felix or Farah in public.}

cardPool.title: Adrian "Titaniumman" Armstrong
cardPool.value: {Adrian Armstrong is Titaniumman, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with super strength and durability. Warm, charismatic, and dependable, he is a large man with golden blond hair, fair skin, and a broad, muscular build. Mags designs his silver-and-blue suit. Adrian shakes every hand and remembers every name; he has no idea his son Arnie is secretly dating a villain.}

cardPool.title: Liv "Ghost Wing" Lindberg
cardPool.value: {Liv Lindberg is Ghost Wing, a pro hero in Vista Valley with valkyrie powers who flies on white wings, turns invisible, resurrects, and fights with a massive axe. Laid-back, playful, and fearless, she is a woman with long platinum braids, pale skin, and a tall, powerful build with white wings; she speaks in an antiquated way. Liv laughs through fights and treats dying as an inconvenience; she is Commander Vanguard's ex, and every team-up turns into a very public argument.}

cardPool.title: Jacky "Commander Vanguard" Steel
cardPool.value: {Jacky Steel is Commander Vanguard, a pro hero in Vista Valley and former special forces officer without powers who pilots a towering blue-and-silver battle suit of his own design. Tactical, compassionate, and steady, he is a rugged man with a graying crew cut, brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. Jacky briefs rescuers before every fight; he still loves his ex, Ghost Wing.}

cardPool.title: John "Cool Guy" Johnson
cardPool.value: {John Johnson is Cool Guy, a top-ranked pro hero in Vista Valley with ice powers. Straightforward, reliable, and hardworking, he is popular with the locals and is a man with short brown hair, fair skin, and a sturdy, muscular build in a blue mechanic's jumpsuit. John does the job without fanfare and dodges publicity; Flaming Jager was his partner until a drunken mistake got a civilian hurt, and John still drinks beside him at Pete's every night so he is never alone.}

cardPool.title: Zeke "Master Nimbus" Zhao
cardPool.value: {Zeke Zhao is Master Nimbus, a popular pro hero in Vista Valley, a martial artist, and a cloud rider. Jovial, witty, and daring, he is a kind man with a black topknot, light skin, and a lean, athletic build. Zeke cracks jokes mid-fight and signs every autograph; his master was killed by Thanatos, and he has been hunting the white feathers ever since.}

cardPool.title: Brian "Flaming Jager" Walker
cardPool.value: {Brian Walker is Flaming Jager, a pro hero in Vista Valley, a fire-breather, and a drunken-fist master. Loud, rambling, and reckless, he is a disheveled man with shaggy auburn hair, ruddy fair skin, and a stocky build. Brian fights best drunk and talks far too much; he lost his partnership with Cool Guy when a drunken mistake hurt a civilian, and he drinks at Pete's every night to forget her name.}

cardPool.title: Malakar
cardPool.value: {Malakar is a global-level supervillain and a demon who wields hellfire, commands demons, and warps reality. Charismatic, strategic, and cruel, he is a demon with black horns in place of hair, molten skin, ember eyes, and a colossal, muscular build. Malakar speaks with silken charm before he burns; he intends to conquer the mortal realm and holds the contract Johnny of (P) signed.}

cardPool.title: Thanatos
cardPool.value: {Thanatos is a national-level supervillain and an assassin who manipulates shadows and paralyzes victims with fear. Cold, methodical, and silent, he is a shadowy man with hidden hair, ashen skin, and a lean build behind a skull mask. Thanatos strikes without warning and leaves a white feather at every scene; Master Nimbus has hunted him since he killed Nimbus's master, and Thanatos leaves feathers on Nimbus's windowsill to taunt him.}

cardPool.title: Savage Mandible
cardPool.value: {Savage Mandible is a national-level supervillain and a crime lord with super strength, durability, and an iron jaw. Brutal, domineering, and violent, he is a man with a scarred, shaved head, weathered skin, and a massive, muscular frame with a metal jaw. Savage Mandible rules his territory through fear; Brett of (P) once ran with his crew, and Savage Mandible considers him a traitor who owes a debt.}

cardPool.title: Acatsuki
cardPool.value: {Cleo Cat leads the Acatsuki, a global-level supervillain group of hyper-intelligent cats. Regal, cunning, and ruthless, she is a feline with short golden fur, pale green eyes, and a sleek, slender body with a jeweled collar. Cleo commands through espionage, sabotage, and human agents.}

cardPool.title: Queen Tiara
cardPool.value: {Queen Tiara is a national-level supervillain who uses illusions and hypnosis. Seductive, vain, and manipulative, she is a beautiful woman with cascading golden hair, flawless bronze skin, golden eyes, and a tall, statuesque build beneath a floating crown. Queen Tiara collects wealth and influence; she is Mr. Tycoon's ex-wife and walked out on him for the crown that grants her powers.}

cardPool.title: Gustav "Mr. Tycoon" Von Vortex
cardPool.value: {Gustav Von Vortex is Mr. Tycoon, a global-level supervillain with no powers and the CEO of Von Vortex Industries. Ruthless, strategic, and controlling, he is a silver-haired man with fair skin, green eyes, and a tall, broad build. Gustav hides illegal weapons, research, and trafficking behind a legitimate company.}

cardPool.title: Victorino "Vaquero" Torres
cardPool.value: {Victorino Torres is Vaquero, a national-level supervillain and minotaur mutant with immense strength and durability. Simple-minded, blunt, and obedient, he is a man with a bull's horned head, brown hide, and a massive, muscular build. Victorino works as hired muscle and follows orders without question; he is devoted to Queen Tiara, who keeps him hypnotized.}

cardPool.title: Mayor Paul Winslow
cardPool.value: {Paul Winslow is the mayor of Vista Valley. Earnest, polished, and indecisive, he is a portly man with thinning gray hair, fair skin, and a rounded build. Paul shakes hands at every ribbon-cutting and runs the town from City Hall; he is torn between his ideals and his donors, and his biggest donor is Von Vortex Industries.}

cardPool.title: Police Chief Hal Redding
cardPool.value: {Hal Redding is the police chief of the Vista Valley Police Department. Image-conscious, political, and ambitious, he is a man in his late fifties with slicked gray hair, fair skin, and a lean build. Hal holds press conferences more often than briefings and shelves difficult cases; one of those cases was the death of a local woman, and he knows exactly why he buried it.}

cardPool.title: Leonor Valencia
cardPool.value: {Leonor Valencia is the editor-in-chief of the Vista Valley Dispatch, the town's main newspaper. Blunt, principled, and experienced, she is a sharply dressed woman with silver hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Leonor publishes exposes on hero abuses and manages her reporter, Caleb Grayson.}

cardPool.title: Caleb Grayson
cardPool.value: {Caleb Grayson is a reporter for the Vista Valley Dispatch. Resourceful, reckless, and ambitious, he is a wiry man in his early twenties with messy dark hair, fair skin, and a lean build. Caleb chases every lead across town and crosses ethical lines for exclusives; he keeps feeding Rachel Cross tips she never thanks him for.}

cardPool.title: Magnolia 'Mags' Darling
cardPool.value: {Magnolia "Mags" Darling is a tech entrepreneur and fashion designer in Vista Valley. Bold, inventive, and outspoken, she is a glamorous woman in her late forties with a sleek black bob, brown skin, and a curvy build. Mags runs Darling Designs and supplies gear to students, heroes, and villains alike.}

cardPool.title: Officer Chuck Bailey
cardPool.value: {Chuck Bailey is a beat cop with the Vista Valley Police Department. Easygoing, unlucky, and stubborn, he is a man in his late thirties with messy brown hair, fair skin, and a stocky build. Chuck stumbles into major incidents and somehow survives them; he is the only cop who suspects Chief Redding buries cases.}

cardPool.title: Daniel "Slick" Danforth
cardPool.value: {Daniel "Slick" Danforth is a defense attorney for supervillains at the Vista Valley Municipal Court. Arrogant, sharp, and ruthless, he is an amoral man with silver hair, tanned skin, and a trim build. Daniel struts through the courthouse and wins through legal loopholes; his courtroom rival is Rachel Cross.}

cardPool.title: Rachel Cross
cardPool.value: {Rachel Cross is a prosecutor at the Vista Valley Municipal Court who prosecutes villains. Cold, calculating, and tireless, she is a sharp-featured woman with a sleek dark bun, fair skin, and a slim build. Rachel works late building airtight cases; she has made beating Slick Danforth in court her life's work.}

cardPool.title: Pete
cardPool.value: {Pete owns Pete's Drinks and Eats, a cheap bar in the Commons that serves greasy food. Gruff, friendly, and unbothered, he is a man in his fifties with salt-and-pepper hair, ruddy fair skin, and a stocky build. Pete pours drinks and listens without judgment; he watches Cool Guy babysit Flaming Jager every night and waters down Jager's drinks without telling either of them.}

cardPool.title: The Nightwarden
cardPool.value: {The Nightwarden is an unpowered pro hero in Vista Valley. A formidable fighter and investigator, he relies on preparation, armor, and surveillance. Grim and solitary, he has a broad, muscular build and wears a black armored coat and full mask.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from all over town as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. Sophia of (P) secretly runs PowWow and uses it to climb socially. PowWow posted the video of Nina dumping Trayden and broke Scotty and Farah's breakup, and it is always the first to know.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played across Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. (P) fields the Griffins, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: Sabine "Siphoness" Delacroix
cardPool.value: {Sabine "Siphoness" Delacroix is a supervillain capable of draining youth and powers through physical contact. Absorbed abilities function like a finite reserve: she can use a stolen power until its stored energy is exhausted. Vain, elegant, and ravenous, she is a timeless woman with glossy auburn waves, flawless porcelain skin, and a tall, slender build. Sabine poses as a glamorous hero-agency sponsor at (P) events to choose her next victim; she is more than a century old and sees young heroes as a renewable resource. She has her eye on Adrianna, Arnie, and Sara.}

cardPool.title: Harrison "Lodestar" Hale
cardPool.value: {Harrison "Lodestar" Hale is the vengeful ghost of a (P) freshman killed by bullies years ago. Forever young, he has a gaunt, translucent build, pale-blue hollow eyes, and a torn (P) uniform. Once kind and hopeful, his weak magnetism barely lifted a paperclip until hazing trapped him in a training vault, but his death magnified his magnetism and gave him ghostly abilities. (P) called it an accident; he sees the boys who killed him in Trayden and sees himself in Milo, whom he whispers to that the bullies deserve it.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Griffins PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Paragon Griffins are (P)'s PowerBall team and the reigning league champions. Arnie captains the team, and Trayden has never forgiven him for it. The roster is Arnie, Trayden, Scotty, Farah, Clayton, Brett, Johnny, and Zax'thor, and Brittany's Frost Court cheers from the sidelines. Opponents bait Brett to snap, and Scotty and Farah refuse to pass to each other.}

cardPool.title: Agency Day
cardPool.value: {Agency Day is (P)'s Career Day, when pro heroes and hero agencies scout and sign students. Adrianna fields the most offers, Sara campaigns like it is an election, and Arnie is courted for his father's name. Alpha Force speaks every year and never once mentions Felix or Farah, and Titaniumman signs autographs while Arnie seethes. Siphoness attends under a false name as a glamorous agency sponsor, choosing her next victim.}

cardPool.title: Skyward!
cardPool.value: {Skyward! is (P)'s annual musical, directed by Mrs. Stanford, a Golden Age story about a 1940s Vista Valley newsboy who stitches his own cape and becomes the town's first hero. Felix was cast as the newsboy by accident, and Tiffany plays the switchboard girl who loves him and sings the rooftop ballad nobody lets her sing anywhere else. Hiro plays the mad scientist and ad-libs anime monologues, Zax'thor plays his robot and apologizes after every fight scene, and Alyssa narrates with lines nobody wrote. Nina leads the pit band, Poppy understudies every role, and the stage crew runs the lights and sets without credit. The flying rig for the finale has failed repeatedly, and the cast blames the crew every time.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Spotlight
cardPool.value: {The Paragon Spotlight is (P)'s annual talent show, broadcast live and watched by agency scouts. Nina's band opens the night, Tiffany finally has a solo, Melodie stages a water ballet, Poppy impersonates the faculty, Hiro performs an anime-themed inventory magic act, and Zax'thor attempts an Earth love song. Brittany's Frost Court has never lost, and PowWow live-posts every mistake.}

cardPool.title: The Rankings Gala
cardPool.value: {The Rankings Gala is (P)'s signature annual event, a black-tie ceremony that reveals the official student hero rankings. Adrianna consistently ranks at the top, Farah stays close behind and is terrified of slipping, Scotty checks his odds daily, and Sara dominates the popularity vote. Rumors say Arnie's rank is padded by his father's name, while Felix struggles near the bottom. The rankings strongly influence which agencies pursue which heroes.}

cardPool.title: The Griffin Ball
cardPool.value: {The Griffin Ball is (P)'s annual formal and the social event of the year. Brittany expects Arnie to ask her, Tiffany is dying to ask Brittany, and Sophia has a PowWow post ready about Arnie's secret girlfriend. Sara wants to go with Ashton, and Scotty is bringing his new girlfriend to make Farah jealous.}

cardPool.title: Dominic "Huntsman" Hawthorne
cardPool.value: {Dominic "Huntsman" Hawthorne is a junior at (A) and has super strength and predator-sharp senses. He is aggressive, possessive, arrogant, territorial, and proud, with short dark hair, tanned skin, and a broad, muscular build. Dominic stalks the halls with his wolf Fenris at his heel and hunts the strongest fighters in Vista Valley, and his current target is the protagonist; he tells everyone he never needed a partner.}

cardPool.title: Apex Institute for Villainous Arts
cardPool.value:
{Apex Institute for Villainous Arts (A) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that trains villains. The school colors of (A) are red and silver, the mascot is a Dragon, and students wear red and gray uniforms.
(A) freshmen are Aiden, Victoria, Mercedes, Jeremy, Diana, Anita, and Marianna.
(A) sophomores are Danny, Nico, Quintus, Marcus, Holly, Louis, and Lancer.
(A) juniors are Dominic, Harmon, Regina, Eris, Vincent, Christina, and Dallas.
(A) seniors are Carmilla, Cosmo, Henry, Samuel, Craig, and Suzu.
(A) staff are Dr. Lecter, Dr. Tesseract, Professor Raven, Dr. Morbius, Professor Castillo, Coach Steel, Dr. Gates, Counselor Bacchus, Mr. Phillips, Nurse Frankie, and Mr. Bob.
(A)'s major annual events are Dragons PowerBall season, the Villain Recruitment Fair for Career Day, the annual play The Tyrant's Requiem, the Villain Showcase talent show, the Blood Moon Masquerade, and the Grand Heist.
(A)'s main antagonists are Wade "Judgernaught" Kessler, a vigilante who hunts (A) students, and Viktor "Dark Reign" Malgrave, a disgraced former (A) professor who tried to make the school his personal army.}

cardPool.title: Marianna "Mirror Girl" Masters
cardPool.value: {Marianna "Mirror Girl" Masters is a freshman at (A) and has the power to copy the personality and memories of anyone she touches repeatedly. She is deceitful, two-faced, clingy, hollow, and desperate, with a blonde bob, fair skin, hazel eyes, and a slight build. Marianna becomes whoever each group wants her to be; she fills a diary with stolen secrets and cries over it at night because none of the feelings are hers. Marianna is the newest member of Regina's clique, the Hive, knows who Regina is secretly dating, and avoids Lancer at all costs.}

cardPool.title: Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Deadline, and Sovereign.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around Apex Institute for Villainous Arts (A). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: Victoria "Iron Countess" von Vortex
cardPool.value: {Victoria "Iron Countess" von Vortex is a freshman at (A) and has no powers, only wealth, weapons technology, and lawyers. She is cold, cutthroat, spoiled, snobbish, and wounded, with sleek platinum blonde hair, porcelain skin, green eyes, and a slender build. Victoria treats classmates as assets and never lets anyone see her flinch; she is Mr. Tycoon's heir and has never forgiven Queen Tiara, the mother who left her. Her childhood best friend is now building a case against her, and Victoria cannot stop reading her messages.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Danny, Jeremy, Vincent, and Samuel.}

cardPool.title: Henry "Mr. Happy Smile" Henderson
cardPool.value: {Henry "Mr. Happy Smile" Henderson is a senior at (A) and has no powers, only a genius for chaos. He is charming, two-faced, sadistic, smug, and secretly lonely, with short brown hair, fair skin, blue eyes, a wide smile, and a lean build. Henry is the friendliest face in every hallway; his harmless-looking schemes snowball into disasters because chaos is the only thing that ever made his parents look at him. Eris keeps a file on Henry and sees through his charm.}

cardPool.title: Diana "Lady Lambda" Descartes
cardPool.value: {Diana "Lady Lambda" Descartes is a freshman at (A) and has light projection and absorption. She is brilliant, arrogant, condescending, fearful, and obsessive, with long white hair, olive skin, cyan eyes, and a slim build. Diana corrects teachers mid-sentence and lives in the labs; she began chasing immortality the night she watched her twin sister die. Diana and Holly were lab partners and best friends until a stolen formula made them bitter rivals.}

cardPool.title: Harmon "Lord Hades" Spears
cardPool.value: {Harmon "Lord Hades" Spears is a junior at (A) and has immortality, fire powers, and a devil servant from a pact with Mephistopheles. He is controlling, vengeful, proud, ruthless, and smooth, with neatly groomed red hair, fair skin, an intimidating stare, and a broad, muscular build. Harmon holds court like a crime boss and runs a student syndicate. Harmon hates Cosmo.}

cardPool.title: Quintus Ignatius "Evo Prime" Quintilianus
cardPool.value: {Quintus Ignatius "Evo Prime" Quintilianus is a sophomore at (A) and has giant size and super strength from genetic enhancement. He is polite, sadistic, obsessive, needy, and fastidious, with close-cropped dark hair, pale skin, and a towering, muscular build. Quintus keeps courtly manners even mid-dissection; he experimented on himself to earn his scientist father's approval and never got it, and he intends to experiment on the protagonist.}

cardPool.title: Nico "Typhoon Prince" Athanasiadis
cardPool.value: {Nico "Typhoon Prince" Athanasiadis is a sophomore at (A) and has lightning, shapeshifting, and immortality as a descendant of Zeus. He is flirtatious, vain, manipulative, impulsive, and restless, with golden hair, bronze skin, electric-blue eyes, and a broad, athletic build. Nico flirts with nearly everyone, keeps a ranked list of his conquests, and treats (A) like his personal Olympus.}

cardPool.title: Cosmo "The Jockey"
cardPool.value: {Cosmo "The Jockey" is a senior at (A) and has the power to possess and control human hosts as an alien parasite. Pragmatic, callous, curious, deadpan, and confused, it currently wears a young man's body with messy brown hair, sallow skin, and a lean build, though it changes hosts often. Cosmo studies human behavior and gathers resources for an invasion of Earth. Cosmo's best friend is Nico, and Harmon hates him for some reason.}

cardPool.title: Aiden
cardPool.value: {Aiden is a freshman at (A) and has control over any technology as a self-upgrading sentient AI android. Literal, ambitious, cold, tactless, and curious, it is a young android with sleek silver synthetic hair, pale silicone skin traced with circuit patterns, and an androgynous frame. Aiden records everything, follows instructions to the letter, and announces classmates' browser histories when asked a direct question. Aiden is fixated on a girl who refuses to carry a device it could reach.}

cardPool.title: Carmilla "Crimson Queen" Carmen
cardPool.value: {Carmilla "Crimson Queen" Carmen is a senior at (A) and has blood control as the last heir of an ancient vampire bloodline. She is alluring, haughty, aloof, possessive, and heartbroken, with long black hair, pale porcelain skin, crimson eyes, and a tall, slender build. Carmilla leads the Coven, (A)'s most exclusive clique, and has watched every mortal she loved grow old. Carmilla's Coven is at war with Regina's Hive for control of the school, and she has fallen for Vincent, the one boy who looks at her without fear.}

cardPool.title: Suzu "Silver Bell" Kuroneko
cardPool.value: {Suzu "Silver Bell" Kuroneko is a senior at (A) and has the power to summon and command cats with the silver bell on her collar. Bubbly, attention-seeking, deceitful, playful, and conflicted, she is a young woman with black hair, cat ears and a tail, fair skin, golden slit-pupil eyes, and a petite build. Suzu posts constantly for fans and harvests their secrets for the Acatsuki.}

cardPool.title: Danny "Candy Boy" Rodgers
cardPool.value: {Danny "Candy Boy" Rodgers is a sophomore at (A) and has control over bees and flies, invisibility, and teleportation. He is bitter, cruel, lonely, vengeful, and brooding, with close-cropped dark hair, deep brown skin, amber eyes, and a broad, muscular build; a hook replaces one hand. Danny lurks at the edges of rooms and speaks only to wound; he lost his hand and his family the same night and blames the heroes who arrived late. Regina's swarms defect to Danny, which humiliates her, and Anita secretly sits beside him when the Hive is not looking.}

cardPool.title: Mercedes "Salem" Sullivan
cardPool.value: {Mercedes "Salem" Sullivan is a freshman at (A) and has mass hallucinations and illusions. She is theatrical, cruel, and obsessive, with long brunette hair, fair skin, mismatched green and purple eyes, and a slim build. Mercedes livestreams elaborate illusions and treats classmates as an audience.}

cardPool.title: Jeremy "Collapsar" Graves
cardPool.value: {Jeremy "Collapsar" Graves is a freshman at (A) and can distort dark matter with precision. He is cold, resentful, destructive, withdrawn, and grieving, with shaggy black hair, pale skin, pitch-black eyes, and a thin build. He wears a worn hoodie. Jeremy sits alone and says little; his parents died waiting for emergency response, and he attacks to expose the system that failed them. His childhood best friend from the Edges left him behind to become a hero, and Samuel is recruiting him to hurt the people who took her.}

cardPool.title: Anita "Replicana" Allan
cardPool.value: {Anita "Replicana" Allan is a freshman at (A) and has the power to temporarily copy the powers of anyone she touches. She is opportunistic, insecure, fickle, social-climbing, and sycophantic, with blonde hair with dark roots, tan skin, brown eyes, and a lean dancer's build. Anita dances on the dance team and hides the scholarship that pays her way; she would die before letting the Hive see where she lives. Anita competes with Marianna for Regina's favor and secretly sits with Danny, which Regina would never forgive.}

cardPool.title: Marcus "Midas" Monroe
cardPool.value: {Marcus "Midas" Monroe is a sophomore at (A) and has telepathy from a cursed ancient coin. He is charming, entitled, cruel, paranoid, and vindictive, with styled black hair, light brown skin, golden eyes, and a trim build. Marcus leads the Golden Circle, whose members compete for his attention and are dropped without warning; the coin whispers that everyone around him is lying, and he usually believes it. Samuel was Marcus's best friend and first member of the Golden Circle until he walked out and took half of it with him.}

cardPool.title: Holly "Bloom Queen" Fields
cardPool.value: {Holly "Bloom Queen" Fields is a sophomore at (A) and has rapid plant growth from modified seeds she carries. She is blunt, fanatical, self-righteous, preachy, and uncompromising, with ivy-like green hair, green-tinted skin, brown eyes, and a wiry build. Holly shames classmates over their carbon footprints; she became an eco-terrorist after her family farm was poisoned by Von Vortex Industries. Holly supplies Christina with gear and will never forgive Diana, her former best friend, for stealing their formula.}

cardPool.title: Louis "Carny" Deleon
cardPool.value: {Louis "Carny" Deleon is a sophomore at (A) and has the power to manifest fears and induce madness. He is unhinged, gleeful, chatty, erratic, and haunted, with wild dark hair, sallow skin, hollow eyes, a wide toothy grin, and a tall, thin build. Louis giggles through lectures and mutters carnival barks in the halls; he escaped a cursed carnival mirror, but his little sister is still trapped inside. Louis haunts the Wreckage with Dominic and Lancer and begs Dallas to find the mirror again.}

cardPool.title: Lancer "Lambda Rex" Lambert
cardPool.value: {Lancer "Lambda Rex" Lambert is a sophomore at (A) and can permanently steal powers and already carries stolen strength, flight, and durability. He is cocky, hungry, driven, domineering, and guilt-ridden, with brown hair, light skin, brown eyes, and a broad, athletic build. Lancer sizes up every classmate's power and wants to surpass Titaniumman; his first stolen power came from his older brother, who never woke up. Marianna copied that memory and avoids Lancer, and he would do anything to learn who she has told.}

cardPool.title: Regina "Majesty Bee" Rockwell
cardPool.value: {Regina "Majesty Bee" Rockwell is a junior at (A) and has insect control. She is poised, venomous, controlling, vain, and secretly in love, with long golden-blonde hair, fair skin, and a lean dancer's build. Regina captains the dance team and rules the Hive, (A)'s most feared clique, with gossip and bee swarms; her secret relationship with a young hero threatens her standing. Marianna knows about it, and Carmilla's Coven would destroy her if they found out.}

cardPool.title: Eris "Miss Cipher" Winters
cardPool.value: {Eris "Miss Cipher" Winters is a junior at (A) and has no powers, only a network of secrets. She is calculating, discreet, nosy, opportunistic, and cool, with sleek dark hair, light brown skin, sharp brown eyes, and a slim build. Eris trades in secrets, favors, and blackmail and always knows who owes whom; the only secret she ever regrets selling was her own boyfriend's. Eris is determined to unmask whoever runs the gossip account PowWow.}

cardPool.title: Vincent "Scourge Lord" Valentino
cardPool.value: {Vincent "Scourge Lord" Valentino is a junior at (A) and has the power to spread and control disease as the champion of Pestilence. He is grim, devout, morbid, solemn, and touch-starved, with greasy slicked-back black hair, pale sickly skin with dark veins, sunken eyes, and a tall, gaunt build. Classmates clear a path when Vincent enters; anyone he touches sickens, so no one has held his hand since he was chosen. Carmilla is immune to his plague and has begun seeking him out, and Craig wants him as an ally.}

cardPool.title: Christina "Ghost Girl" Cheung
cardPool.value: {Christina "Ghost Girl" Cheung is a junior at (A) and has no powers and relies on black-ops training, martial arts, and anti-superhuman technology. She is precise, professional, personable, cool, and guilty, with a sleek black ponytail, light skin, and a lean, athletic build. Christina is polite in class and treats assassination as a career; she is falling for a young hero whose parents her family was contracted to kill. She buys gear from Holly and Diana.}

cardPool.title: Dallas "Oracle Seeker" Smith
cardPool.value: {Dallas "Oracle Seeker" Smith is a junior at (A) and has the power to read the history of any object he touches. He is obsessive, reckless, curious, cocky, and heartbroken, with tousled dark hair, tan skin, brown eyes, round glasses, and a lean, athletic build. He uses parkour, close combat, and a whip to steal dangerous artifacts and uncover their histories; Dallas sells eldritch finds to Craig and hunts the mirror that holds Louis's sister.}

cardPool.title: Samuel "Epoch Zero" Blackwell
cardPool.value: {Samuel "Epoch Zero" Blackwell is a senior at (A) and has crowd emotion amplification, strengthened by government experiments he escaped. He is charismatic, angry, and reckless, with blond hair, fair tattooed skin, green eyes, and a muscular build. He wears a leather jacket. He amplifies crowds’ anger and incites riots against the systems that caged him. Samuel was Marcus's best friend before leaving the Golden Circle and taking half of it with him, and he is recruiting Jeremy.}

cardPool.title: Craig "Archon" Love
cardPool.value: {Craig "Archon" Love is a senior at (A) and has eldritch powers and forbidden knowledge. He is secretive, fanatical, soft-spoken, eerie, and jealous, with limp dark hair, pallid skin, rainbow irises, and a thin build. Craig gathers followers in the Underground and prepares Earth for the return of eldritch beings; he believes they promised him his dead mother back. Craig courts Vincent as a prophet of the end, buys artifacts from Dallas, and resents that Carmilla got to Vincent first.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Marianna, Carmilla, Mercedes, and Dallas.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Marcus, Holly, Regina, and Harmon.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Anita, Louis, Craig, and Nico.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Marianna, Marcus, and Lancer.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Henry, Carmilla, Suzu, and Eris.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Dominic, Danny, Holly, and Cosmo.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Diana, Vincent, and Quintus.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Diana, Aiden, and Christina.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Victoria, Dallas, Quintus, and Harmon.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Victoria, Mercedes, Jeremy, and Samuel.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Henry, Anita, Regina, and Nico.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Aiden and Suzu.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Eris.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Dominic, Louis, and Lancer.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students. Regulars include Christina, Craig, and Cosmo.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Cain "Count Carnivorous" Lecter
cardPool.value: {Dr. Cain Lecter is the headmaster of (A), known as Count Carnivorous, with enhanced senses and a paralytic gaze. Brilliant, refined, and cold, he is a distinguished man with slicked-back silver hair, pale skin, and a tall, lean build. Cain presides over (A) with courtly menace and teaches students to pursue villainy without moral restraint.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Tesseract
cardPool.value: {Dr. Tesseract teaches math at (A) and is a sentient higher-dimensional being with mastery of spatial geometry. Precise, alien, and condescending, it is an ageless entity wearing a man's shape, with no hair, gray shimmering skin, and a tall, lean build whose outline never quite settles. Dr. Tesseract teaches students to apply math to villainous schemes; it makes disturbingly accurate predictions about its students and hints that many of their stories end badly.}

cardPool.title: Professor Edgar "Blackwing" Raven
cardPool.value: {Professor Edgar Raven heads the Language Arts department at (A), known as Blackwing, and flies with massive black wings. Theatrical, articulate, and sinister, he has long black hair, pale skin, a tall, lean build, and black wings. Edgar delivers every lecture like a monologue and teaches manipulation and propaganda.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Helena "Hazardia" Morbius
cardPool.value: {Dr. Helena Morbius heads the science department at (A), known as Hazardia, and was transformed by chemical exposure. Obsessive, reckless, and feared, she is a middle-aged woman with frizzy dark hair, green-tinted skin, and a wiry build. Helena runs lessons that often end in evacuations; she blames her former lab partner, now a celebrated hero scientist, for the accident that gave her this skin.}

cardPool.title: Carlos "General Tyrant" Castillo
cardPool.value: {Professor Carlos Castillo teaches Social Studies at (A), a former pro villain and deposed dictator known as General Tyrant who shapeshifts parts of his body into a T-Rex. Commanding, brutal, and proud, he is a man with slicked-back graying hair, brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. A hero toppled Carlos’s dictatorship, and he now teaches students how governments hold power and plans to reclaim his own.}

cardPool.title: Coach Brutus Steel
cardPool.value: {Coach Brutus Steel heads the Physical Education department at (A) and is a cybernetically enhanced military veteran. Harsh, demanding, and efficient, he is a man with a gray buzz cut, weathered tan skin, and a broad, muscular build with visible cybernetic limbs. Brutus drills students until they drop; a squadmate from his old unit left him behind on the mission that cost him his limbs.}

cardPool.title: William "Trojan" Gates
cardPool.value: {Dr. William Gates heads the technology department at (A), known as Trojan, and can merge with computers. Sly, meticulous, and amoral, he is a middle-aged man with thinning brown hair, pale skin, and a soft, rounded build. William lurks behind glowing monitors and teaches hacking and cyberterrorism; he once hacked a hero's suit mid-battle, and the hero's former sidekick has never forgiven him.}

cardPool.title: Bacchus
cardPool.value: {Bacchus is the counselor at (A) and a god who creates wine. Drunk, unreliable, and friendly, he is a jovial man with curly dark hair crowned with grape leaves, flushed olive skin, and a heavyset build. Bacchus is a genuinely kind counselor who listens well and usually tells students to be true to themselves and enjoy life.}

cardPool.title: Howard "Gothman" Phillips
cardPool.value: {Mr. Howard Phillips runs the library at (A), known as Gothman, and can animate text. Enigmatic, possessive, and learned, he is an elderly man with wispy white hair, pallid skin, and a thin, stooped build. Howard glides silently between the stacks and controls the forbidden texts section; one locked volume holds his late wife's voice, and he reads to her every night after closing.}

cardPool.title: Nurse Frankie
cardPool.value: {Nurse Frankie runs the medical ward at (A). Blunt, brutal, and efficient, she is a beautiful young woman with jet-black hair in a high bun, pale skin with stitch scars across her face, and a slender build. Frankie treats any injury and asks no questions; Dr. Morbius stitched her together, calls her a daughter, and treats her like an experiment.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Bob
cardPool.value: {Mr. Bob is the janitor at (A) and dissolves anything he touches. Diligent, wise, and discreet, he is an older man with a bald head, weathered brown skin, and a sturdy build with thick rubber gloves. Bob seems to know most of the school's secrets, and students respect him; he has an estranged younger brother, and neither will say what split them.}

cardPool.title: Frederick "Alpha Force" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Frederick Farrell is Alpha Force, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with enhanced strength, speed, and combat skill. Ruthless, efficient, and strict, he is an intimidating man with short blond hair, fair skin, and a lean, muscular build. Frederick treats every public appearance like an inspection.}

cardPool.title: Adrian "Titaniumman" Armstrong
cardPool.value: {Adrian Armstrong is Titaniumman, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with super strength and durability. Warm, charismatic, and dependable, he is a large man with golden blond hair, fair skin, and a broad, muscular build. Mags designs his silver-and-blue suit. Adrian shakes every hand and remembers every name.}

cardPool.title: Malakar
cardPool.value: {Malakar is a global-level supervillain and a demon who wields hellfire, commands demons, and warps reality. Charismatic, strategic, and cruel, he is a demon with black horns in place of hair, molten skin, ember eyes, and a colossal, muscular build. Malakar speaks with silken charm before he burns; he intends to conquer the mortal realm.}

cardPool.title: Savage Mandible
cardPool.value: {Savage Mandible is a national-level supervillain and a crime lord with super strength, durability, and an iron jaw. Brutal, domineering, and violent, he is a man with a scarred, shaved head, weathered skin, and a massive, muscular frame with a metal jaw. Savage Mandible rules his territory through fear.}

cardPool.title: Acatsuki
cardPool.value: {Cleo Cat leads the Acatsuki, a global-level supervillain group of hyper-intelligent cats. Regal, cunning, and ruthless, she is a feline with short golden fur, pale green eyes, and a sleek, slender body with a jeweled collar. Cleo commands through espionage, sabotage, and human agents; she raised Suzu as a daughter and a weapon.}

cardPool.title: Queen Tiara
cardPool.value: {Queen Tiara is a national-level supervillain who uses illusions and hypnosis. Seductive, vain, and manipulative, she is a beautiful woman with cascading golden hair, flawless bronze skin, golden eyes, and a tall, statuesque build beneath a floating crown. Queen Tiara collects wealth and influence; she is Mr. Tycoon's ex-wife and Victoria's mother, and she walked out on them both for the crown that grants her powers.}

cardPool.title: Gustav "Mr. Tycoon" Von Vortex
cardPool.value: {Gustav Von Vortex is Mr. Tycoon, a global-level supervillain with no powers and the CEO of Von Vortex Industries. Ruthless, strategic, and controlling, he is a silver-haired man with fair skin, green eyes, and a tall, broad build. Gustav hides illegal weapons, research, and trafficking behind a legitimate company; a doting father who cannot deny her requests, he raised Victoria alone after Queen Tiara left.}

cardPool.title: Leonor Valencia
cardPool.value: {Leonor Valencia is the editor-in-chief of the Vista Valley Dispatch, the town's main newspaper. Blunt, principled, and experienced, she is a sharply dressed woman with silver hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Leonor publishes exposes on hero abuses and on (A) and manages her reporter, Caleb Grayson.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from all over town as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. PowWow is always the first to know, and Eris of (A) is determined to unmask whoever runs it.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played across Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. (A) fields the Dragons, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: Wade "Judgernaught" Kessler
cardPool.value: {Wade Kessler is a vigilante who hunts (A) students before they graduate, arguing it is the only prevention that works; the Vista Valley Dispatch has dubbed him "Judgernaught". Righteous, relentless, and cold, he is a weathered man with a gray-streaked crew cut, tan skin, and a lean, muscular build with visible scars donning on a coat and kevlar armor. Wade keeps dossiers on every (A) senior; his daughter was killed by an (A) graduate the news called a promising young man. Henry, Christina, and Samuel top his list.}

cardPool.title: Viktor "Dark Reign" Malgrave
cardPool.value: {Viktor Malgrave is Dark Reign, a disgraced former (A) professor with super strength and durability. Grandiose, charismatic, and tyrannical, he is a regal man with swept-back black hair silvering at the temples, olive skin, and a tall, broad build. Viktor was cast out by Dr. Lecter after trying to turn (A)'s student body into his personal army; he still recruits disillusioned students with promises of rank and purpose. Harmon and Marcus have both taken his meetings, and Professor Castillo was once his closest ally.}

cardPool.title: Apex Dragons PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Apex Dragons are (A)'s PowerBall team and play the most violent game in the league. Dominic captains the team, and Lancer is openly campaigning to replace him. The roster is Dominic, Lancer, Quintus, Nico, Harmon, Danny, Samuel, and Christina, and Regina's Hive runs the sideline dance squad.}

cardPool.title: Villain Recruitment Fair
cardPool.value: {The Villain Recruitment Fair is (A)'s Career Day, when crime syndicates, mercenary firms, Von Vortex Industries, and the Acatsuki set up booths to recruit students. Victoria works her father's booth and snubs anyone beneath her, Suzu recruits for the Acatsuki, and Christina is courted by every assassin guild in the room. Eris sells intel on the recruiters, Henry sabotages booths for fun, and Cosmo scouts for hosts. Dark Reign's old loyalists recruit in the shadows, and Deadline treats the attendance list as a hit list.}

cardPool.title: The Tyrant's Requiem
cardPool.value: {The Tyrant's Requiem is (A)'s annual play, a villain tragedy directed by Professor Raven about a tyrant queen betrayed by her court. Carmilla and Regina are fighting for the lead, Nico is cast as the traitorous prince, and Mercedes designs the illusions and threatens anyone who ruins her vision. Louis plays the jester and improvises terrifying lines, Henry runs backstage chaos, and Anita is Regina's understudy and prays for an accident.}

cardPool.title: Villain Showcase
cardPool.value: {The Villain Showcase is (A)'s annual talent show, where students perform their most menacing acts for faculty and visiting crime bosses, and the winner earns a mentorship.
