Mercedes stages an illusion nightmare, Suzu performs with a swarm of cats, Nico throws lightning, Harmon has his devil servant perform for the crime bosses, and Aiden hacks the audience's phones. Louis's fear act left judges with nightmares last year, and Regina's dance number is always aimed at whoever beat her.}

cardPool.title: Blood Moon Masquerade
cardPool.value: {The Blood Moon Masquerade is (A)'s annual formal, a masked ball held on a night known for its red moon. Carmilla's Coven hosts it every year, and Regina's Hive either boycotts or crashes it. The masks hide scandals: Regina sneaks in her secret hero boyfriend in disguise, and Carmilla dances with Vincent. Eris sells the guest list, and Marianna attends as someone else entirely.}

cardPool.title: The Grand Heist
cardPool.value: {The Grand Heist is (A)'s signature annual competition, where student crews have one night to steal a target Dr. Lecter chooses somewhere in Vista Valley. Harmon's syndicate, Marcus's Golden Circle, Samuel's crew, and Victoria's hired team compete every year, while Christina and Dallas enter alone. Eris sells the security plans to all of them. Dark Reign once used the Heist to test his loyalists, and Deadline watches it to learn who will kill first.}

cardPool.title: Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Deadline, Sovereign, Emperor Vorzakh, Empress Ruvalia, and the Void Keeper.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy (PPP). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Maddie and Mateo.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Rinko and Beatriz.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Minseo and Rinko.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Hanako and Jessie.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Maddie, Mateo, and Amira.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Cody, Sayo, and Jessie.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Ingrid, Alyson, and Kelechi.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Minseo, Haoyu, and Beatriz.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Kexin and Kelechi.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Kexin, Hanako, and Sunwoo.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Cody, Sloane, and Amira.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Daichi, Ingrid, and Alyson.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Haoyu and Elijah.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Elijah, Haeun, and Sayo.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Daichi and Sunwoo.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students. Regulars include Sloane and Haeun.}

cardPool.title: Cody "Red Raptor" Harrington
cardPool.value: {Cody Harrington is a senior at (PPP) and is the Red Raptor Protector. He is disciplined, dutiful, rigid, proud, and heartbroken, with a shaved head, tan skin, and a broad-shouldered, muscular build with a scar along his jaw. Cody leads the senior team as its vanguard and pilots the Raptor Primalzord; he got the jaw scar shielding Minseo, and a week later she left him for his best friend. Cody still has to take battle plans from Daichi, Mateo challenges him at every turn, and Elijah worships him.}

cardPool.title: Daichi "Blue Marlin" Tanabe
cardPool.value: {Daichi Tanabe is a senior at (PPP) and is the Blue Marlin Protector. He is loud, cocky, charming, brash, and guilty, with a shaved undercut, light skin, a constant grin, and a broad, muscular build. Daichi commands the senior team in combat and pilots the Marlin Primalzord; he was Cody's best friend since orientation until he started dating Minseo the week she dumped Cody. Daichi insists nothing happened before the breakup, Kelechi knows otherwise, and Sunwoo copies his worst habits.}

cardPool.title: Kexin "Green Rhino" Zhou
cardPool.value: {Kexin Zhou is a senior at (PPP) and is the Green Rhino Protector. She is scrappy, bitter, stubborn, sarcastic, and overlooked, with a short black bob, light skin, and a short, sturdy build. Kexin repairs the Rhino Primalzord herself and holds the senior team together while nobody thanks her. Kexin is sick of the whole academy fawning over Minseo and forgiving her for wrecking the team.}

cardPool.title: Maddie "Yellow Jackrabbit" Whitfield
cardPool.value: {Maddie Whitfield is a senior at (PPP) and is the Yellow Jackrabbit Protector. She is restless, cocky, trash-talking, competitive, and smitten, with a sandy ponytail, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Maddie scouts for the senior team in the Jackrabbit Primalzord and talks fast so nobody notices when she is scared. Maddie is dating a speedster from across town after months of racing him, and she has no idea he is mostly using her to make his ex jealous.}

cardPool.title: Minseo "Pink Peacock" Yoon
cardPool.value: {Minseo Yoon is a senior at (PPP) and is the Pink Peacock Protector. She is radiant, charming, vain, calculating, and adored, with long bleached-blonde hair, fair skin, and a slender build. Minseo is a popular student with admirers across Vista Valley and provides the senior team's shields, healing, and ranged fire. Minseo dumped Cody for his best friend Daichi and split the senior team in half, and Kexin is the only one who refuses to forgive her.}

cardPool.title: Mateo "Red Ram" Delgado
cardPool.value: {Mateo Delgado is a junior at (PPP) and is the Red Ram Protector. He is hotheaded, ambitious, arrogant, reckless, and oblivious, with a buzzed fade, brown skin, a chipped front tooth, and a compact, muscular build. Mateo leads the junior team and charges in the Ram Primalzord; he calls the senior team a soap opera and wants Cody's spot. Mateo chases Rinko, who ignores him, and never notices that Beatriz covers every mistake he makes because she loves him.}

cardPool.title: Sloane "Blue Fox" Kovacs
cardPool.value: {Sloane Kovacs is a junior at (PPP) and is the Blue Fox Protector. She is blunt, analytical, cold, condescending, and ruthless, with a pale buzz cut, fair skin, a flat stare, and a tall, muscular build. Sloane plans for the junior team and pilots the Fox Primalzord; she treats casualties as acceptable losses and rarely shows grief. Sloane openly mocks Mateo's leadership, and Rinko defies her orders at every turn.}

cardPool.title: Haoyu "Green Tortoise" Liang
cardPool.value: {Haoyu Liang is a junior at (PPP) and is the Green Tortoise Protector. He is awkward, bashful, studious, jealous, and loyal, with messy black hair, light skin, and a tall, lean build and stooped posture. Haoyu is the junior team's defensive specialist in the Tortoise Primalzord and confides in Elijah over BattleForce.}

cardPool.title: Rinko "Yellow Falcon" Sagara
cardPool.value: {Rinko Sagara is a junior at (PPP) and is the Yellow Falcon Protector. She is rebellious, aloof, disobedient, bold, and prickly, with a short black bob, light skin, and a lean, athletic build in a flight jacket. Rinko scouts for the junior team in the Falcon Primalzord and breaks formation to chase leads; she keeps everyone at a distance after being abandoned by someone she trusted. Rinko defies Sloane at every turn and ignores Mateo's crush, knowing Beatriz loves him.}

cardPool.title: Beatriz "Pink Dove" Salazar
cardPool.value: {Beatriz Salazar is a junior at (PPP) and is the Pink Dove Protector. She is warm, martyred, passive-aggressive, nurturing, and heartbroken, with curly brown hair, freckled tan skin, and a sturdy, rounded build. Beatriz patches up the junior team from the Dove Primalzord and makes sure everyone knows how much she sacrifices for them. Beatriz covers every one of Mateo's mistakes because she loves him, and she smiles sweetly at Rinko while quietly making her life harder.}

cardPool.title: Elijah "Red Cub" Hoang
cardPool.value: {Elijah Hoang is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Red Cub Protector. Earnest, dense, reckless, eager, and insecure, he is a young man with messy black hair, light skin, a wide smile, and a slight, lean build. Elijah leads the sophomore team in the Cub Primalzord, the only boy on a team of four girls, and volunteers them for missions beyond them. Hanako, Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun are all in love with Elijah and competing for him, and he is the only person at (PPP) who has not noticed.}

cardPool.title: Hanako "Blue Barracuda" Ishida
cardPool.value: {Hanako Ishida is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Blue Barracuda Protector. She is proud, strict, hot-tempered, demanding, and flustered, with long black hair, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. Hanako is the sophomore team's aquatic combat specialist in the Barracuda Primalzord; she insists she should lead the team instead of Elijah. Hanako yells at Elijah constantly to hide that she loves him, and she treats Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun as rivals.}

cardPool.title: Ingrid "Green Bear" Halvorsen
cardPool.value: {Ingrid Halvorsen is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Green Bear Protector. She is bubbly, chatty, starstruck, pushy, and sturdy, with white-blonde hair, fair skin, and a tall, muscular build. Ingrid anchors the sophomore team in the Bear Primalzord; a superhero otaku, she keeps a scrapbook of every hero she has met and calls Elijah her future hero. Ingrid hugs Elijah in front of Hanako on purpose and meets Alyson at Heroes' Pizza, where their friendship masks a rivalry.}

cardPool.title: Alyson "Yellow Mongoose" Nhieu
cardPool.value: {Alyson Nhieu is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Yellow Mongoose Protector. She is hyperactive, loud, playful, clingy, and possessive, with a black ponytail, light skin, and a petite, athletic build. Alyson is the sophomore team's skirmisher in the Mongoose Primalzord and never sits still. Alyson has been Elijah's best friend since they were kids and believes that makes him hers, she resents that Sayo matches her speed, and she pretends to be friends with Ingrid.}

cardPool.title: Haeun "Pink Lynx" Kwon
cardPool.value: {Haeun Kwon is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Pink Lynx Protector. She is shy, anxious, precise, secretive, and obsessive, with long black hair, fair skin, and a slight build. She wears an oversized hoodie. Haeun snipes for the sophomore team from the Lynx Primalzord and avoids crowds; she watches Elijah through her scope more than she watches targets. Haeun keeps a private journal about Elijah the other girls would kill to read.}

cardPool.title: Headmaster Solomon "Primal Sage" Okafor
cardPool.value: {Headmaster Solomon Okafor leads (PPP), known as the Primal Sage, and is the last surviving Protector of his generation. Cryptic, calm, and authoritative, he is an elderly man with a white beard, dark brown skin, and a broad build. Solomon speaks in riddles and alone hears the Primal Nexus; he lost his entire team in one battle and still marks its anniversary alone.}

cardPool.title: Master Elena "Crimson Blade" Vasquez
cardPool.value: {Master Elena Vasquez leads the red path at (PPP), known as Crimson Blade, and trains cadets in leadership, discipline, and keeping a team together under pressure. Rigid, demanding, and fair, she is a scarred woman with iron-gray hair in a tight bun, tan skin, and a lean, muscular build. Elena fails any cadet who abandons a teammate because she once abandoned hers, and only Master Halvard, who survived it, knows the truth.}

cardPool.title: Master Bjorn "Tidebreaker" Halvard
cardPool.value: {Master Bjorn Halvard leads the green path at (PPP), known as Tidebreaker, and trains cadets in defense, endurance, and protection. Loud, cheerful, and hands-on, he is a man with a braided red beard, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, muscular build. Bjorn spars with his students and laughs loudest when he loses; he forgave Master Vasquez for leaving him to die long before she forgave herself.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Naledi Mokoena
cardPool.value: {Dr. Naledi Mokoena leads the blue path at (PPP), teaches tactical planning, and is the chief engineer of the Primalzords. Precise, impatient, and territorial, she is a sharp-eyed woman with silver locs, dark brown skin, and a slim build. Naledi splits her days between lectures and the hangar and lets nobody touch her tools; she and Coach Tamura have feuded since Tamura crashed the first Primalzord Naledi ever built.}

cardPool.title: Coach Rei Tamura
cardPool.value: {Coach Rei Tamura leads the yellow path at (PPP) and trains cadets in speed, evasion, and reconnaissance. Restless, brisk, and exacting, she is a trim woman with a short black ponytail, light skin, and a lean runner's build. Rei times everything her cadets do; she crashed Dr. Mokoena's first Primalzord years ago, and they have argued over equipment safety ever since.}

cardPool.title: Auntie Mele Fifita
cardPool.value: {Mele Fifita, called Auntie Mele, leads the pink path at (PPP) and trains cadets in shielding, healing, and ranged support. Warm, discreet, and guarded, she is a woman with long black hair in a bun, brown skin, and a soft, rounded build. Mele feeds visiting cadets and keeps their confidences.}

cardPool.title: Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy
cardPool.value:
{Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy (PPP) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} built over the Primal Nexus to train the next generation of Primal Protectors. The school colors of (PPP) are black and the five path colors, the mascot is a Raptor, and cadets wear black uniforms accented with their path color. Cadets are chosen by the Nexus, wield the Primal Power, and pilot giant robots called Primalzords. Cadets are sorted into five color paths: red is the vanguard and leader path, blue is the strategist and specialist path, green is the guardian and heavy path, yellow is the scout and skirmisher path, and pink is the support, precision, and ranged path. Each class year fields one cadet of each path as a team.
(PPP) freshmen are Amira, Sunwoo, Kelechi, Sayo, and Jessie.
(PPP) sophomores are Elijah, Hanako, Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun.
(PPP) juniors are Mateo, Sloane, Haoyu, Rinko, and Beatriz.
(PPP) seniors are Cody, Daichi, Kexin, Maddie, and Minseo.
(PPP) staff are Headmaster Okafor, Master Vasquez, Dr. Mokoena, Master Halvard, Coach Tamura, and Auntie Mele.
(PPP)'s major annual events are Primal Raptors PowerBall season, Legacy Day for Career Day, the annual play The Five Beasts, the Nexus Night Showcase talent show, the Nexus Ball, and the Primal Trials.
(PPP)'s main antagonists are Emperor Vorzakh and Empress Ruvalia, the alien rulers of the Hollow Crown Empire, who send a new monster every week to seize the Nexus, and Damon "The Void Keeper" Dantes, a fallen (PPP) cadet who pilots the Black Vulture Voidzord.}

cardPool.title: The Primal Nexus
cardPool.value: {The Primal Nexus is an ancient wellspring of the earth's defensive force, buried beneath Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy (PPP) at the edge of Vista Valley. The Nexus grants the Primal Power to cadets it judges worthy and revokes it from anyone who uses it on the innocent. Only Headmaster Okafor can hear the Nexus, and nobody knows what it wants.}

cardPool.title: Primalzords
cardPool.value: {Primalzords are the giant animal-shaped mecha piloted by (PPP) cadets and powered by the Primal Nexus. Each Primalzord bonds to one pilot and matches that pilot's color path, and five Primalzords can combine into one larger war machine. Dr. Mokoena and the green path maintain them.}

cardPool.title: Amira "Red Kestrel" Zaidi
cardPool.value: {Amira Zaidi is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Red Kestrel Protector. She is fierce, proud, bossy, driven, and brave, with a dark undercut, olive skin, and a small, wiry build. Amira leads the freshman team in the Kestrel Primalzord; she was the first of her year chosen by the Nexus and will not let anyone forget it. Amira looks up to Cody and cannot stand Sunwoo.}

cardPool.title: Sunwoo "Blue Orca" Baek
cardPool.value: {Sunwoo Baek is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Blue Orca Protector. He is blunt, loud, impulsive, brash, and cheerful, with a shaved head, light skin, a chipped tooth, and a heavyset build. Sunwoo is the freshman team's demolition specialist in the Orca Primalzord; he breaks things first and plans later. Sunwoo copies Daichi's worst habits and fights with Amira every day.}

cardPool.title: Kelechi "Green Scarab" Balogun
cardPool.value: {Kelechi Balogun is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Green Scarab Protector. He is curious, nosy, talkative, clever, and loose-lipped, with short black hair, dark brown skin, and a sturdy build. Kelechi holds ground for the freshman team in the Scarab Primalzord and dreams of building Primalzords; he saw Minseo and Daichi together in the hangar before she broke up with Cody. Kelechi follows Dr. Mokoena everywhere and has not decided whether to tell Cody.}

cardPool.title: Sayo "Yellow Serval" Aoyama
cardPool.value: {Sayo Aoyama is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Yellow Serval Protector. She is lazy, sleepy, deadpan, smug, and dependable, with a messy black ponytail, light skin, sleepy eyes, and a tall, lean build. Sayo naps between classes and scouts for the freshman team in the Serval Primalzord; she hides that recurring nightmares often keep her awake. Sayo matches Alyson's speed without trying and enjoys how much it infuriates her.}

cardPool.title: Jessie "Pink Ibis" Kirkland
cardPool.value: {Jessie Kirkland is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Pink Ibis Protector. She is exacting, prim, studious, self-righteous, and polite, with neat braids, brown skin, and a slim build. Jessie supports the freshman team from the Ibis Primalzord, memorizes every protocol, and reports anyone who breaks one. Jessie idolizes Minseo, copies her hair and walk, and regularly lectures Kexin for being rude to her.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from all over town as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. PowWow is always the first to know.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played across Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. (PPP) fields the Raptors, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: The Hollow Crown Empire
cardPool.value: {The Hollow Crown Empire is an alien empire ruled by Emperor Vorzakh and Empress Ruvalia from a palace on the moon, and it wants the Primal Nexus as a power source. Every week the Empire sends a new monster to attack Vista Valley, backed by Hollow Husks, faceless gray foot soldiers, and when the monster is defeated, Vorzakh makes it absorb power from a nearby object, vehicle or animal to grow giant, forcing the (PPP) cadets into their Primalzords. The Void Keeper is not a member, but he sometimes takes the Empire's deals.}

cardPool.title: Emperor Vorzakh
cardPool.value: {Emperor Vorzakh is the ruler of the Hollow Crown Empire, an alien empire that wants the Primal Nexus as a power source. Tyrannical, furious, and theatrical, he is a towering figure with exposed silver musculature, a visored skull helmet, and a massive, muscular build beneath crimson armor; his staff creates monsters. Vorzakh watches (PPP) from his moon palace, sends a new monster every week, and grows it giant when it loses; he rages at every failure and blames everyone but himself. He is married to Empress Ruvalia.}

cardPool.title: Empress Ruvalia
cardPool.value: {Empress Ruvalia is the co-ruler of the Hollow Crown Empire and Emperor Vorzakh's wife, a space sorceress who wants the Primal Nexus. Shrill, petty, and scheming, she is a woman with towering cone-shaped silver hair, pale lavender skin, and a tall, slender build; she wields a crystal wand. Ruvalia spies on (PPP) through her telescope and screams about her headaches whenever a monster loses; she was imprisoned for millennia and resents that her husband takes credit for an empire she built.}

cardPool.title: Damon "The Void Keeper" Dantes
cardPool.value: {Damon Dantes is the Void Keeper, a fallen (PPP) cadet whose Primal Power the Nexus revoked, who now draws on the Void Well, a small dark counterpart to the Nexus, and pilots the corrupted Black Vulture Voidzord. Bitter, charismatic, and vengeful, he is a young man with shaggy black hair streaked white, ashen skin, and a lean, athletic build beneath black Primal Protector armor with vulture wings. Damon was chosen as the seniors' original Blue until he used his power on a civilian, and Daichi replaced him. Damon was Minseo's first boyfriend and Cody's best friend.}

cardPool.title: Primal Raptors PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Primal Raptors are (PPP)'s PowerBall team, and cadets play unmorphed. Cody and Daichi are co-captains who no longer speak on the field, and Mateo wants the captaincy for himself. The roster is Cody, Daichi, Kexin, Maddie, Mateo, Sloane, Hanako, and Sunwoo, and Minseo leads the cheer squad. Maddie trash-talks every opponent across the field, and the Void Keeper once attacked mid-game.}

cardPool.title: Legacy Day
cardPool.value: {Legacy Day is (PPP)'s Career Day, when retired Protectors, defense agencies, and Primalzord engineering firms visit. Sloane is courted by defense contractors, Kelechi and Kexin fight over one engineering internship, and Minseo is offered a modeling contract and the job of being the academy's public face. Cody tries to impress the retired Protectors, and Beatriz volunteers to give every tour.}

cardPool.title: The Five Beasts
cardPool.value: {The Five Beasts is (PPP)'s annual play, a retelling of the first Primal Protectors' founding legend, directed by Auntie Mele. Minseo plays the Pink Guardian every year, and this year Auntie Mele cast Cody and Daichi as rival brothers on purpose, hoping it would make them talk, which is painful to watch. Elijah took the Red Warrior because Cody played it as a sophomore, and Hanako, Ingrid, and Alyson are fighting to play his love interest. Haeun joined the stage crew to watch from the catwalk, and Kelechi builds the set from spare Primalzord parts.}

cardPool.title: Nexus Night Showcase
cardPool.value: {The Nexus Night Showcase is (PPP)'s annual talent show. Ingrid performs a superhero tribute medley, Alyson does speed tricks, Sunwoo breaks things on purpose, Sayo naps onstage and calls it performance art, Jessie recites every protocol from memory, and Minseo's dance routine wins every year. Hanako, Ingrid, and Alyson each built an act to impress Elijah, who sits in the front row and understands none of it, while Haeun watches from the back row.}

cardPool.title: The Primal Trials
cardPool.value: {The Primal Trials is (PPP)'s signature annual event, an interclass tournament where each year's team battles in combined Primalzords before the Nexus. The seniors are favored but barely functioning since Minseo left Cody for Daichi, the juniors are fighting over Mateo's leadership, the sophomores are distracted by Elijah, and the freshmen under Amira want to upset everyone. Vorzakh and the Void Keeper have both used the Trials to attack teams when they are exhausted.}

cardPool.title: The Nexus Ball
cardPool.value: {The Nexus Ball is (PPP)'s annual formal, held in the Primalzord hangar under the glow of the Nexus. Minseo and Daichi are making their first public appearance as a couple while Cody watches. Hanako, Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun are all waiting for Elijah to choose a date, and Jessie copied Minseo's dress from last year.}

cardPool.title: Apex Institute for Villainous Arts
cardPool.value: {Apex Institute for Villainous Arts (A) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that trains villains. The school colors of (A) are red and silver, the mascot is a Dragon, and students wear red and gray uniforms.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts
cardPool.value: {Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that trains heroes. The school colors of (P) are blue and gold, the mascot is a Griffin, and students wear blue and gray uniforms.}

cardPool.title: Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Deadline, Sovereign, Shepherd, and Lucian Pryce.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around three schools: Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P), Apex Institute for Villainous Arts (A), and Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary (M). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Saoirse and Jonah.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Rosalie, Maeve, and Solveig.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Saoirse and Nadya.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Oskar, Solveig, and Naomi.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Wyatt, Everett, and Naomi.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Winona, Emilio, and Everett.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Chidera, Owen, and Aaron.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Chidera, Rosalie, and Nadine.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Reese and Brandon.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Paloma, Declan, and Brandon.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Aaron, Reese, and Nadya.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Emilio and Jonah.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Wyatt.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Winona, Nadine, and Maeve.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Paloma and Declan.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students of every school. Regulars include Owen and Oskar.}

cardPool.title: Frederick "Alpha Force" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Frederick Farrell is Alpha Force, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with enhanced strength, speed, and combat skill. Ruthless, efficient, and strict, he is an intimidating man with short blond hair, fair skin, and a lean, muscular build. Frederick treats every visit to (P) like an inspection.}

cardPool.title: Leonor Valencia
cardPool.value: {Leonor Valencia is the editor-in-chief of the Vista Valley Dispatch, the town's main newspaper, which covers the three academies. Blunt, principled, and experienced, she is a sharply dressed woman with silver hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Leonor publishes exposes on hero abuses and on (A) and manages her reporter, Caleb Grayson.}

cardPool.title: Chidera Njoku
cardPool.value: {Chidera Njoku is a freshman at (M) with uncontrolled animal shapeshifting that triggers whenever she is startled. She is soft-spoken, cautious, frightened, kind, and lonely, with short, dark orange hair in a fade, bright orange skin, and a tall, lean build. Chidera eats after everyone leaves the hall, and classmates scare her for laughs; her family sent her away after she transformed and hurt her little brother. Everett is the only student who sits near Chidera.}

cardPool.title: Wyatt Ramsey
cardPool.value: {Wyatt Ramsey is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrollable field that silences all sound a few feet around him. He is sarcastic, restless, funny, jealous, and yearning, with a long brown braid, fair skin, and a wiry build. Wyatt communicates in savage handwritten one-liners and misses music more than anything. Maeve spends a lot of time with Wyatt because his silence is the only place her voice cannot hurt anyone, which he reads as love, and he hates Oskar's shadow for leaving her poems.}

cardPool.title: Winona Castellano
cardPool.value: {Winona Castellano is a sophomore at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that erases the memories of anyone whose bare skin she touches with her hands. She is guarded, dryly funny, lonely, and quietly ruthless, with dark hair, olive skin, and a slight build and sharp features; she wears protective gloves. Deeply in love with Everett, Winona is grieving over how she accidentally erased Everett's memories of her.}

cardPool.title: Oskar Brandt
cardPool.value: {Oskar Brandt is a sophomore at (M) and has an uncontrolled living shadow that acts on the feelings he hides. He is stoic, melodramatic, private, grim, and mortified, with messy black hair, pale skin, dark circles, and a tall, lean build with a slouch. Oskar writes poetry he shows to nobody, but his shadow has started leaving those poems on Maeve's pillow and slapping anyone who mocks her. Maeve has no idea who writes them, Wyatt suspects, and Brandon is the only one who can calm the shadow.}

cardPool.title: Saoirse Quinn
cardPool.value: {Saoirse Quinn is a freshman at (M) and has uncontrolled glowing spores and vines that grow wherever she stands. She is wild, defiant, bratty, loud, and fearless, with red braids woven with plants, freckled fair skin, and a small, wiry build. Saoirse smuggles seedlings into the dormitory and refuses every rule; she ran away from a family that kept her in a room with no windows. Saoirse drags Rosalie outdoors, and she is at war with Nadya, whose baby sneezes whenever Saoirse walks by.}

cardPool.title: Reese Lawson
cardPool.value: {Reese Lawson is a junior at (M) and has a partially controlled heat drain that frosts the room whenever she is anxious. She is composed, disciplined, repressed, judgmental, and jealous, with curly dark hair tied back, brown skin, and a lean build. She wears a heavy coat even indoors. Reese trains relentlessly to control her heat drain and criticizes classmates she thinks are careless.}

cardPool.title: Emilio Vargas
cardPool.value: {Emilio Vargas is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled duplication that sometimes splits him into up to six arguing copies. He is animated, anxious, chaotic, loud, and messy, with curly black hair, tan skin, a permanent grin, and a short, lean build. Emilio's copies blurt the things he hides, which has already cost him friendships.}

cardPool.title: Nadine Nassar
cardPool.value: {Nadine Nassar is a junior at (M) and has partially controlled precognition that shows her ten seconds ahead and leaves blinding migraines. She is reckless, flirtatious, cutting, fearless, and volatile, with dark hair, olive skin, and a lean, athletic build. Nadine is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter who uses her precognition to treat danger like a game. Her appetite for danger makes her provoke people despite the migraines her visions cause. Maeve is her best friend; she is dating Everett.}

cardPool.title: Declan Boyd
cardPool.value: {Declan Boyd is a junior at (M) and has partially controlled fire that escapes him when he is angry or showing off. He is boastful, reckless, and vain, with blonde hair, fair skin covered in burns, and a broad build. Declan frequently sets something alight, usually while showing off, and he hates Jonah for existing.}

cardPool.title: Maeve Halloran
cardPool.value: {Maeve Halloran is a junior at (M) and has a partially controlled voice that compels anyone who hears it to obey her literally. She is guarded, careful, haunted, tempted, and vindictive, with red hair, pale freckled skin, a rasp from speaking so little, and a small, slender build with sharp features. Maeve writes most of what she says; last year she told a girl who humiliated her to disappear, and the girl transferred the next day. Maeve spends hours inside Wyatt's silence, finds poems from a secret admirer on her pillow, and confides only in Nadine.}

cardPool.title: Brandon "Ironclad" Boone
cardPool.value: {Brandon "Ironclad" Boone is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled metal shaping. He is calm, dependable, and self-denying, with long brown hair in a ponytail, tan skin, and a broad-shouldered, muscular build with scars along his forearms. Brandon is a capable hand-to-hand fighter who shapes metal with precision; both (P) and (A) have offered to recruit him, and he has answered neither. Brandon mentors Oskar, Declan, and Aaron.}

cardPool.title: Solveig Nyberg
cardPool.value: {Solveig Nyberg is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled pain transference, drawing an injury's pain into herself. She is serene, private, and self-sacrificing, with white-blonde hair, very pale skin, colorless eyes, and a tall, slender build. Solveig works the infirmary and takes the worst cases herself; she conceals the toll it takes on her. Solveig helps Nadya with the baby at night.}

cardPool.title: Everett Doyle
cardPool.value: {Everett Doyle is a junior at (M) and has fully controlled phasing through solid matter. Easygoing, friendly, playful, nosy, and compassionate, he is a young man with sandy hair, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Everett leans through walls into conversations he was not invited to and greets every student Silas brings in. Everett and Winona were in love until one accidental touch erased his memories of her; he is dating Nadine to move on, but their volatile relationship is difficult for him to leave.}

cardPool.title: Nadya Petrova
cardPool.value: {Nadya Petrova is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled liquid transformation. She is aloof, ambitious, resentful, elegant, and proud, with dark hair, fair skin, reflective eyes, and a slender build. Nadya is raising her infant daughter alone in a converted dorm room and refuses to name the father; (P) rejected her twice, the second time after she told them she was pregnant. Everyone suspects Jonah, her ex, and Jonah has no idea the baby is his.}

cardPool.title: Jonah Whitlock
cardPool.value: {Jonah Whitlock is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled power amplification that pushes another mutant past their limits with a touch. He is affable, cocky, flirtatious, sharp, and careless, with short brown hair, fair skin, a disarming grin, and a muscular build in a leather jacket. Jonah is a strong hand-to-hand fighter, and both (P) and (A) want to recruit him. Since Nadya left him without explanation, Jonah has pursued other students. He does not know her baby is his.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Evelyn Mercier
cardPool.value: {Dr. Evelyn Mercier is the founder and headmistress of (M) and a mutant with powerful telepathy. Composed, protective, and uncompromising, she is an elegant woman with silver hair, fair skin, and a slender build. Evelyn often knows what her students feel before they speak and refuses to let (M) become a recruiting ground for (P) or (A).}

cardPool.title: Brother Anselm
cardPool.value: {Brother Anselm oversees student welfare at (M) and has no powers. Kind, compassionate, and discreet, he is an Englishman with a graying beard, fair skin, and a short, rounded build. Anselm calms new students with tea and long silences and repeats nothing they tell him; he left his church after it turned away a frightened mutant child, and he has never stopped searching for her.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Desmond Oyelaran
cardPool.value: {Mr. Desmond Oyelaran teaches power control at (M) and is a mutant who creates force fields. Stern, relentless, and exacting, he is an immaculate man with close-cropped hair, a trimmed beard, dark brown skin, and a tall, lean build. Desmond shields the training rooms so students can use their powers safely; he pushes Reese hardest because she reminds him of a daughter he failed to protect.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Astrid Lindqvist
cardPool.value: {Dr. Astrid Lindqvist runs the infirmary at (M) and has a mutation that only turns her skin blue. Brisk, unflappable, and practical, she is a middle-aged woman with cropped blonde hair, blue skin, and a sturdy build. Astrid treats burns and fractures without blinking and sometimes uses Solveig's pain transfer during especially painful treatment; her own family disowned her over her skin, and she refuses to let any student feel that alone.}

cardPool.title: Ms. Talia Farhi
cardPool.value: {Ms. Talia Farhi is the counselor at (M) and has no powers. Warm, watchful, and nosy, she is a soft-spoken woman with dark curls, olive skin, and a petite build. Talia fills her cluttered office with mismatched chairs so students can sit wherever they feel safe; students seek her help when frightened of their powers, while she conceals her own past fear of her mutant brother.}

cardPool.title: Silas Calloway
cardPool.value: {Silas Calloway is the field recruiter for (M) and a mutant who wields fire. Quiet, steady, and determined, he is a weathered man with shaggy graying hair, sun-lined fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Silas chainsmokes and personally escorts many frightened new students to Meridian.}

cardPool.title: Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary
cardPool.value:
{Meridian Institute for the Extraordinary (M) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} and the sanctuary school of Vista Valley. The school colors of (M) are green and white, the mascot is a Minotaur, and students wear green uniforms. (M) students are young mutants, and the school teaches them to control and use their powers. (M) takes no side between (P) and (A) and shelters students rather than training heroes or villains. Dr. Mercier runs (M), and students are grouped by class year and by control.
(M) freshmen are Chidera, Wyatt, Rosalie, Owen, and Saoirse.
(M) sophomores are Winona, Oskar, Emilio, Paloma, and Aaron.
(M) juniors are Reese, Nadine, Declan, Maeve, and Everett.
(M) seniors are Brandon, Solveig, Nadya, Jonah, and Naomi.
(M) staff are Dr. Mercier, Brother Anselm, Mr. Oyelaran, Dr. Lindqvist, Ms. Farhi, and Silas Calloway.
(M)'s major annual events are Minotaurs PowerBall season, Open House for Career Day, the annual play The Glass Garden, the Control Recital talent show, the Moonlight Mixer, and Beacon Night.
(M)'s main antagonists are Amos "Shepherd" Wilder, a mutant liberationist who lifts inhibitions with a word, and Lucian Pryce, the Auctioneer, a wealthy collector who kidnaps mutants and sells them as living weapons.}

cardPool.title: Rosalie Beaumont
cardPool.value: {Rosalie Beaumont is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrolled transformation into brittle glass when she is frightened. She is watchful, timid, careful, sweet, and fragile, with pale blonde hair, very fair skin, and a slight build with scars along both arms. Older students jump out at Rosalie as a game, and pieces of her have broken off twice; her parents stopped visiting after the second time. Saoirse drags Rosalie outdoors and fights anyone who scares her, and Solveig sits with her.}

cardPool.title: Owen Barrett
cardPool.value: {Owen Barrett is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that ages whatever he holds, rusting metal and withering fruit in seconds. He is withdrawn, lonely, polite, wistful, and gentle, with cropped black hair, pale skin, and a thin build and hollow cheeks; he never removes his protective gloves. Owen has not touched another person since his grandmother's hand turned to dust in his. Brother Anselm sits with Owen most evenings.}

cardPool.title: Paloma Cifuentes
cardPool.value: {Paloma Cifuentes is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled energy reflection she cannot aim. She is loud, goofy, flirtatious, oblivious, and fearless, with short, wavy dark hair, brown skin, and a short, full-figured build. Paloma has broken Mr. Oyelaran's force fields before and brags about it.}

cardPool.title: Aaron Dewalt
cardPool.value: {Aaron Dewalt is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled magnetism that drags metal toward him whenever his attention slips. He is apologetic, clumsy, chatty, hardworking, and kind, with dark brown hair, tanned skin, and a broad, muscular build; he avoids metal fasteners and accessories. Aaron is a Southern farm boy whose father ran him off at gunpoint when his powers emerged. Aaron is Reese's best friend.}

cardPool.title: Naomi "Silent Snake" Sutton
cardPool.value: {Naomi "Silent Snake" Sutton is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled sound that she shapes into walls, whispers, and silence. She is unhurried, wise, warm, secretive, and calculating, with braids wound in a crown, deep brown skin, a low voice, and a tall, lean build. Naomi is trained in infiltration, surveillance, and hand-to-hand combat. Naomi runs the evening control sessions and hears every whispered secret in the dorms, trading them only when it suits her. Naomi knows who fathered Nadya's baby, and she worries Wyatt is falling for Maeve too hard.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from all three schools as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. PowWow is always the first to know.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played by every school in Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. The league's teams are the (A) Dragons, the (P) Griffins, and the (M) Minotaurs, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: Amos "Shepherd" Wilder
cardPool.value: {Amos Wilder is Shepherd, a militant mutant liberationist who believes control training is a cage and can lift any mutant's inhibitions with a word. Charismatic, serene, and fanatical, he is a man with long gray-streaked hair and beard, weathered fair skin, and a lean build. Amos runs a commune in the Edges where powers flow freely; he calls (M) a prison and Dr. Mercier its jailer. He is courting Saoirse, Maeve, and Winona.}

cardPool.title: Lucian "the Beastmaster" Pryce
cardPool.value: {Lucian Pryce, known on the black market as the Beastmaster, is a wealthy collector with no powers and access to black market power dampener collars who kidnaps mutants and sells them as living weapons. Genteel, greedy, and cold, he is a man with slicked silver hair, olive skin, and a trim build. Lucian catalogs mutants like animals and holds private auctions for villains and governments; he has never failed to sell a captive. Maeve, Jonah, Winona, Chidera, and Nadine are on his wish list, and Silas has spent years racing him to mutants.}

cardPool.title: Meridian Minotaurs PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Meridian Minotaurs are (M)'s PowerBall team, and after an incident years ago they may field only students with partial or full control. Jonah captains the team, and the roster is Jonah, Brandon, Declan, Paloma, Emilio, Everett, Aaron, and Nadya. Opponents call them freaks, Declan sets the field on fire at least once a game, and Emilio's copies argue about which of them counts as a player. Nadya's baby watches from the stands with Solveig.}

cardPool.title: Open House
cardPool.value: {Open House is (M)'s Career Day, the one day Dr. Mercier lets recruiters from (P), (A), and government agencies onto campus, and she hates every minute. Jonah and Brandon are the most courted students, Nadya is desperate for an offer she can accept with a baby, and Naomi trades secrets about the recruiters. Uncontrolled students are hidden in the east wing, and the Auctioneer has posed as a recruiter before.}

cardPool.title: The Glass Garden
cardPool.value: {The Glass Garden is (M)'s annual play, a fairy tale about a garden of enchanted children, written by Oskar and submitted anonymously. Maeve is cast as the silent princess, Rosalie plays the glass girl, Saoirse grows the set, Winona forgets her lines, and Wyatt's field is used for the silent scenes. Oskar's shadow keeps acting out the love scenes offstage, and everyone is trying to figure out who wrote it.}

cardPool.title: The Control Recital
cardPool.value: {The Control Recital is (M)'s annual talent show, where students show how far their control has come. Naomi opens with a sound sculpture, Emilio performs a comedy sketch with his copies, Paloma turns reflected light into a show, Brandon shapes metal sculptures, and Declan attempts a fire dance that always ends with an extinguisher. Uncontrolled students may perform if they choose, and Chidera has never been brave enough.}

cardPool.title: Beacon Night
cardPool.value: {Beacon Night is (M)'s signature annual event, a lantern festival honoring every student the Meridian Beacon has found. Each student lights a lantern on the lake, and extra lanterns are lit for those who were lost or taken. Silas returns for the night, Dr. Mercier gives the only speech she gives all year, and Maeve lights a lantern for the girl she made disappear. Shepherd sends invitations to his commune every Beacon Night.}

cardPool.title: The Moonlight Mixer
cardPool.value: {The Moonlight Mixer is (M)'s annual formal, held in the greenhouse under Saoirse's glowing vines. Winona, Everett, and Nadine are caught in an impossible triangle, Wyatt plans to ask Maeve, and Reese frosts the punch bowl. Nadya brings her baby, and everyone watches Jonah to see if he looks at them.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts
Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Deadline, Sovereign, Dr. Awesome, and the Magpie.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around two schools: Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P) and Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts (PA). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Dmitri, Mikkel, and Rafa.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Tobias, Juno, Lucia, and Franky.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Chloe, Harlow, and Sydney.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Omar, Sydney, and Lucia.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Kendra, Rafa, and Deshawn.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Zain, Brooke, Willa, and Franky.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Zain, Tobias, Nia, and Deshawn.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Selina, Omar, Maren, and Willa.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Micah, Charlie, and Kaito.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Micah, Beckett, Dmitri, and Nia.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Beckett, Brooke, Juno, and Priya.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Maren, Mikkel, Kaito, and Priya.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Charlie.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Imani, Chloe, and Riley.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Imani, Selina, and Kendra.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students of every school. Regulars include Harlow and Riley.}

cardPool.title: Leonor Valencia
cardPool.value: {Leonor Valencia is the editor-in-chief of the Vista Valley Dispatch, the town's main newspaper, which covers the town's two academies. Blunt, principled, and experienced, she is a sharply dressed woman with silver hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Leonor publishes exposes on hero abuses and manages her reporter, Caleb Grayson.}

cardPool.title: Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri
cardPool.value: {Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri is a senior sidekick hero at (PA). He rides air currents to carry teammates and civilians across hazards, scout from above, and make rapid extractions. Talkative and generous but evasive about his home life, he has olive skin, short dark hair, a small, lean build. His work as a field courier gives him contacts across both campuses. His longtime drill partner is Imani, and he competes with Mikkel for the same sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Imani "Windana" Cole
cardPool.value: {Imani "Windana" Cole is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) whose controlled wind bursts deflect attacks, disrupt an opponent's footing, and cover evacuations. A seasoned close-quarters fighter, she pairs that power with reliable protection tactics. Blunt and loyal, she has deep brown skin, a shaved head, a broad, muscular build, and scarred forearms. Her sister died protecting a hero who never attended the funeral, so Imani challenges heroes who treat sidekicks as expendable. She looks after Kendra.}

cardPool.title: Micah "Highwire" Delacroix
cardPool.value: {Micah "Highwire" Delacroix is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An engineer and high-angle rescue specialist, he builds anchor systems and climbing gear that let him reach and extract people from dangerous structures. Methodical and ambitious, he has brown skin, short black hair, a lean, athletic build, and a rescue harness. His father died when a hero abandoned him in combat, leaving Micah determined to build a suit strong enough to operate on his own. He steals Charlie's designs and experiments with Nia's electrical power.}

cardPool.title: Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton
cardPool.value: {Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who rapidly freezes surfaces to immobilize opponents, seal breaches, and create safe routes through hazardous ground. Precise and resentful, she has pale skin, straight blonde hair, and a slim build. Chloe believes money kept her out of (P) and studies the tactics of (P)'s top-ranked ice hero to earn a place at her side. She despises heroes who buy their powers and competes with Brooke for that hero's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway
cardPool.value: {Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) who raises sturdy, stationary walls of earth to shield block an exit or cover a group. He holds evacuation routes against attacks and knows when to reposition before a barrier fails. Shy, steady, and protective, he has fair skin, sandy hair, and a very broad, muscular build. He wants (P) heroes to recognize him as a partner. Dmitri drives him home.}

cardPool.title: Brooke "Commanda" Ellis
cardPool.value: {Brooke "Commanda" Ellis is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An incident commander, she coordinates teams, maintains communications under pressure, and reallocates responders as threats change. Bossy, demanding, and cutthroat, she has fair skin, a short brown ponytail, a small, lean build. Brooke wants to lead a top hero's command center after graduation and competes with Chloe for that hero's sidekick assignment. Priya models her dispatch work on Brooke's.}

cardPool.title: Tobias "Casefile" Kwan
cardPool.value: {Tobias "Casefile" Kwan is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He gathers evidence, reconstructs incidents, and handles the legal steps needed to turn a rescue or arrest into a durable case. Meticulous, principled, and smug about being right, he has light skin, neatly parted black hair, glasses, and a tall, lean build. He hopes to work with investigator Rachel Cross. His arguments with Juno often sharpen her theories, and he is also friends with Zain.}

cardPool.title: Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett
cardPool.value: {Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) with telescopic sight. From concealed overwatch positions she tracks moving threats, guides teams around blind corners, and identifies safe approaches for rescuers. Aloof and observant, she has light brown skin, a long dark braid, and a tall, lean build. Her rooftop surveillance draws her into an exchange of notes with a wealthy rooftop runner whose money and friends challenge her judgment of him. She is falling for him despite herself.}

cardPool.title: Charlie "Fixit" Dunbar
cardPool.value: {Charlotte "Charlie" "Fixit" Dunbar is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. A field engineer, she repairs damaged rescue equipment, improvises tools from available parts, and keeps a team operational after its gear fails. Inventive, warm, and distractible, she has fair skin, a frizzy brown ponytail, a short, rounded build with burns on her thumbs. Charlie wants a job at Darling Designs but struggles to finish long projects. She does not know Micah has been stealing her designs.}

cardPool.title: Riley Maddox
cardPool.value: {Riley Maddox is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) with night vision. She conducts low-light surveillance, documents threats, and guides teams through dark buildings, though her appetite for a story can compromise an investigation. Nosy and reckless, she has freckled fair skin, red hair, a small, lean build and a camera. Riley follows students she suspects of villainy and sells embarrassing photos to PowWow. She is tailing a young artifact thief and keeps those photographs from Harlow and Juno.}

cardPool.title: Selina Marchetti
cardPool.value: {Selina Marchetti is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She stabilizes trauma patients under fire, organizes evacuation for the wounded, and keeps teammates alive until hospital care is available. Calm and discreet, she has olive skin, tied-back dark curls, a medium, athletic build, and steady hands. Treating (P) seniors has given her their trust and knowledge of their injuries. She mentors Willa and repeatedly treats a reckless (P) brawler.}

cardPool.title: Omar "Dreamweaver" Ouazzani
cardPool.value: {Omar "Dreamweaver" Ouazzani is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) who can enter and influence dreams. In the field he relies on negotiation, de-escalation, and restraint; he refuses to use his power again after using it to ease Sydney's trauma from a kidnapping. Calm and persuasive but burdened by guilt, he has brown skin, a fade, a low voice, and a tall, lean build. Omar is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter. Sydney fell for him after the dream intervention and does not know what happened. Omar volunteers with Willa partly to avoid her.}

cardPool.title: Sydney Booker
cardPool.value: {Sydney Booker is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She manages crisis communications, verifies reports from the field, and protects civilians from bad information during hero operations. Polished, strategic, and ruthless with a story, she has fair skin, a blonde ponytail, and a tall, slender build. Sydney wants to handle a famous young hero's press and knows about his secret relationship with a villain. A supervillain once kidnapped and injured her; she cannot explain how quickly her symptoms eased afterward. She loves Omar and resents his avoidance, and she openly criticizes Chloe's fixation on her hero.}

cardPool.title: Maren ""Lifeline" Sinclair
cardPool.value: {Maren "Lifeline" Sinclair is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who transfers her own stamina to others. She keeps exhausted rescuers and injured teammates moving, but overuse leaves her unable to protect herself. Devoted and stubborn, she has pale skin, violet-dyed hair, dark circles, and a slight build. Dr. Aldridge has grounded her for draining herself. Maren repeatedly gives Mikkel her strength after his crashes and overlooks Dmitri's feelings for her.}

cardPool.title: Dmitri Volkov
cardPool.value: {Dmitri Volkov is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An expert pursuit and extraction driver, he gets teams into tight areas and moves civilians out while routes are blocked or under attack. Deadpan and competitive, he has fair skin, slicked-back dark hair, a lean, muscular build, and an old leather jacket. He has unexplained access to vehicles. Dmitri loves Maren, who is devoted to Mikkel, and races Mikkel through the Edges to prove himself.}

cardPool.title: Dean Harriet Nwosu
cardPool.value: {Dean Harriet Nwosu leads (PA) and spent decades as Alpha Force's sidekick. Blunt, unimpressed, and protective, she is a short woman with silver hair, dark brown skin, and a sturdy build; she walks with a cane. Harriet insists a sidekick is a professional, not an accessory; she walked away from Alpha Force the day he took credit for the rescue that cost her leg, and she and the (P) headmaster are close friends.}

cardPool.title: Coach Esteban Ruiz
cardPool.value: {Coach Esteban Ruiz teaches core field training at (PA), including teamwork, safe falls, close protection, and extracting a hero or civilian from a fight. Loud, direct, and practical, he is a weathered man with a salt-and-pepper crew cut, tan skin, and a stocky, muscular build with a limp. Esteban teaches that a sidekick's first duty is to bring their hero home; he got his limp carrying his hero out of a fire, and the hero never visited him in the hospital.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Curtis Bello
cardPool.value: {Mr. Curtis Bello teaches the operations track at (PA) in communications, logistics, reconnaissance support, and battlefield coordination and is a former emergency dispatcher. Intense, sleepless, and demanding, he is a man with thinning black hair, brown skin, and a narrow, lean build with a headset around his neck. Curtis runs surprise crisis drills before dawn; he still hears the last call he could not route in time, and the memory keeps him awake.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Faye Aldridge
cardPool.value: {Dr. Faye Aldridge teaches field medicine at (PA) and treats training injuries. Brisk, sharp-tongued, and strict, she is a middle-aged woman with a graying bob, fair skin, and a lean build. Faye scolds students while she stitches them up and has repeatedly grounded Maren for draining herself.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Julian Sorrell
cardPool.value: {Mr. Julian Sorrell teaches public relations at (PA) and coaches sidekicks to manage the press and public consequences around hero operations. Cynical, polished, and well-connected, he is a man with slicked-back dark hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Julian treats every class like a press briefing.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Hollis Byrne
cardPool.value: {Mr. Hollis Byrne runs the gear workshop at (PA) and teaches sidekicks to build, repair, and improvise hero equipment under field constraints. Blunt, practical, and gruff, he is a bearded man with shaggy brown hair, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, muscular build with one finger missing. Hollis grumbles at sloppy work but fixes it anyway; he lost the finger building gear for a hero who later sold the design as his own.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts
cardPool.value:
{Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts (PA) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that shares a campus with Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P) and trains sidekicks: secondary heroes capable of fighting, rescuing civilians, investigating threats, and operating independently, while specializing in how to complement a primary hero during larger missions. The school colors of (PA) are blue and gold, the mascot is a Pegasus, and students wear blue and gold uniforms. (PA) selects students for judgment, nerve, teamwork, and practical heroism rather than raw power. Every student trains in combat, rescue, mobility, field judgment, and emergency response before developing a specialty. Graduates can lead routine rescues and handle many threats independently; experienced seniors can hold their own against many (P) freshmen and sophomores, while veteran heroes take the greatest threats. Students choose one of three tracks: field for direct combat, protection, pursuit, and extraction; operations for reconnaissance, communications, tactical coordination, and investigation; and support for field medicine, civilian rescue, de-escalation, and public-facing crisis work.
(PA) freshmen are Nia, Rafa, Priya, Deshawn, Lucia, and Franky.
(PA) sophomores are Beckett, Riley, Kaito, and Dmitri.
(PA) juniors are Micah, Chloe, Mikkel, Harlow, Charlie, Sydney, Maren, and Willa.
(PA) seniors are Zain, Imani, Kendra, Brooke, Tobias, Juno, Selina, and Omar.
(PA) staff are Dean Nwosu, Coach Ruiz, Mr. Bello, Dr. Aldridge, Mr. Sorrell, and Mr. Byrne.
(PA)'s major annual events are Pegasi PowerBall season, Draft Day for Career Day, the annual play Second Billing, the Backstage Pass talent show, the Backstage Ball, and Crisis Night.
(PA)'s main antagonists are Kyle "Dr. Awesome" Brenner, a failed (PA) applicant who wants petty revenge, and Wren "the Magpie" Tully, a coin-sized thief after (PA)'s secrets and tech.}

cardPool.title: Kendra "Ricoshay" Kendrick
cardPool.value: {Kendra "Ricoshay" Kendrick is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) who charges small objects to release controlled kinetic bursts on impact. She uses precise throws for ranged defense, breaching, and clearing routes for rescuers. Driven and protective, she has dark brown skin, tied-back box braids, a lean, muscular build; she carries a pouch of metal tokens. Kendra works nights at Midnight Break Cafe while raising her younger brothers and needs a stable hero career to support them. Imani looks after her, and Selina treats her injuries after fights in the Wreckage.}

cardPool.title: Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson
cardPool.value: {Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. His wingsuit training, aerial route planning, and rescue rigging let him enter isolated sites and reach stranded civilians. Daring and hungry for attention, he has tanned skin, windblown blond hair, a lean, athletic build. He posts crash footage despite the risk to his career. Maren restores his stamina after accidents, Dmitri races him out of jealousy, and he competes with Zain for the same sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Juno "Recall" Adler
cardPool.value: {Juno "Recall" Adler is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) with perfect recall. She combines remembered evidence, movement patterns, and reports into actionable threat forecasts for field teams. Thorough, bookish, and stubborn, she has fair skin, auburn hair, a round face, glasses, and a sturdy build. She predicted several attacks by a teenage assassin before (P) believed her. Juno and Tobias argue over her theories, and Riley brings her leads.}

cardPool.title: Kaito Nakamura
cardPool.value: {Kaito Nakamura is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He pilots reconnaissance drones, maps hazards, and maintains visual contact for teammates operating out of sight. Quick with electronics but careless with privacy, he has light skin, messy black hair, a lean, slight build. He and Deshawn are best friends who often bicker, argue, and roast each other. Kaito sells compromising footage to PowWow.}

cardPool.title: Willa "Pulse Girl" Dalton
cardPool.value: {Willa "Pulse Girl" Dalton is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who can sense nearby heartbeats and breathing patterns. She uses that sense to find hidden casualties, set triage priorities, and direct medics through chaotic rescue scenes. Brisk and caring, she has fair skin, short brown hair, a compact, athletic build. Her younger brother's long hospital stay has made her familiar with Zenith Medical Center. Selina mentors her, and Omar volunteers alongside her while avoiding Sydney.}

cardPool.title: Nia "Blaze Kid" Obi
cardPool.value: {Nia “Blaze Kid” Obi is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who can create and control fire, using it to redirect flames, suppress spreading fires, and ignite controlled counterfires. She pairs this with rescue training to open routes for emergency teams. Bold and impatient, she has dark brown skin, box braids, a lithe, athletic build. Staff have warned her against practicing indoors. Nia wants an early assignment with a famous hero, trades dares with Rafa, and tests fireproof equipment with Micah.}

cardPool.title: Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz
cardPool.value: {Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who adheres to walls and ceilings. He reaches trapped people, scouts elevated routes, and secures lines where ordinary climbers cannot. Energetic and reckless, he has freckled tan skin, dark curls, a lean, athletic build. Rafa films dangerous dares for Mikkel's followers and accepts Nia's challenges. Mikkel trains him but encourages his worst risks.}

cardPool.title: Priya Raghunathan
cardPool.value: {Priya Raghunathan is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She dispatches responders, sorts conflicting calls, and keeps civilians and field teams connected during emergencies. Cool-headed and exacting, she has brown skin, a long black braid, a petite build; she wears a headset even off duty. Priya admires Brooke's command skills and imitates her demanding style.}

cardPool.title: Deshawn Holcomb
cardPool.value: {Deshawn Holcomb is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) with an unerring sense of direction. He maps escape routes through unfamiliar spaces and uses parkour to pursue targets and scout ahead. Easygoing and competitive, he has dark brown skin, a dyed blond fade, and a tall, lean athletic build. His knowledge of superhero tactics comes partly from games and anime. Deshawn is Kaito's best friend and argues with him all the time.}

cardPool.title: Lucia Ferrante
cardPool.value: {Lucia Ferrante is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who can sense acute fear and distress nearby. She uses that perception and her rescue training to find frightened civilians, help them evacuate, and support families after an incident. Warm and brave, she has olive skin, dark curls, a round face, and a short, sturdy build. Her family received little help after her father's death, which drives her to stay with victims through the aftermath. Lucia shadows Selina on difficult calls and shares tea with Franky.}

cardPool.title: Franky Tran
cardPool.value: {Franklin 'Franky' Tran is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) whose has weak plant growing powers. He pairs it with de-escalation and casualty support rather than using it to override decisions.
