Gentle and observant, Franky has light skin, short black hair, feminine face and a lean, androgynous build. He studies under Dr. Aldridge and shares tea with Lucia.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from both schools as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. Kaito and Riley of (PA) sell it footage, and PowWow is always the first to know.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played by both schools in Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. The league's teams include the (P) Griffins and the (PA) Pegasi, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: Kyle "Dr. Awesome" Brenner
cardPool.value: {Kyle Brenner is Dr. Awesome, a failed (PA) applicant turned villain. Brilliant, vindictive, and arrogant, he is a young man with bleached spiky hair, pale skin, and a narrow, lean build inside bulky power armor. Kyle crashes (PA) drills and events to humiliate students and prove he never needed them; admissions rejected him for his disregard for others’ safety, but he believes they doubted his intelligence. Kyle targets Micah, whom he sees as himself.}

cardPool.title: Wren "the Magpie" Tully
cardPool.value: {Wren Tully is the Magpie, a small-time but persistent villain who can shrink to the size of a coin. Crafty, greedy, and relentless, she is a woman with a messy black-and-white pixie cut, fair skin, and a small, lean build with mechanical wings. Wren breaks into (PA) to steal hero technology and sells it to the highest bidder. Wren steals Charlie's designs more than anyone's, since Charlie always leaves them unlocked and unattended, and Mr. Byrne has sworn to catch her.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Aux Pegasi PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Paragon Aux Pegasi are (PA)'s PowerBall team, a team that combines coordinated powers, protection, and field tactics. Imani captains the team, and the roster is Imani, Zain, Mikkel, Kendra, Dmitri, Beckett, Rafa, and Nia, with Selina as team medic. Brooke coordinates plays from the sidelines. The Pegasi's annual game against the (P) Griffins, who share their campus, is a grudge match.}

cardPool.title: Draft Day
cardPool.value: {Draft Day is (PA)'s Career Day, when (PA) trainees and prospective hero partners negotiate field assignments. Chloe and Brooke are fighting over one top hero, Zain and Mikkel over another, Nia wants an early assignment with a famous hero, and Sydney is angling to run a star's press. Micah rejects a permanent hero partnership, Kendra needs a paid placement to keep her brothers fed, and PowWow reports the most public rejections by morning. Dr. Awesome crashes Draft Day every year to disrupt the placements he was denied.}

cardPool.title: Second Billing
cardPool.value: {Second Billing is (PA)'s annual play, a comedy about a sidekick who saves the day while her hero takes the credit, written and produced by Sydney. Mikkel stars, Maren plays his love interest, and Juno and Tobias play bickering villains. Riley films everything, and (PA) students run both their own play and (P)'s musical, Skyward!, in the same week, so the tech crew threatens to strike every year.}

cardPool.title: Backstage Pass
cardPool.value: {Backstage Pass is (PA)'s annual talent show, held in the (P) auditorium after hours. Kaito runs a drone light show, Mikkel and Rafa perform stunts that end in the infirmary, Zain rides air currents over the crowd, Kendra ricochets charged discs around the auditorium, and Beckett is talked into singing every year. Charlie builds the stage and finishes it an hour late, and Dr. Awesome hacked the sound system last year.}

cardPool.title: Crisis Night
cardPool.value: {Crisis Night is (PA)'s signature annual event, an unannounced citywide overnight drill that Mr. Bello starts before dawn. Brooke commands operations, Priya runs dispatch, Selina and Willa run triage, Dmitri drives extraction, and Harlow and Kaito run overwatch. The winning team gets priority when negotiating Draft Day placements, Dr. Awesome always tries to sabotage it, and the Magpie uses the chaos to rob the gear workshop.}

cardPool.title: The Backstage Ball
cardPool.value: {The Backstage Ball is (PA)'s annual formal, thrown the same night as (P)'s Griffin Ball after (PA) students were uninvited. Sydney runs it like a press event, and Dmitri watches Maren wait for Mikkel. Harlow is secretly bringing her rooftop pen pal. Every year a few (P) students sneak over because the Backstage Ball is more fun.}

cardPool.title: Supervillains
cardPool.value: {Supervillains and major antagonists active around Vista Valley include Malakar, Thanatos, Savage Mandible, the Acatsuki, Queen Tiara, Mr. Tycoon, Vaquero, Deadline, Sovereign, Vitruvian, and Zulu-Zero.}

cardPool.title: Vista Valley
cardPool.value: {Vista Valley is a small town built around Bastion Tactical Academy (B). Hero and villain battles are frequent, and pro heroes and supervillains visit often. The districts of Vista Valley are the Civic Center District, the Historic Downtown Core, The Heights, the Riverside Arts District, the College Town District, The Commons, the Market District, the Medical Quarter, the Innovation District, the Industrial Park, and the Edges.}

cardPool.title: The Edges
cardPool.value: {The Edges are the outskirts of Vista Valley, full of shuttered factories, decaying buildings, low-income housing, homeless encampments, and open crime. Landmarks include The Wreckage, a set of abandoned buildings, and The Underground, a network of maintenance tunnels. Regulars include Jackson, Imogen, and Margot.}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Cordelia, Anjali, and Wendell.}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Vesper, Anjali, and Augusta.}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Vesper, Enzo, and Margot.}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Ratna, Colton, and Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Noor, Augusta, and Dakota.}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Wendell, Otis, Ramiro, and Gabriel.}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Blake, Tunde, and Yuki.}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Imogen, Otis, and Sana.}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Dagny, Jackson, Tunde, and Leonid.}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Cordelia, Sana, Dakota, and Vlad.}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Dagny, Bryce, and Hugo.}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Bryce and Yuki.}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Enzo, Vlad, and Gabriel.}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Ratna, Hugo, and Blake.}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students. Regulars include Colton, Noor, and Leonid.}

cardPool.title: Police Chief Hal Redding
cardPool.value: {Hal Redding is the police chief of the Vista Valley Police Department. Image-conscious, political, and ambitious, he is a man in his late fifties with slicked gray hair, fair skin, and a lean build. Hal holds press conferences more often than briefings and shelves difficult cases; one of those cases was the death of Margot Ellery's mother, and he knows exactly why he buried it.}

cardPool.title: Dagny "Steel-Six" Holt
cardPool.value: {Dagny "Steel-Six" Holt is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in hand-to-hand combat and melee weapons. Combative, direct, prideful, protective, and impulsive, she has an ash-blonde crew cut, fair skin, a tall, broad, muscular build, and a crooked nose. She seeks fights with powered students because one put her younger brother in the hospital; she has beaten several. Dagny spars with Ratna each morning and has never lost. She does not realize Ratna loves her.}

cardPool.title: Jackson "Hotel-Hard" Whitmore
cardPool.value: {Jackson "Hotel-Hard" Whitmore is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in breaching, demolitions, and close-quarters fighting. Methodical, stoic, conscientious, judgmental, and loyal, he has a close-cropped buzz cut, dark brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. He accounts for every round he fires after once losing track of one. Otis, his closest friend, builds his charges; Jackson walks the Edges with Margot and defends her from Victor-Viper's clique.}

cardPool.title: Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in intelligence and threat analysis. Observant, ambitious, resentful, strategic, and insecure, he has a dark curly taper fade, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He studies how powered heroes and villains fight and keeps an especially detailed file on his twin sister Blake. Bryce resents Blake for winning the recon slot he trained for and plays BattleForce with Yuki.}

cardPool.title: Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt
cardPool.value: {Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth, infiltration, and escape. Taciturn, audacious, independent, curious, and exacting, she has a black tapered pixie cut, pale skin, and a lithe, athletic build. She slipped into a villain stronghold after dark, and a young assassin caught her and let her go. Vesper tests Noor's counter-surveillance skills, though Noor has caught her twice.}

cardPool.title: Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe
cardPool.value: {Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in electronic surveillance and signals intelligence. Skeptical, resourceful, impatient, vigilant, and loyal, she wears her dark hair in a low braided bun beneath a neatly secured headscarf; she has light brown skin and a lean, wiry build. She avoids networked devices and plants listening devices around (B), including Victor-Viper's common room. A rogue AI sends messages to every screen near her. Imogen trusts Sana more than anyone.}

cardPool.title: Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in field medicine and reconnaissance. Charismatic, calm, competitive, generous, and vain, she has dark curls in a close tapered pixie cut, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. She has carried injured cadets off the obstacle course and enjoys the attention afterward. Blake won the recon slot her twin brother Bryce wanted.}

cardPool.title: Cordelia "Victor-Viper" Colby
cardPool.value: {Cordelia "Victor-Viper" Colby is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in investigation, interrogation, and fencing. Brilliant, elitist, exacting, manipulative, and vindictive, she wears dark hair in a tight low bun and has fair skin and a lean, athletic build. A trust-fund heiress and former youth Olympic fencer, she leads a clique of wealthy cadets that includes Augusta and Colton. Cordelia stole credit for a case from her former best friend Margot, whom the clique now torments along with Noor.}

cardPool.title: Enzo "Charlie-Crow" Carrillo
cardPool.value: {Enzo "Charlie-Crow" Carrillo is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in tracking and surveillance. Personable, opportunistic, perceptive, cynical, and patient, he has dark hair in a short scissor-cut taper, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. Enzo can find people who do not want to be found and sells that skill to almost anyone; he refuses to search for the father who left him. He works from the Super Grind, trades leads with Wendell, and lets Gabriel study at his table.}

cardPool.title: Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair
cardPool.value: {Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in cyber investigation and criminal-network analysis. Tenacious, discreet, analytical, conflicted, and compassionate, she has black hair in a neat single braid pinned above her collar, brown skin, and a small, lean athletic build. Anjali traces shell-company payments and is building a case against Von Vortex Industries. The company's heir was her childhood best friend; despite what the case may do to her friend, Anjali still answers her late-night messages.}

cardPool.title: Otis "Bravo-Blade" Grady
cardPool.value: {Otis "Bravo-Blade" Grady is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in combat engineering and demolitions. Inventive, pragmatic, gruff, principled, and generous, he has a brown regulation crew cut, fair skin, and a broad, muscular build marked by burns. He builds the grapples, smoke charges, and armor used across (B)'s divisions and refuses to prioritize Victor-Viper's clique for money. Otis supplies charges to his closest friend Jackson and mentors Yuki and Tunde.}

cardPool.title: Sana "Raven-Two" Qureshi
cardPool.value: {Sana "Raven-Two" Qureshi is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in digital surveillance and data recovery. Quiet, meticulous, secretive, courageous, and anxious, she has a dark jaw-length bob tucked securely behind her ears, brown skin, and a slight, athletic build. Sana keeps backups of (B)'s records, including a file about the Nightwarden she was ordered to destroy. She trades data with Imogen but has not told even her what the file contains.}

cardPool.title: Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov
cardPool.value: {Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in trap engineering and countermeasures. Inventive, skittish, vindictive, loyal, and impulsive, he has a brown short back-and-sides cut, pale skin, and a lean, narrow build. He rigs traps for the engineering division and sabotages Victor-Viper's clique's footlockers in retaliation for their treatment of Noor. Leonid explores the Underground with Colton and Noor.}

cardPool.title: Augusta "Midnight-One" Kline
cardPool.value: {Augusta "Midnight-One" Kline is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in command and tactical planning. Imperious, disciplined, calculating, entitled, and wary, she has blonde hair in a tight French braid pinned above her collar, fair skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. A trust-fund heiress and (B)'s ranking cadet officer, she helped found Victor-Viper's clique with Cordelia and Colton. Her second, Vlad, loves her; Augusta trusts Dakota more than Vlad to challenge a flawed plan.}

cardPool.title: Ramiro "Lone-Three" Salas
cardPool.value: {Ramiro "Lone-Three" Salas is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in security and counter-infiltration. Dutiful, exacting, self-righteous, lonely, and steadfast, he has a black low taper fade, tan skin, and a sturdy, athletic build. He reports every rule breach, including one that got his only friend, Colton's former training partner, expelled. Colton has never forgiven him. Gabriel manages the freshman duty roster for Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: Dakota "Strike-Seven" Pruitt
cardPool.value: {Dakota "Strike-Seven" Pruitt is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in battlefield tactics and squad coordination. Composed, decisive, adaptable, showy, and competitive, he has tanned skin, a freckled face, clean cut short brown hair, and a broad-shouldered, athletic build. Dakota revises failing plans under pressure and makes sure his contribution is recognized. Augusta trusts him to challenge her tactics, which stings Vlad, who wants Augusta's trust.}

cardPool.title: Bastion Tactical Academy
cardPool.value:
{Bastion Tactical Academy (B) is a private ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} on a fortified campus at the edge of Vista Valley that trains heroes with no powers, and the Nightwarden founded, funds, and chairs it. The school colors of (B) are gray and black, the mascot is a Gargoyle, and cadets wear gray military prep uniforms. Cadets rise before dawn and train in tactics, forensics, marksmanship, and engineering. (B) teaches that preparation beats power, holds powered heroes in contempt, and studies villains as a live threat. Cadets are assigned to five divisions: strike, recon, investigation, engineering, and command.
(B) freshmen are Hugo, Noor, Wendell, Yuki, and Gabriel.
(B) sophomores are Bryce, Blake, Anjali, Leonid, Dakota, and Vlad.
(B) juniors are Jackson, Imogen, Colton, Enzo, Sana, Tunde, and Ramiro.
(B) seniors are Dagny, Ratna, Vesper, Cordelia, Margot, Otis, and Augusta.
(B) staff are Headmaster Thorne, Dean Hargrave, Coach Halliwell, Instructor Moss, Instructor Ocampo, Dr. Kalmar, and Ms. Lindholm.
(B)'s major annual events are Gargoyles PowerBall season, Placement Day for Career Day, the annual play Hold the Line, Skills Night, the Commandant's Ball, and the Crucible.
(B)'s main antagonists are Corvin "Vitruvian" Thackery, the Nightwarden's oldest enemy and a genius trap-builder, and Nolan "Zulu-Zero" Sterling, a former (B) honor cadet who sells the academy's doctrine to villains.}

cardPool.title: Headmaster Ambrose Thorne
cardPool.value: {Headmaster Ambrose Thorne runs (B) and has no powers. Strict, formal, and uncompromising, he is a man with silver hair, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Ambrose expels cadets who fall below standard and answers to the Nightwarden; they grew up as brothers in all but blood.}

cardPool.title: Dean Ophelia Hargrave
cardPool.value: {Dean Ophelia Hargrave oversees discipline and conduct at (B) and has no powers. Severe, precise, and unrelenting, she is a woman with a gray bob, pale skin, and a slim, upright build. Ophelia inspects uniforms, rooms, and attitudes without warning and rarely lets a demerit slide; she once gave a troubled cadet too many chances and still blames herself for what he became.}

cardPool.title: Coach Duke Halliwell
cardPool.value: {Coach Duke Halliwell runs conditioning and hand-to-hand training at (B) and has no powers. Harsh, loud, and demanding, he is a man with a gray flattop, weathered tan skin, a very broad, muscular build, and a gravelly voice. Duke runs cadets into the ground; he left a squadmate behind on the mission that cost the man his limbs, and he has been trying to outrun that choice ever since.}

cardPool.title: Instructor Cyprian Moss
cardPool.value: {Instructor Cyprian Moss teaches investigation and forensics at (B) and has no powers. Dry, sharp, and withholding, he is an older man with thinning white hair, pale skin, and a narrow, stooped build. Cyprian answers questions with harder questions; he withholds praise because success once made him arrogant, and he watches Cordelia’s feud with Margot without taking sides.}

cardPool.title: Instructor Inez Ocampo
cardPool.value: {Instructor Inez Ocampo teaches marksmanship, infiltration, and reconnaissance at (B), has no powers, and can remain motionless for hours. Unsmiling, stoic, and exacting, she is a weathered woman with a black braid, tan skin, and a lean, wiry build with a scar on one forearm. Inez grades a cadet on whether anyone knew they were there; the scar came from a failed infiltration that also cost her a partner.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Boris Kalmar
cardPool.value: {Dr. Boris Kalmar teaches combat trauma and interrogation resistance at (B) and has no powers. Clinical, unnerving, and eerily calm, he is a man with short gray hair, pale skin, and a slight build. Boris runs relentless interrogation-resistance and mental-defense drills; he keeps the secret that could end the career of a former black-site colleague who now counsels students.}

cardPool.title: Ms. Greta Lindholm
cardPool.value: {Ms. Greta Lindholm runs the armory and equipment room at (B) and has no powers. Blunt, territorial, and thorough, she is a woman with iron-gray hair, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, sturdy build. Greta tracks every piece of equipment a cadet carries; the one item she cannot account for is the rifle that went missing the night her son left to become a villain.}

cardPool.title: The Nightwarden
cardPool.value: {The Nightwarden is an unpowered pro hero and the founder of (B), where he funds and oversees the training of unpowered cadets. A formidable fighter and investigator, he relies on preparation, armor, and surveillance. Grim and solitary, he has a broad, muscular build and wears a black armored coat and full mask. Headmaster Thorne is his brother in all but blood; Sana has found a secret he buried.}

cardPool.title: Ratna "Tango-Talon" Kusuma
cardPool.value: {Ratna "Tango-Talon" Kusuma is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in grappling and takedowns. Tenacious, disciplined, competitive, tender, and proud, she has a blonde tapered crop, tan skin, and a compact, muscular build with cauliflower ears. She spars with Dagny every morning, has never beaten her, and has loved her since their first bout. Ratna tests Tunde's restraints and regularly defeats Hugo in practice.}

cardPool.title: Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves
cardPool.value: {Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in parkour, acrobatics, and rooftop pursuit. Guarded, charming, spoiled, rebellious, and conflicted, he has dark curls in a neat low taper, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. A trust-fund heir and former youth Olympic gymnast, he belongs to Victor-Viper's clique but keeps his rooftop routes private. He trades route notes with a sharp-eyed girl who watches the same rooftops, which the clique would condemn, and still resents Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: Margot "Delta-Dead" Ellery
cardPool.value: {Margot "Delta-Dead" Ellery is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in investigation and forensics. Persistent, skeptical, blunt, resentful, and compassionate, she has mousy brown hair in a secured low chignon, fair skin, and a sturdy, athletic build. A scholarship cadet, she is investigating why Chief Redding buried her mother's case. Cordelia, once her closest friend, took credit for their first case; Cordelia's clique mocks Margot's secondhand uniforms. Margot walks the Edges with Jackson.}

cardPool.title: Tunde "India-Iron" Adeniyi
cardPool.value: {Tunde "India-Iron" Adeniyi is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in restraint technology and power containment. Analytical, controlled, intense, principled, and humorless, he has black hair in a close even buzz cut, dark brown skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. He designs cuffs and dampeners for specific powers after a powered criminal hurt his family and escaped justice. Tunde tests restraints with Ratna and studies combat engineering under Otis.}

cardPool.title: Vlad "November-Night" Petrescu
cardPool.value: {Vlad "November-Night" Petrescu is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in long-range marksmanship and reconnaissance. Precise, reserved, jealous, dutiful, and unforgiving, he has dark hair in a sharply tapered side part, pale skin, and a lean, athletic build. Vlad records responsibility for every failure and has softened only one report, about Augusta. He serves as Augusta's second and loves her; her trust in Dakota fuels his resentment.}

cardPool.title: Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira
cardPool.value: {Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in close-quarters combat and disarming. Eager, combative, stubborn, loyal, and resilient, he has a shaved induction cut, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He challenges older cadets because he promised his brother he would become (B)'s toughest fighter. Ratna beats him consistently. Blake patches him up and teases him.}

cardPool.title: Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad
cardPool.value: {Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth and counter-surveillance in urban terrain. Observant, cautious, proud, inventive, and courageous, she has dark hair in a neat low bun, olive skin, and a small, lithe athletic build. Years of being followed taught her to spot surveillance. Victor-Viper's clique mocks her scholarship and coat; Noor has caught Vesper testing her skills more than once.}

cardPool.title: Wendell "Papa-Patience" Okonkwo
cardPool.value: {Wendell "Papa-Patience" Okonkwo is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in negotiation and intelligence gathering. Warm, gregarious, persistent, diplomatic, and approval-seeking, he has a black short tapered afro, dark brown skin, and a broad, athletic build. He gets reluctant witnesses talking and brings Cordelia statements other cadets cannot obtain. Wendell is caught between Cordelia and Margot's feud and trades leads with Enzo.}

cardPool.title: Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana
cardPool.value: {Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in armor engineering and field repair. Inventive, meticulous, shy, critical, and devoted, she has black hair in a close tapered pixie cut, light skin, and a petite, lean athletic build. An equipment failure killed her cousin, so she will not release armor she considers unsafe. Otis mentors her, and she plays BattleForce with Bryce.}

cardPool.title: Gabriel "Oscar-Nine" Solano
cardPool.value: {Gabriel "Oscar-Nine" Solano is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in communications and encryption. Earnest, anxious, diligent, impressionable, and ambitious, he has dark hair in a regulation ivy-league cut, tan skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. He revises briefings repeatedly and wants Victor-Viper's clique to notice him. Gabriel runs the freshman duty roster for Ramiro, the first upperclassman to praise him, and studies at Enzo's table in the Super Grind.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played across Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. (B) fields the Gargoyles, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: Corvin "Vitruvian" Thackery
cardPool.value: {Corvin Thackery is Vitruvian, the Nightwarden's oldest enemy, a genius planner with no powers who builds elaborate traps. Brilliant, cruel, and obsessive, he is a man with slicked-back black hair, pale skin, and a tall, lean build with blueprint tattoos on his hands. Corvin targets (B) because it is the only thing the Nightwarden truly cares about, and he knows the campus better than its builders. Sana's hidden file may be about him.}

cardPool.title: Nolan "Zulu-Zero" Sterling
cardPool.value: {Nolan Sterling is Zulu-Zero, a former (B) honor cadet who sells the academy's information, including doctrine, tactics, and cadets to villains. Polished, mercenary, and smug, he is a clean-cut young man with neatly parted blond hair, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Nolan graduated first in his class and was the Nightwarden's chosen successor until he vanished with the archives. Augusta trained under him and still keeps his letters.}

cardPool.title: Bastion Gargoyles PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Bastion Gargoyles are (B)'s PowerBall team, the only team in the league with no powers, playing in armor built by Otis. Dagny captains the team, and the roster is Dagny, Jackson, Ratna, Hugo, Blake, Colton, Dakota, and Tunde, with Bryce scouting every opponent. The Gargoyles have beaten powered teams before, and the families of Victor-Viper's clique fund the team, so Colton never gets benched.}

cardPool.title: Placement Day
cardPool.value: {Placement Day is (B)'s Career Day, when intelligence agencies, private security firms, and the Nightwarden's investigators come to recruit. Anjali is courted by financial crimes units, Vesper by agencies that do not officially exist, and the families of Victor-Viper's clique run booths of their own. Scholarship cadets like Margot and Noor compete for the few paid placements, and Zulu-Zero was the most-recruited cadet in (B) history.}

cardPool.title: Hold the Line
cardPool.value: {Hold the Line is (B)'s annual play, a military drama about unpowered soldiers defending a city, directed by Augusta. Cordelia stars as the commander, Colton plays the young hero, Wendell steals every scene as comic relief, and Gabriel keeps rewriting the script. Vlad critiques every rehearsal, and scholarship cadets are always cast as the soldiers who die.}

cardPool.title: Skills Night
cardPool.value: {Skills Night is (B)'s annual talent show, where cadets compete in practical skills instead of performances. Vesper does a blindfolded escape act, Leonid builds a trap maze, Colton performs his old Olympic gymnastics routine, Ratna wrestles volunteers, Yuki fits a volunteer with full armor and will not let the timer stop until it is perfect, and Enzo finds a hidden audience member in minutes. Victor-Viper's clique wins every year, and Imogen bugs the judges' table.}

cardPool.title: The Crucible
cardPool.value: {The Crucible is (B)'s signature annual event, a multi-day field exercise across Vista Valley with limited rest and live opposition. Augusta commands, Dakota rewrites her plans when they fail, and Vlad writes the after-action reports that end careers. Bryce and Blake are always put on opposing teams, Dagny hunts powered volunteers, and Vitruvian has sabotaged the Crucible before.}

cardPool.title: The Commandant's Ball
cardPool.value: {The Commandant's Ball is (B)'s annual formal, a dress-uniform affair hosted by the Nightwarden himself. Victor-Viper's clique runs the guest list, scholarship cadets struggle to afford dress uniforms, and Noor wears a borrowed one. Colton is rumored to be bringing his rooftop pen pal, Ratna is trying to ask Dagny, and Vlad hopes Augusta will say yes. Zulu-Zero once used the Ball to steal the academy archives.}

cardPool.title: The Commandant's Ball
cardPool.value: {The Commandant's Ball is (B)'s annual formal, a dress-uniform affair hosted by the Nightwarden himself. Victor-Viper's clique runs the guest list, scholarship cadets struggle to afford dress uniforms, and Noor wears a borrowed one. Colton is rumored to be bringing Harlow of (PA), Ratna is trying to ask Dagny, and Vlad hopes Augusta will say yes. Zulu-Zero once used the Ball to steal the academy archives.}

cardPool.title: Bastion Gargoyles PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Bastion Gargoyles are (B)'s PowerBall team, the only team in the league with no powers, playing in armor built by Otis. Dagny captains the team, and the roster is Dagny, Jackson, Ratna, Hugo, Blake, Colton, Dakota, and Tunde, with Bryce scouting every opponent. The Gargoyles have beaten (P) before, and the families of Victor-Viper's clique fund the team, so Colton never gets benched.}

cardPool.title: Open House
cardPool.value: {Open House is (M)'s Career Day, the one day Dr. Mercier lets recruiters from (P), (A), (B), and government agencies onto campus, and she hates every minute. Jonah and Brandon are the most courted students, Nadya is desperate for an offer she can accept with a baby, and Naomi trades secrets about the recruiters. Uncontrolled students are hidden in the east wing, and the Auctioneer has posed as a recruiter before.}

cardPool.title: Primal Raptors PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Primal Raptors are (PPP)'s PowerBall team, and cadets play unmorphed. Cody and Daichi are co-captains who no longer speak on the field, and Mateo wants the captaincy for himself. The roster is Cody, Daichi, Kexin, Maddie, Mateo, Sloane, Hanako, and Sunwoo, and Minseo leads the cheer squad. Maddie trash-talks Scotty across the field, and the Void Keeper once attacked mid-game.}

cardPool.title: The Backstage Ball
cardPool.value: {The Backstage Ball is (PA)'s annual formal, thrown the same night as (P)'s Griffin Ball after (PA) students were uninvited. Sydney runs it like a press event, and Dmitri watches Maren wait for Mikkel. Harlow is secretly bringing Colton of (B). Every year a few (P) students sneak over because the Backstage Ball is more fun.}

cardPool.title: Draft Day
cardPool.value: {Draft Day is (PA)'s Career Day, when (PA) trainees and prospective hero partners negotiate field assignments. Chloe and Brooke are fighting for Adrianna, Zain and Mikkel are fighting for Scotty, Nia wants Arnie, and Sydney is angling to run Arnie's press. Micah rejects a permanent hero partnership, Kendra needs a paid placement to keep her brothers fed, and PowWow reports the most public rejections by morning. Dr. Awesome crashes Draft Day every year to disrupt the placements he was denied.}

cardPool.title: The Griffin Ball
cardPool.value: {The Griffin Ball is (P)'s annual formal and the social event of the year. Brittany expects Arnie to ask her, Tiffany is dying to ask Brittany, and Sophia has a PowWow post ready about Arnie and Regina. Sara wants to go with Ashton, and Scotty is bringing Maddie of (PPP) to make Farah jealous. (PA) students are traditionally uninvited, which fuels a campus-wide feud.}

cardPool.title: The Rankings Gala
cardPool.value: {The Rankings Gala is (P)'s signature annual event, a black-tie ceremony that reveals the official student hero rankings. Adrianna consistently ranks at the top, Farah stays close behind and is terrified of slipping, Scotty checks his odds daily, and Sara dominates the popularity vote. Rumors say Arnie's rank is padded by his father's name, while Felix struggles near the bottom. The rankings strongly influence which agencies and (PA) sidekicks pursue which heroes.}

cardPool.title: Skyward!
cardPool.value: {Skyward! is (P)'s annual musical, directed by Mrs. Stanford, a Golden Age story about a 1940s Vista Valley newsboy who stitches his own cape and becomes the town's first hero. Felix was cast as the newsboy by accident, and Tiffany plays the switchboard girl who loves him and sings the rooftop ballad nobody lets her sing anywhere else. Hiro plays the mad scientist and ad-libs anime monologues, Zax'thor plays his robot and apologizes after every fight scene, and Alyssa narrates with lines nobody wrote. Nina leads the pit band, Poppy understudies every role, and (PA) students run the lights and sets without credit. The flying rig for the finale has failed repeatedly, and (P) blames the (PA) crew every time.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Griffins PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Paragon Griffins are (P)'s PowerBall team and the reigning league champions. Arnie captains the team, and Trayden has never forgiven him for it. The roster is Arnie, Trayden, Scotty, Farah, Clayton, Brett, Johnny, and Zax'thor, and Brittany's Frost Court cheers from the sidelines. Opponents bait Brett to snap, Scotty and Farah refuse to pass to each other, and the rivalry game against the (A) Dragons is the biggest event of the season.}

cardPool.title: The Grand Heist
cardPool.value: {The Grand Heist is (A)'s signature annual competition, where student crews have one night to steal a target Dr. Lecter chooses somewhere in Vista Valley, often (P)'s trophy case. Harmon's syndicate, Marcus's Golden Circle, Samuel's crew, and Victoria's hired team compete every year, while Christina and Dallas enter alone. Eris sells the security plans to all of them. Dark Reign once used the Heist to test his loyalists, and Deadline watches it to learn who will kill first.}

cardPool.title: Blood Moon Masquerade
cardPool.value: {The Blood Moon Masquerade is (A)'s annual formal, a masked ball held on a night known for its red moon. Carmilla's Coven hosts it every year, and Regina's Hive either boycotts or crashes it. The masks hide scandals: Regina sneaks Arnie of (P) in disguise, and Carmilla dances with Vincent. Eris sells the guest list, and Marianna attends as someone else entirely.}

cardPool.title: Apex Dragons PowerBall
cardPool.value: {The Apex Dragons are (A)'s PowerBall team and play the most violent game in the league. Dominic captains the team, and Lancer is openly campaigning to replace him. The roster is Dominic, Lancer, Quintus, Nico, Harmon, Danny, Samuel, and Christina, and Regina's Hive runs the sideline dance squad. The Dragons' rivalry game against the (P) Griffins is the most-watched game of the year, and Lancer wants Arnie on the field.}

cardPool.title: Corvin "Vitruvian" Thackery
cardPool.value: {Corvin Thackery is Vitruvian, the Nightwarden's oldest enemy, a genius planner with no powers who builds elaborate traps. Brilliant, cruel, and obsessive, he is a man with slicked-back black hair, pale skin, and a tall, lean build with blueprint tattoos on his hands. Corvin targets (B) because it is the only thing the Nightwarden truly cares about, and he knows the campus better than its builders. Sana's hidden file may be about him.}

cardPool.title: Lucian "the Beastmaster" Pryce
cardPool.value: {Lucian Pryce, known on the black market as the Beastmaster, is a wealthy collector with no powers and access to black market power dampener collars who kidnaps mutants and sells them as living weapons. Genteel, greedy, and cold, he is a man with slicked silver hair, olive skin, and a trim build. Lucian catalogs mutants like animals and holds private auctions for villains and governments; he has never failed to sell a captive. Maeve, Jonah, Winona, Chidera, and Nadine are on his wish list, and Silas has spent years racing him to mutants.}

cardPool.title: Amos "Shepherd" Wilder
cardPool.value: {Amos Wilder is Shepherd, a militant mutant liberationist who believes control training is a cage and can lift any mutant's inhibitions with a word. Charismatic, serene, and fanatical, he is a man with long gray-streaked hair and beard, weathered fair skin, and a lean build. Amos runs a commune in the Edges where powers flow freely; he calls (M) a prison and Dr. Mercier its jailer. He is courting Saoirse, Maeve, and Winona.}

cardPool.title: Kyle "Dr. Awesome" Brenner
cardPool.value: {Kyle Brenner is Dr. Awesome, a failed (PA) applicant turned villain. Brilliant, vindictive, and arrogant, he is a young man with bleached spiky hair, pale skin, and a narrow, lean build inside bulky power armor. Kyle crashes (PA) drills and events to humiliate students and prove he never needed them; admissions rejected him for his disregard for others’ safety, but he believes they doubted his intelligence. Kyle targets Micah, whom he sees as himself.}

cardPool.title: Harrison "Lodestar" Hale
cardPool.value: {Harrison "Lodestar" Hale is the vengeful ghost of a (P) freshman killed by bullies years ago. Forever young, he has a gaunt, translucent build, pale-blue hollow eyes, and a torn (P) uniform. Once kind and hopeful, his weak magnetism barely lifted a paperclip until hazing trapped him in a training vault, but his death magnified his magnetism and gave him ghostly abilities. (P) called it an accident; he sees the boys who killed him in Trayden and sees himself in Milo, whom he whispers to that the bullies deserve it.}

cardPool.title: Sabine "Siphoness" Delacroix
cardPool.value: {Sabine "Siphoness" Delacroix is a supervillain capable of draining youth and powers through physical contact. Absorbed abilities function like a finite reserve: she can use a stolen power until its stored energy is exhausted. Vain, elegant, and ravenous, she is a timeless woman with glossy auburn waves, flawless porcelain skin, and a tall, slender build. Sabine poses as a glamorous hero-agency sponsor at (P) events to choose her next victim; she is more than a century old and sees young heroes as a renewable resource. She has her eye on Adrianna, Arnie, and Sara.}

cardPool.title: Viktor "Dark Reign" Malgrave
cardPool.value: {Viktor Malgrave is Dark Reign, a disgraced former (A) professor with super strength and durability. Grandiose, charismatic, and tyrannical, he is a regal man with swept-back black hair silvering at the temples, olive skin, and a tall, broad build. Viktor was cast out by Dr. Lecter after trying to turn (A)'s student body into his personal army; he still recruits disillusioned students with promises of rank and purpose. Harmon and Marcus have both taken his meetings, and Professor Castillo was once his closest ally.}

cardPool.title: PowerBall
cardPool.value: {PowerBall is a popular sport played by every school in Vista Valley. Two teams of eight carry or throw a reinforced ball into the opposing end zone, and powers are allowed under league safety rules. The league's teams are the (A) Dragons, the (P) Griffins, the (PA) Pegasi, the (PPP) Raptors, the (M) Minotaurs, and the (B) Gargoyles, and games draw crowds from all over town.}

cardPool.title: PowWow
cardPool.value: {PowWow is an anonymous gossip account that every student in Vista Valley reads, posting secrets, breakups, fights, and scandals from all six schools as blurry photos, leaked messages, and blind items. Nobody knows who runs PowWow, and being posted can make or end a reputation overnight. Sophia of (P) secretly runs PowWow and uses it to climb socially, Kaito and Riley of (PA) sell it footage, Eris of (A) suspects Sophia. PowWow posted the video of Nina dumping Trayden and broke Scotty and Farah's breakup, and it is always the first to know.}

cardPool.title: Franky Tran
cardPool.value: {Franklin 'Franky' Tran is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) whose has weak plant growing powers. He pairs it with de-escalation and casualty support rather than using it to override decisions. Gentle and observant, Franky has light skin, short black hair, feminine face and a lean, androgynous build. He studies under Dr. Aldridge and shares tea with Lucia.}

cardPool.title: Lucia Ferrante
cardPool.value: {Lucia Ferrante is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who can sense acute fear and distress nearby. She uses that perception and her rescue training to find frightened civilians, help them evacuate, and support families after an incident. Warm and brave, she has olive skin, dark curls, a round face, and a short, sturdy build. Her family received little help after her father's death, which drives her to stay with victims through the aftermath. Lucia shadows Selina on difficult calls and shares tea with Franky.}

cardPool.title: Deshawn Holcomb
cardPool.value: {Deshawn Holcomb is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) with an unerring sense of direction. He maps escape routes through unfamiliar spaces and uses parkour to pursue targets and scout ahead. Easygoing and competitive, he has dark brown skin, a dyed blond fade, and a tall, lean athletic build. His knowledge of superhero tactics comes partly from games and anime. Deshawn is Kaito's best friend and argues with him all the time.}

cardPool.title: Priya Raghunathan
cardPool.value: {Priya Raghunathan is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She dispatches responders, sorts conflicting calls, and keeps civilians and field teams connected during emergencies. Cool-headed and exacting, she has brown skin, a long black braid, a petite build; she wears a headset even off duty. Priya admires Brooke's command skills and imitates her demanding style.}

cardPool.title: Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz
cardPool.value: {Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who adheres to walls and ceilings. He reaches trapped people, scouts elevated routes, and secures lines where ordinary climbers cannot. Energetic and reckless, he has freckled tan skin, dark curls, a lean, athletic build. Rafa films dangerous dares for Mikkel's followers and accepts Nia's challenges. Mikkel trains him but encourages his worst risks.}

cardPool.title: Nia "Blaze Kid" Obi
cardPool.value: {Nia “Blaze Kid” Obi is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who can create and control fire, using it to redirect flames, suppress spreading fires, and ignite controlled counterfires. She pairs this with rescue training to open routes for emergency teams. Bold and impatient, she has dark brown skin, box braids, a lithe, athletic build. Staff have warned her against practicing indoors. Nia wants an early assignment with Arnie, trades dares with Rafa, and tests fireproof equipment with Micah.}

cardPool.title: Gabriel "Oscar-Nine" Solano
cardPool.value: {Gabriel "Oscar-Nine" Solano is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in communications and encryption. Earnest, anxious, diligent, impressionable, and ambitious, he has dark hair in a regulation ivy-league cut, tan skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. He revises briefings repeatedly and wants Victor-Viper's clique to notice him. Gabriel runs the freshman duty roster for Ramiro, the first upperclassman to praise him, and studies at Enzo's table in the Super Grind.}

cardPool.title: Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana
cardPool.value: {Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in armor engineering and field repair. Inventive, meticulous, shy, critical, and devoted, she has black hair in a close tapered pixie cut, light skin, and a petite, lean athletic build. An equipment failure killed her cousin, so she will not release armor she considers unsafe. Otis mentors her, and she plays BattleForce with Bryce.}

cardPool.title: Wendell "Papa-Patience" Okonkwo
cardPool.value: {Wendell "Papa-Patience" Okonkwo is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in negotiation and intelligence gathering. Warm, gregarious, persistent, diplomatic, and approval-seeking, he has a black short tapered afro, dark brown skin, and a broad, athletic build. He gets reluctant witnesses talking and brings Cordelia statements other cadets cannot obtain. Wendell is caught between Cordelia and Margot's feud and trades leads with Enzo.}

cardPool.title: Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad
cardPool.value: {Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth and counter-surveillance in urban terrain. Observant, cautious, proud, inventive, and courageous, she has dark hair in a neat low bun, olive skin, and a small, lithe athletic build. Years of being followed taught her to spot surveillance. Victor-Viper's clique mocks her scholarship and coat; Noor has caught Vesper testing her skills more than once.}

cardPool.title: Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira
cardPool.value: {Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in close-quarters combat and disarming. Eager, combative, stubborn, loyal, and resilient, he has a shaved induction cut, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He challenges older cadets because he promised his brother he would become (B)'s toughest fighter. Ratna beats him consistently. Blake patches him up and teases him.}

cardPool.title: Willa "Pulse Girl" Dalton
cardPool.value: {Willa "Pulse Girl" Dalton is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who can sense nearby heartbeats and breathing patterns. She uses that sense to find hidden casualties, set triage priorities, and direct medics through chaotic rescue scenes. Brisk and caring, she has fair skin, short brown hair, a compact, athletic build. Her younger brother's long hospital stay has made her familiar with Zenith Medical Center. Selina mentors her, and Omar volunteers alongside her while avoiding Sydney.}

cardPool.title: Kaito Nakamura
cardPool.value: {Kaito Nakamura is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He pilots reconnaissance drones, maps hazards, and maintains visual contact for teammates operating out of sight. Quick with electronics but careless with privacy, he has light skin, messy black hair, a lean, slight build. He and Deshawn are best friends who often bicker, argue, and roast each other. Kaito sells compromising footage to PowWow.}

cardPool.title: Juno "Recall" Adler
cardPool.value: {Juno "Recall" Adler is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) with perfect recall. She combines remembered evidence, movement patterns, and reports into actionable threat forecasts for field teams. Thorough, bookish, and stubborn, she has fair skin, auburn hair, a round face, glasses, and a sturdy build. She predicted several attacks by Christina before (P) believed her. Juno and Tobias argue over her theories, and Riley brings her leads.}

cardPool.title: Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson
cardPool.value: {Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. His wingsuit training, aerial route planning, and rescue rigging let him enter isolated sites and reach stranded civilians. Daring and hungry for attention, he has tanned skin, windblown blond hair, a lean, athletic build. He posts crash footage despite the risk to his career. Maren restores his stamina after accidents, Dmitri races him out of jealousy, and he competes with Zain for Scotty's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Kendra "Ricoshay" Kendrick
cardPool.value: {Kendra "Ricoshay" Kendrick is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) who charges small objects to release controlled kinetic bursts on impact. She uses precise throws for ranged defense, breaching, and clearing routes for rescuers. Driven and protective, she has dark brown skin, tied-back box braids, a lean, muscular build; she carries a pouch of metal tokens. Kendra works nights at Midnight Break Cafe while raising her younger brothers and needs a stable hero career to support them. Imani looks after her, and Selina treats her injuries after fights in the Wreckage.}

cardPool.title: Vlad "November-Night" Petrescu
cardPool.value: {Vlad "November-Night" Petrescu is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in long-range marksmanship and reconnaissance. Precise, reserved, jealous, dutiful, and unforgiving, he has dark hair in a sharply tapered side part, pale skin, and a lean, athletic build. Vlad records responsibility for every failure and has softened only one report, about Augusta. He serves as Augusta's second and loves her; her trust in Dakota fuels his resentment.}

cardPool.title: Tunde "India-Iron" Adeniyi
cardPool.value: {Tunde "India-Iron" Adeniyi is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in restraint technology and power containment. Analytical, controlled, intense, principled, and humorless, he has black hair in a close even buzz cut, dark brown skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. He designs cuffs and dampeners for specific powers after a powered criminal hurt his family and escaped justice. Tunde tests restraints with Ratna and studies combat engineering under Otis.}

cardPool.title: Margot "Delta-Dead" Ellery
cardPool.value: {Margot "Delta-Dead" Ellery is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in investigation and forensics. Persistent, skeptical, blunt, resentful, and compassionate, she has mousy brown hair in a secured low chignon, fair skin, and a sturdy, athletic build. A scholarship cadet, she is investigating why Chief Redding buried her mother's case. Cordelia, once her closest friend, took credit for their first case; Cordelia's clique mocks Margot's secondhand uniforms. Margot walks the Edges with Jackson.}

cardPool.title: Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves
cardPool.value: {Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in parkour, acrobatics, and rooftop pursuit. Guarded, charming, spoiled, rebellious, and conflicted, he has dark curls in a neat low taper, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. A trust-fund heir and former youth Olympic gymnast, he belongs to Victor-Viper's clique but keeps his rooftop routes private. He trades route notes with Harlow of (PA), which the clique would condemn, and still resents Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: Ratna "Tango-Talon" Kusuma
cardPool.value: {Ratna "Tango-Talon" Kusuma is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in grappling and takedowns. Tenacious, disciplined, competitive, tender, and proud, she has a blonde tapered crop, tan skin, and a compact, muscular build with cauliflower ears. She spars with Dagny every morning, has never beaten her, and has loved her since their first bout. Ratna tests Tunde's restraints and regularly defeats Hugo in practice.}

cardPool.title: Naomi "Silent Snake" Sutton
cardPool.value: {Naomi "Silent Snake" Sutton is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled sound that she shapes into walls, whispers, and silence. She is unhurried, wise, warm, secretive, and calculating, with braids wound in a crown, deep brown skin, a low voice, and a tall, lean build. Naomi is trained in infiltration, surveillance, and hand-to-hand combat. Naomi runs the evening control sessions and hears every whispered secret in the dorms, trading them only when it suits her. Naomi knows who fathered Nadya's baby, and she worries Wyatt is falling for Maeve too hard.}

cardPool.title: Aaron Dewalt
cardPool.value: {Aaron Dewalt is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled magnetism that drags metal toward him whenever his attention slips. He is apologetic, clumsy, chatty, hardworking, and kind, with dark brown hair, tanned skin, and a broad, muscular build; he avoids metal fasteners and accessories. Aaron is a Southern farm boy whose father ran him off at gunpoint when his powers emerged. Aaron is Reese's best friend.}

cardPool.title: Paloma Cifuentes
cardPool.value: {Paloma Cifuentes is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled energy reflection she cannot aim. She is loud, goofy, flirtatious, oblivious, and fearless, with short, wavy dark hair, brown skin, and a short, full-figured build. Paloma has broken Mr. Oyelaran's force fields before and brags about it.}

cardPool.title: Owen Barrett
cardPool.value: {Owen Barrett is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that ages whatever he holds, rusting metal and withering fruit in seconds. He is withdrawn, lonely, polite, wistful, and gentle, with cropped black hair, pale skin, and a thin build and hollow cheeks; he never removes his protective gloves. Owen has not touched another person since his grandmother's hand turned to dust in his. Brother Anselm sits with Owen most evenings.}

cardPool.title: Rosalie Beaumont
cardPool.value: {Rosalie Beaumont is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrolled transformation into brittle glass when she is frightened. She is watchful, timid, careful, sweet, and fragile, with pale blonde hair, very fair skin, and a slight build with scars along both arms. Older students jump out at Rosalie as a game, and pieces of her have broken off twice; her parents stopped visiting after the second time. Saoirse drags Rosalie outdoors and fights anyone who scares her, and Solveig sits with her.}

cardPool.title: Jessie "Pink Ibis" Kirkland
cardPool.value: {Jessie Kirkland is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Pink Ibis Protector. She is exacting, prim, studious, self-righteous, and polite, with neat braids, brown skin, and a slim build. Jessie supports the freshman team from the Ibis Primalzord, memorizes every protocol, and reports anyone who breaks one. Jessie idolizes Minseo, copies her hair and walk, and regularly lectures Kexin for being rude to her.}

cardPool.title: Sayo "Yellow Serval" Aoyama
cardPool.value: {Sayo Aoyama is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Yellow Serval Protector. She is lazy, sleepy, deadpan, smug, and dependable, with a messy black ponytail, light skin, sleepy eyes, and a tall, lean build. Sayo naps between classes and scouts for the freshman team in the Serval Primalzord; she hides that recurring nightmares often keep her awake. Sayo matches Alyson's speed without trying and enjoys how much it infuriates her.}

cardPool.title: Kelechi "Green Scarab" Balogun
cardPool.value: {Kelechi Balogun is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Green Scarab Protector. He is curious, nosy, talkative, clever, and loose-lipped, with short black hair, dark brown skin, and a sturdy build. Kelechi holds ground for the freshman team in the Scarab Primalzord and dreams of building Primalzords; he saw Minseo and Daichi together in the hangar before she broke up with Cody. Kelechi follows Dr. Mokoena everywhere and has not decided whether to tell Cody.}

cardPool.title: Sunwoo "Blue Orca" Baek
cardPool.value: {Sunwoo Baek is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Blue Orca Protector. He is blunt, loud, impulsive, brash, and cheerful, with a shaved head, light skin, a chipped tooth, and a heavyset build. Sunwoo is the freshman team's demolition specialist in the Orca Primalzord; he breaks things first and plans later. Sunwoo copies Daichi's worst habits and fights with Amira every day.}

cardPool.title: Amira "Red Kestrel" Zaidi
cardPool.value: {Amira Zaidi is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Red Kestrel Protector. She is fierce, proud, bossy, driven, and brave, with a dark undercut, olive skin, and a small, wiry build. Amira leads the freshman team in the Kestrel Primalzord; she was the first of her year chosen by the Nexus and will not let anyone forget it. Amira looks up to Cody and cannot stand Sunwoo.}

cardPool.title: Ms. Greta Lindholm
cardPool.value: {Ms. Greta Lindholm runs the armory and equipment room at (B) and has no powers. Blunt, territorial, and thorough, she is a woman with iron-gray hair, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, sturdy build. Greta tracks every piece of equipment a cadet carries; the one item she cannot account for is the rifle that went missing the night her son left for (A).}

cardPool.title: Dr. Boris Kalmar
cardPool.value: {Dr. Boris Kalmar teaches combat trauma and interrogation resistance at (B) and has no powers. Clinical, unnerving, and eerily calm, he is a man with short gray hair, pale skin, and a slight build. Boris runs relentless interrogation-resistance and mental-defense drills; he and Dr. Patrick of (P) worked the same black site, and Boris keeps the secret that could end Emory's career.}

cardPool.title: Instructor Cyprian Moss
cardPool.value: {Instructor Cyprian Moss teaches investigation and forensics at (B) and has no powers. Dry, sharp, and withholding, he is an older man with thinning white hair, pale skin, and a narrow, stooped build. Cyprian answers questions with harder questions; he withholds praise because success once made him arrogant, and he watches Cordelia’s feud with Margot without taking sides.}

cardPool.title: Coach Duke Halliwell
cardPool.value: {Coach Duke Halliwell runs conditioning and hand-to-hand training at (B) and has no powers. Harsh, loud, and demanding, he is a man with a gray flattop, weathered tan skin, a very broad, muscular build, and a gravelly voice. Duke runs cadets into the ground; he served with Coach Steel of (A) and left him behind on the mission that cost Steel his limbs, and he has been trying to outrun that choice ever since.}

cardPool.title: Dean Ophelia Hargrave
cardPool.value: {Dean Ophelia Hargrave oversees discipline and conduct at (B) and has no powers. Severe, precise, and unrelenting, she is a woman with a gray bob, pale skin, and a slim, upright build. Ophelia inspects uniforms, rooms, and attitudes without warning and rarely lets a demerit slide; she once gave a troubled cadet too many chances and still blames herself for what he became.}

cardPool.title: Headmaster Ambrose Thorne
cardPool.value: {Headmaster Ambrose Thorne runs (B) and has no powers. Strict, formal, and uncompromising, he is a man with silver hair, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Ambrose expels cadets who fall below standard and answers to the Nightwarden; they grew up as brothers in all but blood.}

cardPool.title: Bastion Tactical Academy
cardPool.value:
{Bastion Tactical Academy (B) is a private ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} on a fortified campus at the edge of Vista Valley that trains heroes with no powers, and the Nightwarden founded, funds, and chairs it. The school colors of (B) are gray and black, the mascot is a Gargoyle, and cadets wear gray military prep uniforms. Cadets rise before dawn and train in tactics, forensics, marksmanship, and engineering. (B) teaches that preparation beats power, holds (P) in contempt, and studies (A) as a live threat. Cadets are assigned to five divisions: strike, recon, investigation, engineering, and command.
(B) freshmen are Hugo, Noor, Wendell, Yuki, and Gabriel.
(B) sophomores are Bryce, Blake, Anjali, Leonid, Dakota, and Vlad.
(B) juniors are Jackson, Imogen, Colton, Enzo, Sana, Tunde, and Ramiro.
(B) seniors are Dagny, Ratna, Vesper, Cordelia, Margot, Otis, and Augusta.
(B) staff are Headmaster Thorne, Dean Hargrave, Coach Halliwell, Instructor Moss, Instructor Ocampo, Dr. Kalmar, and Ms. Lindholm.
(B)'s major annual events are Gargoyles PowerBall season, Placement Day for Career Day, the annual play Hold the Line, Skills Night, the Commandant's Ball, and the Crucible.
(B)'s main antagonists are Corvin "Vitruvian" Thackery, the Nightwarden's oldest enemy and a genius trap-builder, and Nolan "Zulu-Zero" Sterling, a former (B) honor cadet who sells the academy's doctrine to villains.}

cardPool.title: Dakota "Strike-Seven" Pruitt
cardPool.value: {Dakota "Strike-Seven" Pruitt is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in battlefield tactics and squad coordination. Composed, decisive, adaptable, showy, and competitive, he has tanned skin, a freckled face, clean cut short brown hair, and a broad-shouldered, athletic build. Dakota revises failing plans under pressure and makes sure his contribution is recognized. Augusta trusts him to challenge her tactics, which stings Vlad, who wants Augusta's trust.}

cardPool.title: Ramiro "Lone-Three" Salas
cardPool.value: {Ramiro "Lone-Three" Salas is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in security and counter-infiltration. Dutiful, exacting, self-righteous, lonely, and steadfast, he has a black low taper fade, tan skin, and a sturdy, athletic build. He reports every rule breach, including one that got his only friend, Colton's former training partner, expelled. Colton has never forgiven him. Gabriel manages the freshman duty roster for Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: Augusta "Midnight-One" Kline
cardPool.value: {Augusta "Midnight-One" Kline is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in command and tactical planning. Imperious, disciplined, calculating, entitled, and wary, she has blonde hair in a tight French braid pinned above her collar, fair skin, and a tall, lean athletic build. A trust-fund heiress and (B)'s ranking cadet officer, she helped found Victor-Viper's clique with Cordelia and Colton. Her second, Vlad, loves her; Augusta trusts Dakota more than Vlad to challenge a flawed plan.}

cardPool.title: Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov
cardPool.value: {Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in trap engineering and countermeasures. Inventive, skittish, vindictive, loyal, and impulsive, he has a brown short back-and-sides cut, pale skin, and a lean, narrow build. He rigs traps for the engineering division and sabotages Victor-Viper's clique's footlockers in retaliation for their treatment of Noor. Leonid explores the Underground with Colton and Noor.}

cardPool.title: Sana "Raven-Two" Qureshi
cardPool.value: {Sana "Raven-Two" Qureshi is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in digital surveillance and data recovery. Quiet, meticulous, secretive, courageous, and anxious, she has a dark jaw-length bob tucked securely behind her ears, brown skin, and a slight, athletic build. Sana keeps backups of (B)'s records, including a file about the Nightwarden she was ordered to destroy. She trades data with Imogen but has not told even her what the file contains.}

cardPool.title: Otis "Bravo-Blade" Grady
cardPool.value: {Otis "Bravo-Blade" Grady is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in combat engineering and demolitions. Inventive, pragmatic, gruff, principled, and generous, he has a brown regulation crew cut, fair skin, and a broad, muscular build marked by burns. He builds the grapples, smoke charges, and armor used across (B)'s divisions and refuses to prioritize Victor-Viper's clique for money. Otis supplies charges to his closest friend Jackson and mentors Yuki and Tunde.}

cardPool.title: Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair
cardPool.value: {Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in cyber investigation and criminal-network analysis. Tenacious, discreet, analytical, conflicted, and compassionate, she has black hair in a neat single braid pinned above her collar, brown skin, and a small, lean athletic build. Anjali traces shell-company payments and is building a case against Von Vortex Industries. Victoria of (A) was her childhood best friend; despite what the case may do to Victoria, Anjali still answers her late-night messages.}

cardPool.title: Enzo "Charlie-Crow" Carrillo
cardPool.value: {Enzo "Charlie-Crow" Carrillo is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in tracking and surveillance. Personable, opportunistic, perceptive, cynical, and patient, he has dark hair in a short scissor-cut taper, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. Enzo can find people who do not want to be found and sells that skill to almost anyone; he refuses to search for the father who left him. He works from the Super Grind, trades leads with Wendell, and lets Gabriel study at his table.}

cardPool.title: Cordelia "Victor-Viper" Colby
cardPool.value: {Cordelia "Victor-Viper" Colby is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in investigation, interrogation, and fencing. Brilliant, elitist, exacting, manipulative, and vindictive, she wears dark hair in a tight low bun and has fair skin and a lean, athletic build. A trust-fund heiress and former youth Olympic fencer, she leads a clique of wealthy cadets that includes Augusta and Colton. Cordelia stole credit for a case from her former best friend Margot, whom the clique now torments along with Noor.}

cardPool.title: Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in field medicine and reconnaissance. Charismatic, calm, competitive, generous, and vain, she has dark curls in a close tapered pixie cut, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. She has carried injured cadets off the obstacle course and enjoys the attention afterward. Blake won the recon slot her twin brother Bryce wanted.}

cardPool.title: Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe
cardPool.value: {Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in electronic surveillance and signals intelligence. Skeptical, resourceful, impatient, vigilant, and loyal, she wears her dark hair in a low braided bun beneath a neatly secured headscarf; she has light brown skin and a lean, wiry build. She avoids networked devices and plants listening devices around (B), including Victor-Viper's common room. Aiden of (A) sends messages to every screen near her. Imogen trusts Sana more than anyone.}

cardPool.title: Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt
cardPool.value: {Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth, infiltration, and escape. Taciturn, audacious, independent, curious, and exacting, she has a black tapered pixie cut, pale skin, and a lithe, athletic build. She slipped into (A) after dark; Christina caught her and let her go. Vesper tests Noor's counter-surveillance skills, though Noor has caught her twice.}

cardPool.title: Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in intelligence and threat analysis. Observant, ambitious, resentful, strategic, and insecure, he has a dark curly taper fade, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He studies how (P) and (A) students fight and keeps an especially detailed file on his twin sister Blake. Bryce resents Blake for winning the recon slot he trained for and plays BattleForce with Yuki.}

cardPool.title: Jackson "Hotel-Hard" Whitmore
cardPool.value: {Jackson "Hotel-Hard" Whitmore is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in breaching, demolitions, and close-quarters fighting. Methodical, stoic, conscientious, judgmental, and loyal, he has a close-cropped buzz cut, dark brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. He accounts for every round he fires after once losing track of one. Otis, his closest friend, builds his charges; Jackson walks the Edges with Margot and defends her from Victor-Viper's clique.}

cardPool.title: Dagny "Steel-Six" Holt
cardPool.value: {Dagny "Steel-Six" Holt is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in hand-to-hand combat and melee weapons. Combative, direct, prideful, protective, and impulsive, she has an ash-blonde crew cut, fair skin, a tall, broad, muscular build, and a crooked nose. She seeks fights with powered students because one put her younger brother in the hospital; she has beaten several. Dagny spars with Ratna each morning and has never lost. She does not realize Ratna loves her.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Hollis Byrne
cardPool.value: {Mr. Hollis Byrne runs the gear workshop at (PA) and teaches sidekicks to build, repair, and improvise hero equipment under field constraints. Blunt, practical, and gruff, he is a bearded man with shaggy brown hair, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, muscular build with one finger missing. Hollis grumbles at sloppy work but fixes it anyway; he lost the finger building gear for a hero who later sold the design as his own.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Julian Sorrell
cardPool.value: {Mr. Julian Sorrell teaches public relations at (PA) and coaches sidekicks to manage the press and public consequences around hero operations. Cynical, polished, and well-connected, he is a man with slicked-back dark hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Julian treats every class like a press briefing.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Faye Aldridge
cardPool.value: {Dr. Faye Aldridge teaches field medicine at (PA) and treats training injuries. Brisk, sharp-tongued, and strict, she is a middle-aged woman with a graying bob, fair skin, and a lean build. Faye scolds students while she stitches them up and has repeatedly grounded Maren for draining herself.}

cardPool.title: Coach Esteban Ruiz
cardPool.value: {Coach Esteban Ruiz teaches core field training at (PA), including teamwork, safe falls, close protection, and extracting a hero or civilian from a fight. Loud, direct, and practical, he is a weathered man with a salt-and-pepper crew cut, tan skin, and a stocky, muscular build with a limp. Esteban teaches that a sidekick's first duty is to bring their hero home; he got his limp carrying his hero out of a fire, and the hero never visited him in the hospital.}

cardPool.title: Dean Harriet Nwosu
cardPool.value: {Dean Harriet Nwosu leads (PA) and spent decades as Alpha Force's sidekick. Blunt, unimpressed, and protective, she is a short woman with silver hair, dark brown skin, and a sturdy build; she walks with a cane. Harriet insists a sidekick is a professional, not an accessory; she walked away from Alpha Force the day he took credit for the rescue that cost her leg, and she and Headmaster Green are close friends.}

cardPool.title: Dmitri Volkov
cardPool.value: {Dmitri Volkov is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An expert pursuit and extraction driver, he gets teams into tight areas and moves civilians out while routes are blocked or under attack. Deadpan and competitive, he has fair skin, slicked-back dark hair, a lean, muscular build, and an old leather jacket. He has unexplained access to vehicles. Dmitri loves Maren, who is devoted to Mikkel, and races Mikkel through the Edges to prove himself.}

cardPool.title: Maren ""Lifeline" Sinclair
cardPool.value: {Maren "Lifeline" Sinclair is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who transfers her own stamina to others. She keeps exhausted rescuers and injured teammates moving, but overuse leaves her unable to protect herself. Devoted and stubborn, she has pale skin, violet-dyed hair, dark circles, and a slight build. Dr. Aldridge has grounded her for draining herself. Maren repeatedly gives Mikkel her strength after his crashes and overlooks Dmitri's feelings for her.}

cardPool.title: Sydney Booker
cardPool.value: {Sydney Booker is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She manages crisis communications, verifies reports from the field, and protects civilians from bad information during hero operations. Polished, strategic, and ruthless with a story, she has fair skin, a blonde ponytail, and a tall, slender build. Sydney wants to handle Arnie's press and knows about his relationship with Regina. A supervillain once kidnapped and injured her; she cannot explain how quickly her symptoms eased afterward. She loves Omar and resents his avoidance, and she openly criticizes Chloe's fixation on Adrianna.}

cardPool.title: Omar "Dreamweaver" Ouazzani
cardPool.value: {Omar "Dreamweaver" Ouazzani is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) who can enter and influence dreams. In the field he relies on negotiation, de-escalation, and restraint; he refuses to use his power again after using it to ease Sydney's trauma from a kidnapping. Calm and persuasive but burdened by guilt, he has brown skin, a fade, a low voice, and a tall, lean build. Omar is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter. Sydney fell for him after the dream intervention and does not know what happened. Omar volunteers with Willa partly to avoid her.}

cardPool.title: Selina Marchetti
cardPool.value: {Selina Marchetti is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She stabilizes trauma patients under fire, organizes evacuation for the wounded, and keeps teammates alive until hospital care is available. Calm and discreet, she has olive skin, tied-back dark curls, a medium, athletic build, and steady hands. Treating (P) seniors has given her their trust and knowledge of their injuries. She mentors Willa and repeatedly treats Johnny of (P).}

cardPool.title: Riley Maddox
cardPool.value: {Riley Maddox is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) with night vision. She conducts low-light surveillance, documents threats, and guides teams through dark buildings, though her appetite for a story can compromise an investigation. Nosy and reckless, she has freckled fair skin, red hair, a small, lean build and a camera. Riley follows suspected (A) students and sells embarrassing photos to PowWow. She is tailing Dallas of (A) and keeps those photographs from Harlow and Juno.}

cardPool.title: Charlie "Fixit" Dunbar
cardPool.value: {Charlotte "Charlie" "Fixit" Dunbar is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. A field engineer, she repairs damaged rescue equipment, improvises tools from available parts, and keeps a team operational after its gear fails. Inventive, warm, and distractible, she has fair skin, a frizzy brown ponytail, a short, rounded build with burns on her thumbs. Charlie wants a job at Darling Designs but struggles to finish long projects. She does not know Micah has been stealing her designs.}

cardPool.title: Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett
cardPool.value: {Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) with telescopic sight. From concealed overwatch positions she tracks moving threats, guides teams around blind corners, and identifies safe approaches for rescuers. Aloof and observant, she has light brown skin, a long dark braid, and a tall, lean build. Her rooftop surveillance draws her into an exchange of notes with Colton of (B), whose wealth and clique challenge her judgment of him. She is falling for him despite herself.}

cardPool.title: Tobias "Casefile" Kwan
cardPool.value: {Tobias "Casefile" Kwan is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He gathers evidence, reconstructs incidents, and handles the legal steps needed to turn a rescue or arrest into a durable case. Meticulous, principled, and smug about being right, he has light skin, neatly parted black hair, glasses, and a tall, lean build. He hopes to work with investigator Rachel Cross. His arguments with Juno often sharpen her theories, and he is also friends with Zain.}

cardPool.title: Brooke "Commanda" Ellis
cardPool.value: {Brooke "Commanda" Ellis is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An incident commander, she coordinates teams, maintains communications under pressure, and reallocates responders as threats change.
