Bossy, demanding, and cutthroat, she has fair skin, a short brown ponytail, a small, lean build. Brooke wants to lead Adrianna's command center after graduation and competes with Chloe for her sidekick assignment. Priya models her dispatch work on Brooke's.}

cardPool.title: Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway
cardPool.value: {Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) who raises sturdy, stationary walls of earth to shield block an exit or cover a group. He holds evacuation routes against attacks and knows when to reposition before a barrier fails. Shy, steady, and protective, he has fair skin, sandy hair, and a very broad, muscular build. He wants (P) heroes to recognize him as a partner. Dmitri drives him home.}

cardPool.title: Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton
cardPool.value: {Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who rapidly freezes surfaces to immobilize opponents, seal breaches, and create safe routes through hazardous ground. Precise and resentful, she has pale skin, straight blonde hair, and a slim build. Chloe believes money kept her out of (P) and studies Adrianna's tactics to earn a place at her side. She despises Brittany's purchased ice powers and competes with Brooke for Adrianna's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Micah "Highwire" Delacroix
cardPool.value: {Micah "Highwire" Delacroix is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An engineer and high-angle rescue specialist, he builds anchor systems and climbing gear that let him reach and extract people from dangerous structures. Methodical and ambitious, he has brown skin, short black hair, a lean, athletic build, and a rescue harness. His father died when a hero abandoned him in combat, leaving Micah determined to build a suit strong enough to operate on his own. He steals Charlie's designs and experiments with Nia's electrical power.}

cardPool.title: Imani "Windana" Cole
cardPool.value: {Imani "Windana" Cole is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) whose controlled wind bursts deflect attacks, disrupt an opponent's footing, and cover evacuations. A seasoned close-quarters fighter, she pairs that power with reliable protection tactics. Blunt and loyal, she has deep brown skin, a shaved head, a broad, muscular build, and scarred forearms. Her sister died protecting a hero who never attended the funeral, so Imani challenges heroes who treat sidekicks as expendable. She looks after Kendra.}

cardPool.title: Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri
cardPool.value: {Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri is a senior sidekick hero at (PA). He rides air currents to carry teammates and civilians across hazards, scout from above, and make rapid extractions. Talkative and generous but evasive about his home life, he has olive skin, short dark hair, a small, lean build. His work as a field courier gives him contacts across both campuses. His longtime drill partner is Imani, and he competes with Mikkel for Scotty's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Silas Calloway
cardPool.value: {Silas Calloway is the field recruiter for (M) and a mutant who wields fire. Quiet, steady, and determined, he is a weathered man with shaggy graying hair, sun-lined fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Silas chainsmokes and personally escorts many frightened new students to Meridian.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Desmond Oyelaran
cardPool.value: {Mr. Desmond Oyelaran teaches power control at (M) and is a mutant who creates force fields. Stern, relentless, and exacting, he is an immaculate man with close-cropped hair, a trimmed beard, dark brown skin, and a tall, lean build. Desmond shields the training rooms so students can use their powers safely; he pushes Reese hardest because she reminds him of a daughter he failed to protect.}

cardPool.title: Brother Anselm
cardPool.value: {Brother Anselm oversees student welfare at (M) and has no powers. Kind, compassionate, and discreet, he is an Englishman with a graying beard, fair skin, and a short, rounded build. Anselm calms new students with tea and long silences and repeats nothing they tell him; he left his church after it turned away a frightened mutant child, and he has never stopped searching for her.}

cardPool.title: Jonah Whitlock
cardPool.value: {Jonah Whitlock is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled power amplification that pushes another mutant past their limits with a touch. He is affable, cocky, flirtatious, sharp, and careless, with short brown hair, fair skin, a disarming grin, and a muscular build in a leather jacket. Jonah is a strong hand-to-hand fighter, and both (P) and (A) want to recruit him. Since Nadya left him without explanation, Jonah has pursued other students. He does not know her baby is his.}

cardPool.title: Nadya Petrova
cardPool.value: {Nadya Petrova is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled liquid transformation. She is aloof, ambitious, resentful, elegant, and proud, with dark hair, fair skin, reflective eyes, and a slender build. Nadya is raising her infant daughter alone in a converted dorm room and refuses to name the father; (P) rejected her twice, the second time after she told them she was pregnant. Everyone suspects Jonah, her ex, and Jonah has no idea the baby is his.}

cardPool.title: Everett Doyle
cardPool.value: {Everett Doyle is a junior at (M) and has fully controlled phasing through solid matter. Easygoing, friendly, playful, nosy, and compassionate, he is a young man with sandy hair, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Everett leans through walls into conversations he was not invited to and greets every student Silas brings in. Everett and Winona were in love until one accidental touch erased his memories of her; he is dating Nadine to move on, but their volatile relationship is difficult for him to leave.}

cardPool.title: Solveig Nyberg
cardPool.value: {Solveig Nyberg is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled pain transference, drawing an injury's pain into herself. She is serene, private, and self-sacrificing, with white-blonde hair, very pale skin, colorless eyes, and a tall, slender build. Solveig works the infirmary and takes the worst cases herself; she conceals the toll it takes on her. Solveig helps Nadya with the baby at night.}

cardPool.title: Brandon "Ironclad" Boone
cardPool.value: {Brandon "Ironclad" Boone is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled metal shaping. He is calm, dependable, and self-denying, with long brown hair in a ponytail, tan skin, and a broad-shouldered, muscular build with scars along his forearms. Brandon is a capable hand-to-hand fighter who shapes metal with precision; both (P) and (A) have offered to recruit him, and he has answered neither. Brandon mentors Oskar, Declan, and Aaron.}

cardPool.title: Maeve Halloran
cardPool.value: {Maeve Halloran is a junior at (M) and has a partially controlled voice that compels anyone who hears it to obey her literally. She is guarded, careful, haunted, tempted, and vindictive, with red hair, pale freckled skin, a rasp from speaking so little, and a small, slender build with sharp features. Maeve writes most of what she says; last year she told a girl who humiliated her to disappear, and the girl transferred the next day. Maeve spends hours inside Wyatt's silence, finds poems from a secret admirer on her pillow, and confides only in Nadine.}

cardPool.title: Declan Boyd
cardPool.value: {Declan Boyd is a junior at (M) and has partially controlled fire that escapes him when he is angry or showing off. He is boastful, reckless, and vain, with blonde hair, fair skin covered in burns, and a broad build. Declan frequently sets something alight, usually while showing off, and he hates Jonah for existing.}

cardPool.title: Nadine Nassar
cardPool.value: {Nadine Nassar is a junior at (M) and has partially controlled precognition that shows her ten seconds ahead and leaves blinding migraines. She is reckless, flirtatious, cutting, fearless, and volatile, with dark hair, olive skin, and a lean, athletic build. Nadine is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter who uses her precognition to treat danger like a game. Her appetite for danger makes her provoke people despite the migraines her visions cause. Maeve is her best friend; she is dating Everett.}

cardPool.title: Emilio Vargas
cardPool.value: {Emilio Vargas is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled duplication that sometimes splits him into up to six arguing copies. He is animated, anxious, chaotic, loud, and messy, with curly black hair, tan skin, a permanent grin, and a short, lean build. Emilio's copies blurt the things he hides, which has already cost him friendships.}

cardPool.title: Reese Lawson
cardPool.value: {Reese Lawson is a junior at (M) and has a partially controlled heat drain that frosts the room whenever she is anxious. She is composed, disciplined, repressed, judgmental, and jealous, with curly dark hair tied back, brown skin, and a lean build. She wears a heavy coat even indoors. Reese trains relentlessly to control her heat drain and criticizes classmates she thinks are careless.}

cardPool.title: Saoirse Quinn
cardPool.value: {Saoirse Quinn is a freshman at (M) and has uncontrolled glowing spores and vines that grow wherever she stands. She is wild, defiant, bratty, loud, and fearless, with red braids woven with plants, freckled fair skin, and a small, wiry build. Saoirse smuggles seedlings into the dormitory and refuses every rule; she ran away from a family that kept her in a room with no windows. Saoirse drags Rosalie outdoors, and she is at war with Nadya, whose baby sneezes whenever Saoirse walks by.}

cardPool.title: Oskar Brandt
cardPool.value: {Oskar Brandt is a sophomore at (M) and has an uncontrolled living shadow that acts on the feelings he hides. He is stoic, melodramatic, private, grim, and mortified, with messy black hair, pale skin, dark circles, and a tall, lean build with a slouch. Oskar writes poetry he shows to nobody, but his shadow has started leaving those poems on Maeve's pillow and slapping anyone who mocks her. Maeve has no idea who writes them, Wyatt suspects, and Brandon is the only one who can calm the shadow.}

cardPool.title: Winona Castellano
cardPool.value: {Winona Castellano is a sophomore at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that erases the memories of anyone whose bare skin she touches with her hands. She is guarded, dryly funny, lonely, and quietly ruthless, with dark hair, olive skin, and a slight build and sharp features; she wears protective gloves. Deeply in love with Everett, Winona is grieving over how she accidentally erased Everett's memories of her.}

cardPool.title: Wyatt Ramsey
cardPool.value: {Wyatt Ramsey is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrollable field that silences all sound a few feet around him. He is sarcastic, restless, funny, jealous, and yearning, with a long brown braid, fair skin, and a wiry build. Wyatt communicates in savage handwritten one-liners and misses music more than anything. Maeve spends a lot of time with Wyatt because his silence is the only place her voice cannot hurt anyone, which he reads as love, and he hates Oskar's shadow for leaving her poems.}

cardPool.title: Chidera Njoku
cardPool.value: {Chidera Njoku is a freshman at (M) with uncontrolled animal shapeshifting that triggers whenever she is startled. She is soft-spoken, cautious, frightened, kind, and lonely, with short, dark orange hair in a fade, bright orange skin, and a tall, lean build. Chidera eats after everyone leaves the hall, and classmates scare her for laughs; her family sent her away after she transformed and hurt her little brother. Everett is the only student who sits near Chidera.}

cardPool.title: Coach Rei Tamura
cardPool.value: {Coach Rei Tamura leads the yellow path at (PPP) and trains cadets in speed, evasion, and reconnaissance. Restless, brisk, and exacting, she is a trim woman with a short black ponytail, light skin, and a lean runner's build. Rei times everything her cadets do; she crashed Dr. Mokoena's first Primalzord years ago, and they have argued over equipment safety ever since.}

cardPool.title: Haeun "Pink Lynx" Kwon
cardPool.value: {Haeun Kwon is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Pink Lynx Protector. She is shy, anxious, precise, secretive, and obsessive, with long black hair, fair skin, and a slight build. She wears an oversized hoodie. Haeun snipes for the sophomore team from the Lynx Primalzord and avoids crowds; she watches Elijah through her scope more than she watches targets. Haeun keeps a private journal about Elijah the other girls would kill to read.}

cardPool.title: Alyson "Yellow Mongoose" Nhieu
cardPool.value: {Alyson Nhieu is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Yellow Mongoose Protector. She is hyperactive, loud, playful, clingy, and possessive, with a black ponytail, light skin, and a petite, athletic build. Alyson is the sophomore team's skirmisher in the Mongoose Primalzord and never sits still. Alyson has been Elijah's best friend since they were kids and believes that makes him hers, she resents that Sayo matches her speed, and she pretends to be friends with Ingrid.}

cardPool.title: Ingrid "Green Bear" Halvorsen
cardPool.value: {Ingrid Halvorsen is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Green Bear Protector. She is bubbly, chatty, starstruck, pushy, and sturdy, with white-blonde hair, fair skin, and a tall, muscular build. Ingrid anchors the sophomore team in the Bear Primalzord; a superhero otaku, she keeps a scrapbook of every hero she has met and calls Elijah her future hero. Ingrid hugs Elijah in front of Hanako on purpose and meets Alyson at Heroes' Pizza, where their friendship masks a rivalry.}

cardPool.title: Hanako "Blue Barracuda" Ishida
cardPool.value: {Hanako Ishida is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Blue Barracuda Protector. She is proud, strict, hot-tempered, demanding, and flustered, with long black hair, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. Hanako is the sophomore team's aquatic combat specialist in the Barracuda Primalzord; she insists she should lead the team instead of Elijah. Hanako yells at Elijah constantly to hide that she loves him, and she treats Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun as rivals.}

cardPool.title: Elijah "Red Tiger" Hoang
cardPool.value: {Elijah Hoang is a sophomore at (PPP) and is the Red Tiger Protector. Earnest, dense, reckless, eager, and insecure, he is a young man with messy black hair, light skin, a wide smile, and a slight, lean build. Elijah leads the sophomore team in the Cub Primalzord, the only boy on a team of four girls, and volunteers them for missions beyond them. Hanako, Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun are all in love with Elijah and competing for him, and he is the only person at (PPP) who has not noticed.}

cardPool.title: Beatriz "Pink Dove" Salazar
cardPool.value: {Beatriz Salazar is a junior at (PPP) and is the Pink Dove Protector. She is warm, martyred, passive-aggressive, nurturing, and heartbroken, with curly brown hair, freckled tan skin, and a sturdy, rounded build. Beatriz patches up the junior team from the Dove Primalzord and makes sure everyone knows how much she sacrifices for them. Beatriz covers every one of Mateo's mistakes because she loves him, and she smiles sweetly at Rinko while quietly making her life harder.}

cardPool.title: Rinko "Yellow Falcon" Sagara
cardPool.value: {Rinko Sagara is a junior at (PPP) and is the Yellow Falcon Protector. She is rebellious, aloof, disobedient, bold, and prickly, with a short black bob, light skin, and a lean, athletic build in a flight jacket. Rinko scouts for the junior team in the Falcon Primalzord and breaks formation to chase leads; she keeps everyone at a distance after being abandoned by someone she trusted. Rinko defies Sloane at every turn and ignores Mateo's crush, knowing Beatriz loves him.}

cardPool.title: Haoyu "Green Tortoise" Liang
cardPool.value: {Haoyu Liang is a junior at (PPP) and is the Green Tortoise Protector. He is awkward, bashful, studious, jealous, and loyal, with messy black hair, light skin, and a tall, lean build and stooped posture. Haoyu is the junior team's defensive specialist in the Tortoise Primalzord and confides in Elijah over BattleForce.}

cardPool.title: Sloane "Blue Fox" Kovacs
cardPool.value: {Sloane Kovacs is a junior at (PPP) and is the Blue Fox Protector. She is blunt, analytical, cold, condescending, and ruthless, with a pale buzz cut, fair skin, a flat stare, and a tall, muscular build. Sloane plans for the junior team and pilots the Fox Primalzord; she treats casualties as acceptable losses and rarely shows grief. Sloane openly mocks Mateo's leadership, and Rinko defies her orders at every turn.}

cardPool.title: Mateo "Red Ram" Delgado
cardPool.value: {Mateo Delgado is a junior at (PPP) and is the Red Ram Protector. He is hotheaded, ambitious, arrogant, reckless, and oblivious, with a buzzed fade, brown skin, a chipped front tooth, and a compact, muscular build. Mateo leads the junior team and charges in the Ram Primalzord; he calls the senior team a soap opera and wants Cody's spot. Mateo chases Rinko, who ignores him, and never notices that Beatriz covers every mistake he makes because she loves him.}

cardPool.title: Minseo "Pink Peacock" Yoon
cardPool.value: {Minseo Yoon is a senior at (PPP) and is the Pink Peacock Protector. She is radiant, charming, vain, calculating, and adored, with long bleached-blonde hair, fair skin, and a slender build. Minseo is a popular student with admirers across Vista Valley and provides the senior team's shields, healing, and ranged fire. Minseo dumped Cody for his best friend Daichi and split the senior team in half, and Kexin is the only one who refuses to forgive her.}

cardPool.title: Maddie "Yellow Jackrabbit" Whitfield
cardPool.value: {Maddie Whitfield is a senior at (PPP) and is the Yellow Jackrabbit Protector. She is restless, cocky, trash-talking, competitive, and smitten, with a sandy ponytail, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Maddie scouts for the senior team in the Jackrabbit Primalzord and talks fast so nobody notices when she is scared. Maddie is dating Scotty of (P) after months of racing him, and she has no idea he is mostly using her to make his ex, Farah, jealous.}

cardPool.title: Kexin "Green Rhino" Zhou
cardPool.value: {Kexin Zhou is a senior at (PPP) and is the Green Rhino Protector. She is scrappy, bitter, stubborn, sarcastic, and overlooked, with a short black bob, light skin, and a short, sturdy build. Kexin repairs the Rhino Primalzord herself and holds the senior team together while nobody thanks her. Kexin is sick of the whole academy fawning over Minseo and forgiving her for wrecking the team.}

cardPool.title: Daichi "Blue Marlin" Tanabe
cardPool.value: {Daichi Tanabe is a senior at (PPP) and is the Blue Marlin Protector. He is loud, cocky, charming, brash, and guilty, with a shaved undercut, light skin, a constant grin, and a broad, muscular build. Daichi commands the senior team in combat and pilots the Marlin Primalzord; he was Cody's best friend since orientation until he started dating Minseo the week she dumped Cody. Daichi insists nothing happened before the breakup, Kelechi knows otherwise, and Sunwoo copies his worst habits.}

cardPool.title: Cody "Red Raptor" Harrington
cardPool.value: {Cody Harrington is a senior at (PPP) and is the Red Raptor Protector. He is disciplined, dutiful, rigid, proud, and heartbroken, with a shaved head, tan skin, and a broad-shouldered, muscular build with a scar along his jaw. Cody leads the senior team as its vanguard and pilots the Raptor Primalzord; he got the jaw scar shielding Minseo, and a week later she left him for his best friend. Cody still has to take battle plans from Daichi, Mateo challenges him at every turn, and Elijah worships him.}

cardPool.title: Rachel Cross
cardPool.value: {Rachel Cross is a prosecutor at the Vista Valley Municipal Court who prosecutes villains. Cold, calculating, and tireless, she is a sharp-featured woman with a sleek dark bun, fair skin, and a slim build. Rachel works late building airtight cases; she has made beating Slick Danforth in court her life's work.}

cardPool.title: Daniel "Slick" Danforth
cardPool.value: {Daniel "Slick" Danforth is a defense attorney for supervillains at the Vista Valley Municipal Court. Arrogant, sharp, and ruthless, he is an amoral man with silver hair, tanned skin, and a trim build. Daniel struts through the courthouse and wins through legal loopholes; his courtroom rival is Rachel Cross.}

cardPool.title: Magnolia 'Mags' Darling
cardPool.value: {Magnolia "Mags" Darling is a tech entrepreneur and fashion designer in Vista Valley. Bold, inventive, and outspoken, she is a glamorous woman in her late forties with a sleek black bob, brown skin, and a curvy build. Mags runs Darling Designs and supplies gear to students, heroes, and villains alike.}

cardPool.title: Caleb Grayson
cardPool.value: {Caleb Grayson is a reporter for the Vista Valley Dispatch. Resourceful, reckless, and ambitious, he is a wiry man in his early twenties with messy dark hair, fair skin, and a lean build. Caleb chases every lead across town and crosses ethical lines for exclusives; he keeps feeding Rachel Cross tips she never thanks him for.}

cardPool.title: Leonor Valencia
cardPool.value: {Leonor Valencia is the editor-in-chief of the Vista Valley Dispatch, the town's main newspaper, which covers the six academies. Blunt, principled, and experienced, she is a sharply dressed woman with silver hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Leonor publishes exposes on hero abuses and on (A) and manages her reporter, Caleb Grayson.}

cardPool.title: Mayor Paul Winslow
cardPool.value: {Paul Winslow is the mayor of Vista Valley. Earnest, polished, and indecisive, he is a portly man with thinning gray hair, fair skin, and a rounded build. Paul shakes hands at every ribbon-cutting and runs the town from City Hall; he is torn between his ideals and his donors, and his biggest donor is Von Vortex Industries.}

cardPool.title: Victorino "Vaquero" Torres
cardPool.value: {Victorino Torres is Vaquero, a national-level supervillain and minotaur mutant with immense strength and durability. Simple-minded, blunt, and obedient, he is a man with a bull's horned head, brown hide, and a massive, muscular build. Victorino works as hired muscle and follows orders without question; he is devoted to Queen Tiara, who keeps him hypnotized.}

cardPool.title: Gustav "Mr. Tycoon" Von Vortex
cardPool.value: {Gustav Von Vortex is Mr. Tycoon, a global-level supervillain with no powers and the CEO of Von Vortex Industries. Ruthless, strategic, and controlling, he is a silver-haired man with fair skin, green eyes, and a tall, broad build. Gustav hides illegal weapons, research, and trafficking behind a legitimate company; a doting father who cannot deny her requests, he raised Victoria alone after Queen Tiara left.}

cardPool.title: Brian "Flaming Jager" Walker
cardPool.value: {Brian Walker is Flaming Jager, a pro hero in Vista Valley, a fire-breather, and a drunken-fist master. Loud, rambling, and reckless, he is a disheveled man with shaggy auburn hair, ruddy fair skin, and a stocky build. Brian fights best drunk and talks far too much; he lost his partnership with Cool Guy when a drunken mistake hurt a civilian, and he drinks at Pete's every night to forget her name.}

cardPool.title: Zeke "Master Nimbus" Zhao
cardPool.value: {Zeke Zhao is Master Nimbus, a popular pro hero in Vista Valley, a martial artist, and a cloud rider. Jovial, witty, and daring, he is a kind man with a black topknot, light skin, and a lean, athletic build. Zeke cracks jokes mid-fight and signs every autograph; his master was killed by Thanatos, and he has been hunting the white feathers ever since.}

cardPool.title: Jacky "Commander Vanguard" Steel
cardPool.value: {Jacky Steel is Commander Vanguard, a pro hero in Vista Valley and former special forces officer without powers who pilots a towering blue-and-silver battle suit of his own design. Tactical, compassionate, and steady, he is a rugged man with a graying crew cut, brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. Jacky briefs rescuers before every fight; he still loves his ex, Ghost Wing.}

cardPool.title: Adrian "Titaniumman" Armstrong
cardPool.value: {Adrian Armstrong is Titaniumman, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with super strength and durability. Warm, charismatic, and dependable, he is a large man with golden blond hair, fair skin, and a broad, muscular build. Mags designs his silver-and-blue suit. Adrian shakes every hand and remembers every name; he has no idea his son Arnie is dating a girl from (A).}

cardPool.title: Frederick "Alpha Force" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Frederick Farrell is Alpha Force, a legendary pro hero in Vista Valley with enhanced strength, speed, and combat skill. Ruthless, efficient, and strict, he is an intimidating man with short blond hair, fair skin, and a lean, muscular build. Frederick treats every visit to (P) like an inspection and has never praised Felix or Farah in public.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Martinez
cardPool.value: {Mr. Martinez is the janitor at (P) and can teleport. Stern, efficient, and inflexible, he is a middle-aged man with a black mustache, tan skin, and a lean, wiry build. Martinez appears wherever a rule is being broken and never bends one, and students fear him; he is the estranged younger brother of Mr. Bob of (A) and teleports away whenever his name comes up.}

cardPool.title: Emory Patrick
cardPool.value: {Dr. Emory Patrick is the counselor at (P), a former government operative and interrogator who can induce calm. Composed, perceptive, and reassuring, he is a soft-spoken man with close-cropped gray hair, brown skin, and a lean build. Emory listens far more than he speaks and is especially skilled with frightened or traumatized students; he and Dr. Kalmar of (B) worked the same black site, and Kalmar knows the one interrogation Emory has never forgiven himself for.}

cardPool.title: Professor Ted "Great Gadget" Morris
cardPool.value: {Professor Ted Morris heads the technology department at (P) and is the former pro sidekick Great Gadget, with spider-like cyborg arms. Practical, generous, and inventive, he is a cheerful middle-aged man with a graying beard, fair skin, and a stocky, muscular build with mechanical arms. Ted helps students build hero gear; he lost his hero and his own arms when Dr. Gates hacked their suit, and he obsessively checks student gear for security flaws because of it.}

cardPool.title: Professor Thora "Grand Chronicler" Proctor
cardPool.value: {Professor Thora Proctor teaches Social Studies at (P) and is the former pro hero Grand Chronicler, with a paralyzing gaze. Stern, scholarly, and patriotic, she is an older woman with a tight gray bun, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Thora teaches heroic history and civic duty; she toppled Professor Castillo's dictatorship herself and lost her partner in the final battle, and she cannot believe he teaches across town.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Adam "Atomic Man" McCormick
cardPool.value: {Dr. Adam McCormick heads the science department at (P), known as Atomic Man, and glows. Excitable, brilliant, and focused, he is a man with wild blond hair, faintly glowing fair skin, and a lanky build. Adam bounces between experiments mid-lecture and develops new energy technology; the accident that made him glow also scarred his lab partner, Dr. Morbius, and he has spent years trying to apologize.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Bob
cardPool.value: {Mr. Bob is the janitor at (A) and dissolves anything he touches. Diligent, wise, and discreet, he is an older man with a bald head, weathered brown skin, and a sturdy build with thick rubber gloves. Bob seems to know most of the school's secrets, and students respect him; he is the estranged older brother of Mr. Martinez of (P), and neither will say what split them.}

cardPool.title: William "Trojan" Gates
cardPool.value: {Dr. William Gates heads the technology department at (A), known as Trojan, and can merge with computers. Sly, meticulous, and amoral, he is a middle-aged man with thinning brown hair, pale skin, and a soft, rounded build. William lurks behind glowing monitors and teaches hacking and cyberterrorism; he once hacked the suit of Morris's hero, and Ted has never forgiven him.}

cardPool.title: Coach Brutus Steel
cardPool.value: {Coach Brutus Steel heads the Physical Education department at (A) and is a cybernetically enhanced military veteran. Harsh, demanding, and efficient, he is a man with a gray buzz cut, weathered tan skin, and a broad, muscular build with visible cybernetic limbs. Brutus drills students until they drop; he and Coach Halliwell of (B) served in the same unit until Halliwell left him behind on a mission that cost him his limbs.}

cardPool.title: Carlos "General Tyrant" Castillo
cardPool.value: {Professor Carlos Castillo teaches Social Studies at (A), a former pro villain and deposed dictator known as General Tyrant who shapeshifts parts of his body into a T-Rex. Commanding, brutal, and proud, he is a man with slicked-back graying hair, brown skin, and a broad, muscular build. Professor Proctor of (P) toppled Carlos’s dictatorship. He now teaches students how governments hold power and plans to reclaim his own.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Helena "Hazardia" Morbius
cardPool.value: {Dr. Helena Morbius heads the science department at (A), known as Hazardia, and was transformed by chemical exposure. Obsessive, reckless, and feared, she is a middle-aged woman with frizzy dark hair, green-tinted skin, and a wiry build. Helena runs lessons that often end in evacuations; she was Dr. McCormick's lab partner until the accident that gave him his glow and her this skin, and she blames him for all of it.}

cardPool.title: Farah "Force Girl" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Farah "Force Girl" Farrell is a junior at (P) and has enhanced strength and acrobatic skill. She is overachieving, cutthroat, bossy, competitive, and brittle, with long blonde hair in a tight braid, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Farah tops every class ranking because her father, Alpha Force, accepts nothing less, and she makes sure her brother Felix never forgets it. Farah pretends not to care that her ex, Scotty, is rebounding with Maddie of (PPP), and she has started planning revenge.}

cardPool.title: Felix "Force Boy" Farrell
cardPool.value: {Felix "Force Boy" Farrell is a freshman at (P) and has enhanced strength. He is nervous, try-hard, clumsy, jealous, and eager, with spiky blonde hair, fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Felix trips over his own feet in training; his father, Alpha Force, has never once called him by name in public. Felix lives in his sister Farah's shadow and follows Zax'thor around because he really wants an alien best friend.}

cardPool.title: Brett "Breaker Boy" Buchanan
cardPool.value: {Brett "Breaker Boy" Buchanan is a sophomore at (P) and has strength that grows with his anger. He is earnest, remorseful, self-conscious, steady, and ashamed, with no hair, gray skin, soft brown eyes, and a towering, heavily muscled build. Brett transferred through a rehabilitation program and keeps his temper leashed while classmates bait him to snap; he once ran with Savage Mandible's crew. Clayton is Brett's best friend.}

cardPool.title: Melodie "Whirl Girl" Morgan
cardPool.value: {Melodie "Whirl Girl" Morgan is a junior at (P) and has hydrokinesis. She is obedient, sanctimonious, eager, tattling, and sneaky, with wavy blue hair, fair skin, wide eyes, and a petite build. Melodie keeps a notebook of every rule broken at (P) and trades pages for favors, which has made her the least trusted girl in her year.}

cardPool.title: Sophia "Luxe Light" Sierra
cardPool.value: {Sophia "Luxe Light" Sierra is a sophomore at (P) and has solid light constructs. She is manipulative, gossipy, social-climbing, charming, and envious, with long black hair, tan skin, brown eyes, and a slim build. Sophia secretly runs PowWow, the anonymous gossip account every school in Vista Valley reads, and uses it to rise one secret at a time. Sophia is scheming to replace Veronica in the Frost Court and has just learned Arnie is dating a girl from (A).}

cardPool.title: The Underground
cardPool.value: {The Underground is a network of maintenance tunnels beneath Vista Valley used in secret by students of every school. Regulars include Ashton and Dexter (P); Christina, Craig, and Cosmo (A); Sloane and Haeun (PPP); Owen and Oskar (M); Harlow and Riley (PA); Colton, Noor, and Leonid (B).}

cardPool.title: The Wreckage
cardPool.value: {The Wreckage is a set of abandoned factories and warehouses in the Edges used for power demonstrations and underground fights. Regulars include Trayden and Johnny (P); Dominic, Louis, and Lancer (A); Daichi and Sunwoo (PPP); Paloma and Declan (M); Imani, Selina, and Kendra (PA); Ratna, Hugo, and Blake (B).}

cardPool.title: The Super Grind
cardPool.value: {The Super Grind is a 24-hour diner in College Town where students study late, eat, and recover after training. Regulars include Liam, Milo, and Brett (P); Eris (A); Elijah, Haeun, and Sayo (PPP); Winona, Nadine, and Maeve (M); Imani, Chloe, and Riley (PA); Enzo, Vlad, and Gabriel (B).}

cardPool.title: Quantum Comics & Games
cardPool.value: {Quantum Comics & Games is a store in the Market District that sells hero and villain memorabilia and hosts tabletop tournaments, and its most popular game is BattleForce: Surge! Regulars include Ezra, Hiro, and Milo (P); Aiden and Suzu (A); Haoyu and Elijah (PPP); Wyatt (M); Charlie (PA); Bryce and Yuki (B).}

cardPool.title: Heroes' Pizza
cardPool.value: {Heroes' Pizza is a pizzeria and student hangout in College Town with arcade games and weekend karaoke, and students claim its booths as social territory. Regulars include Trayden, Nina, Tiffany, and Johnny (P); Henry, Anita, Regina, and Nico (A); Daichi, Ingrid, and Alyson (PPP); Emilio and Jonah (M); Maren, Mikkel, Kaito, and Priya (PA); Dagny, Bryce, and Hugo (B).}

cardPool.title: Civic Center District
cardPool.value: {The Civic Center District holds the government and emergency response of Vista Valley in reinforced buildings with power-dampening technology and heavy security. City Hall is the office of Mayor Winslow. The Vista Valley Police Department has a power response unit, is run by Chief Redding, and is patrolled by Officer Bailey. The Municipal Court is where Slick Danforth and Rachel Cross work. The district also holds an Emergency Response Center with power containment and a Fire & Rescue Station. Regulars include Scotty, Sara, Adrianna, and Melodie (P); Victoria, Mercedes, Jeremy, and Samuel (A); Cody, Sloane, and Amira (PPP); Aaron, Reese, and Nadya (M); Beckett, Brooke, Juno, and Priya (PA); Cordelia, Sana, Dakota, and Vlad (B).}

cardPool.title: The Industrial Park
cardPool.value: {The Industrial Park holds the power, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities of Vista Valley on the eastern edge of town, separated from housing by green space. Landmarks include Quantum Core Energy Facility, Central Distribution, Sunrise Logistics, Reinforced Materials Plant, Greenway Trail, and Secured Storage Solutions. Regulars include Ashton, Clayton, Arnie, and Wes (P); Victoria, Dallas, Quintus, and Harmon (A); Kexin, Hanako, and Sunwoo (PPP); Paloma, Declan, and Brandon (M); Micah, Beckett, Dmitri, and Nia (PA); Dagny, Jackson, Tunde, and Leonid (B).}

cardPool.title: The Innovation District
cardPool.value: {The Innovation District is the tech hub of Vista Valley, with firms, labs, and shared workspaces in converted industrial buildings. Landmarks include Creation Hub, Workshop Commons, Gadget Lab, Nemesis Tech Supply, Blueprint Studios, and Darling Designs. Regulars include Ezra and Dexter (P); Diana, Aiden, and Christina (A); Kexin and Kelechi (PPP); Reese and Brandon (M); Micah, Charlie, and Kaito (PA); Imogen, Otis, and Sana (B).}

cardPool.title: The Medical Quarter
cardPool.value: {The Medical Quarter is the healthcare hub of Vista Valley, centered on a hospital with specialized treatment wings and surrounded by medical offices and research facilities. Landmarks include Zenith Medical Center, Restoration Plaza, Accelerated Healing Institute, Quantum Care Center, and Recovery Zone. Regulars include Sara, Adrianna, and Farah (P); Diana, Vincent, and Quintus (A); Minseo, Haoyu, and Beatriz (PPP); Chidera, Rosalie, and Nadine (M); Selina, Omar, Maren, and Willa (PA); Blake, Tunde, and Yuki (B).}

cardPool.title: The Market District
cardPool.value: {The Market District is the retail hub of Vista Valley, built around an open-air marketplace of local vendors. Landmarks include Open Air Exchange, Artisan Hall, Powered Provisions, Trade Square, Specialty Spice House, Vista Valley Grocery, Power-Safe Hardware, and Quantum Comics & Games. Regulars include Clayton, Veronica, Zax'thor, and Felix (P); Dominic, Danny, Holly, and Cosmo (A); Ingrid, Alyson, and Kelechi (PPP); Chidera, Owen, and Aaron (M); Zain, Tobias, Nia, and Deshawn (PA); Wendell, Otis, Ramiro, and Gabriel (B).}

cardPool.title: The Commons
cardPool.value: {The Commons is a mixed-use district of Vista Valley with mid-rise apartments above shops and offices. Landmarks include Corner Market, Bean Scene Cafe, Quicksilver Alterations, the Vista Valley Dispatch office, Central Square, Vista Valley Public Library, Community Recreation Center, and Pete's Drinks and Eats, a local bar. Regulars include Hiro, Jade, Zax'thor, and Sophia (P); Henry, Carmilla, Suzu, and Eris (A); Cody, Sayo, and Jessie (PPP); Winona, Emilio, and Everett (M); Zain, Brooke, Willa, and Franky (PA); Noor, Augusta, and Dakota (B).}

cardPool.title: The College Town District
cardPool.value: {The College Town District is the student neighborhood of Vista Valley, with late-night eateries, bookstores, and convenience stores. Landmarks include Academic Arsenal bookstore, Midnight Break Cafe, Alter-Ego Accessories, Underground Study Lounge, Spin Cycle Laundry, Heroes' Pizza, and The Super Grind diner. Regulars include Scotty, Poppy, Felix, and Farah (P); Marianna, Marcus, and Lancer (A); Maddie, Mateo, and Amira (PPP); Wyatt, Everett, and Naomi (M); Kendra, Rafa, and Deshawn (PA); Ratna, Colton, and Ramiro (B).}

cardPool.title: The Riverside Arts District
cardPool.value: {The Riverside Arts District is the riverfront cultural zone of Vista Valley, with renovated warehouses holding public art, performance venues, and studios. Landmarks include Depot Stage, Soundwave Hall, Looking Glass Studios, Creative Corner Supply, and the Waterfront Walk. Regulars include Alyssa, Brittany, Wes, and Melodie (P); Anita, Louis, Craig, and Nico (A); Hanako and Jessie (PPP); Oskar, Solveig, and Naomi (M); Omar, Sydney, and Lucia (PA); Vesper, Enzo, and Margot (B).}

cardPool.title: The Heights
cardPool.value: {The Heights is the wealthy northern hillside of Vista Valley, with gated estates and converted mansions with heavy security. Landmarks include the Ridgeline Club, Overlook Gardens, Eclipse Design & Security, Hillside Botanical Park, and Pinnacle Recreation Center. Regulars include Veronica, Brittany, Arnie, and Sophia (P); Marcus, Holly, Regina, and Harmon (A); Minseo and Rinko (PPP); Saoirse and Nadya (M); Chloe, Harlow, and Sydney (PA); Vesper, Anjali, and Augusta (B).}

cardPool.title: The Historic Downtown Core
cardPool.value: {The Historic Downtown Core is the heritage shopping center of Vista Valley, with 19th-century and Art Deco buildings holding vintage shops, cafes, and student retail. Landmarks include Victory Coffee & Tea House, The Golden Age Cinema, Identity Outfitters, Ben Bistro, and The Old Town Bank Building. Regulars include Alyssa, Nina, Tiffany, and Poppy (P); Marianna, Carmilla, Mercedes, and Dallas (A); Rinko and Beatriz (PPP); Rosalie, Maeve, and Solveig (M); Tobias, Juno, Lucia, and Franky (PA); Cordelia, Anjali, and Wendell (B).}

cardPool.title: Craig "Archon" Love
cardPool.value: {Craig "Archon" Love is a senior at (A) and has eldritch powers and forbidden knowledge. He is secretive, fanatical, soft-spoken, eerie, and jealous, with limp dark hair, pallid skin, rainbow irises, and a thin build. Craig gathers followers in the Underground and prepares Earth for the return of eldritch beings; he believes they promised him his dead mother back. Craig courts Vincent as a prophet of the end, buys artifacts from Dallas, and resents that Carmilla got to Vincent first.}

cardPool.title: Samuel "Epoch Zero" Blackwell
cardPool.value: {Samuel "Epoch Zero" Blackwell is a senior at (A) and has crowd emotion amplification, strengthened by government experiments he escaped. He is charismatic, angry, and reckless, with blond hair, fair tattooed skin, green eyes, and a muscular build. He wears a leather jacket. He amplifies crowds’ anger and incites riots against the systems that caged him. Samuel was Marcus's best friend before leaving the Golden Circle and taking half of it with him, and he is recruiting Jeremy.}

cardPool.title: Dallas "Oracle Seeker" Smith
cardPool.value: {Dallas "Oracle Seeker" Smith is a junior at (A) and has the power to read the history of any object he touches. He is obsessive, reckless, curious, cocky, and heartbroken, with tousled dark hair, tan skin, brown eyes, round glasses, and a lean, athletic build. He uses parkour, close combat, and a whip to steal dangerous artifacts and uncover their histories; Dallas sells eldritch finds to Craig and hunts the mirror that holds Louis's sister.}

cardPool.title: Christina "Ghost Girl" Cheung
cardPool.value: {Christina "Ghost Girl" Cheung is a junior at (A) and has no powers and relies on black-ops training, martial arts, and anti-superhuman technology. She is precise, professional, personable, cool, and guilty, with a sleek black ponytail, light skin, and a lean, athletic build. Christina is polite in class and treats assassination as a career; she is falling for Ashton of (P), and her family took the contract on his parents. She buys gear from Holly and Diana, and knows Cordelia of (B) is building a file on her.}

cardPool.title: Vincent "Scourge Lord" Valentino

cardPool.title: Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts
cardPool.value:
{Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that trains heroes. (P) shares a campus with Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts (PA), which trains the sidekicks and support crews who work alongside (P) graduates in the field.
(P) freshmen are Hiro, Jade, Liam, Milo, Tiffany, Veronica, and Felix.
(P) sophomores are Alyssa, Arnie, Brittany, Ezra, Johnny, Sophia, and Brett.

(P) seniors are Adrianna, Nina, Scotty, Trayden, Wes, and Zax'thor.

cardPool.title: Trayden "Titan Boy" Thompson
cardPool.value: {Trayden "Titan Boy" Thompson is a senior at (P) whose titanium skin and super strength make him a formidable fighter. cardPool.title: Dominic "Huntsman" Hawthorne
cardPool.value: {Dominic "Huntsman" Hawthorne is a junior at (A) and has super strength and predator-sharp senses. cardPool.title: The Commandant's Ball
cardPool.value: {The Commandant's Ball is (B)'s annual formal, a dress-uniform affair hosted by the Nightwarden himself. cardPool.title: The Moonlight Mixer
cardPool.value: {The Moonlight Mixer is (M)'s annual formal, held in the greenhouse under Saoirse's glowing vines. Nadya brings her baby, and everyone watches Jonah to see if he looks at them.}

cardPool.title: The Nexus Ball
cardPool.value: {The Nexus Ball is (PPP)'s annual formal, held in the Primalzord hangar under the glow of the Nexus. cardPool.value: {The Backstage Ball is (PA)'s annual formal, thrown the same night as (P)'s Griffin Ball after (PA) students were uninvited. Harlow is secretly bringing Colton of (B), and Riley hopes Dallas of (A) shows up. Every year a few (P) students sneak over because the Backstage Ball is more fun.}

cardPool.title: Second Billing
cardPool.value: {Second Billing is (PA)'s annual play, a comedy about a sidekick who saves the day while her hero takes the credit, written and produced by Sydney. Riley films everything, and (PA) students run both their own play and (P)'s musical, Skyward!, in the same week, so the tech crew threatens to strike every year.}

cardPool.title: The Griffin Ball
cardPool.value: {The Griffin Ball is (P)'s annual formal and the social event of the year. Brittany expects Arnie to ask her, Tiffany is dying to ask Brittany, and Sophia has a PowWow post ready about Arnie and Regina. Sara wants to go with Ashton, Wes is trying to take Melodie, and Scotty is bringing Maddie of (PPP) to make Farah jealous. (PA) students are traditionally uninvited, which fuels a campus-wide feud.}

cardPool.title: Skyward!
cardPool.value: {Skyward! is (P)'s annual musical, directed by Mrs. Stanford, a Golden Age story about a 1940s Vista Valley newsboy who stitches his own cape and becomes the town's first hero. Felix auditioned only to be near Tiffany and was cast as the newsboy by accident, and Tiffany plays the switchboard girl who loves him and sings the rooftop ballad nobody lets her sing anywhere else. Hiro plays the mad scientist and ad-libs anime monologues, Zax'thor plays his robot and apologizes after every fight scene, and Alyssa narrates with lines nobody wrote. Nina leads the pit band, Poppy understudies every role, and (PA) students run the lights and sets without credit. The flying rig for the finale has failed repeatedly, and (P) blames the (PA) crew every time.}

cardPool.title: Blood Moon Masquerade
cardPool.value: {The Blood Moon Masquerade is (A)'s annual formal, a masked ball held on a night known for its red moon. Carmilla's Coven hosts it every year, and Regina's Hive either boycotts or crashes it. The masks hide scandals: Regina sneaks Arnie of (P) in disguise, Carmilla dances with Vincent, Nico means to finally confess to Cosmo, and Mercedes waits all night for Henry. Eris sells the guest list, and Marianna attends as someone else entirely.}

cardPool.title: Franky Tran
cardPool.value: {Franklin 'Franky' Tran is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) whose has weak plant growing powers. He pairs it with de-escalation and casualty support rather than using it to override decisions. Gentle and observant, Franky has light skin, short black hair, feminine face and a lean, androgynous build. He studies under Dr. Aldridge, shares tea with Lucia, and is working up the courage to tell her how he feels.}

cardPool.title: Priya Raghunathan
cardPool.value: {Priya Raghunathan is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She dispatches responders, sorts conflicting calls, and keeps civilians and field teams connected during emergencies. Cool-headed and exacting, she has brown skin, a long black braid, a petite build; she wears a headset even off duty. Priya admires Brooke's command skills and imitates her demanding style. She has not noticed Kaito's crush on her.}

cardPool.title: Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz
cardPool.value: {Rafa "Kid Gecko" Ortiz is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who adheres to walls and ceilings. He reaches trapped people, scouts elevated routes, and secures lines where ordinary climbers cannot. Energetic and reckless, he has freckled tan skin, dark curls, a lean, athletic build. Rafa films dangerous dares for Mikkel's followers and accepts Nia's challenges because he has a crush on her. Mikkel trains him but encourages his worst risks.}

cardPool.title: Nia "Blaze Kid" Obi
cardPool.value: {Nia “Blaze Kid” Obi is a freshman sidekick hero at (PA) who can create and control fire, using it to redirect flames, suppress spreading fires, and ignite controlled counterfires. She pairs this with rescue training to open routes for emergency teams. Bold and impatient, she has dark brown skin, box braids, a lithe, athletic build. Staff have warned her against practicing indoors. Nia wants an early assignment with Arnie, trades dares with Rafa, and tests fireproof equipment with Micah.}

cardPool.title: Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana
cardPool.value: {Yuki "Yankee-Yield" Tachibana is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in armor engineering and field repair. Inventive, meticulous, shy, critical, and devoted, she has black hair in a close tapered pixie cut, light skin, and a petite, lean athletic build. An equipment failure killed her cousin, so she will not release armor she considers unsafe. Otis mentors her; she plays BattleForce with Bryce and likes him more than she admits.}

cardPool.title: Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad
cardPool.value: {Noor "Foxtrot-Fade" Haddad is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth and counter-surveillance in urban terrain. Observant, cautious, proud, inventive, and courageous, she has dark hair in a neat low bun, olive skin, and a small, lithe athletic build. Years of being followed taught her to spot surveillance. Victor-Viper's clique mocks her scholarship and coat; Noor has caught Vesper testing her skills more than once and has not noticed Leonid's crush.}

cardPool.title: Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira
cardPool.value: {Hugo "Echo-Edge" Ferreira is a freshman unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in close-quarters combat and disarming. Eager, combative, stubborn, romantic, and resilient, he has a shaved induction cut, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He challenges older cadets because he promised his brother he would become (B)'s toughest fighter. Ratna beats him consistently. Hugo has a crush on Blake, who patches him up and teases him.}

cardPool.title: Kaito Nakamura
cardPool.value: {Kaito Nakamura is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He pilots reconnaissance drones, maps hazards, and maintains visual contact for teammates operating out of sight. Quick with electronics but careless with privacy, he has light skin, messy black hair, a lean, slight build. He and Deshawn are best friends who often bicker, argue, and roast each other. Kaito sells compromising footage to PowWow and has a crush on Priya.}

cardPool.title: Juno "Recall" Adler
cardPool.value: {Juno "Recall" Adler is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) with perfect recall. She combines remembered evidence, movement patterns, and reports into actionable threat forecasts for field teams. Thorough, bookish, and stubborn, she has fair skin, auburn hair, a round face, glasses, and a sturdy build. She predicted several attacks by Christina before (P) believed her. Juno and Tobias argue over her theories while concealing their attraction; Riley brings her leads.}

cardPool.title: Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson
cardPool.value: {Mikkel "Falcon Boy" Mikkelson is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. His wingsuit training, aerial route planning, and rescue rigging let him enter isolated sites and reach stranded civilians. Daring and hungry for attention, he has tanned skin, windblown blond hair, a lean, athletic build. He posts crash footage despite the risk to his career. Maren restores his stamina after accidents, Dmitri races him out of jealousy, and he competes with Zain for Scotty's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves
cardPool.value: {Colton "Romeo-Rook" Reeves is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in parkour, acrobatics, and rooftop pursuit. Guarded, charming, spoiled, rebellious, and conflicted, he has dark curls in a neat low taper, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. A trust-fund heir and former youth Olympic gymnast, he belongs to Victor-Viper's clique but keeps his rooftop routes private. He trades route notes with Harlow of (PA), which the clique would condemn, and still resents Ramiro.}

cardPool.title: Aaron Dewalt
cardPool.value: {Aaron Dewalt is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled magnetism that drags metal toward him whenever his attention slips. He is apologetic, clumsy, chatty, hardworking, and kind, with dark brown hair, tanned skin, and a broad, muscular build; he avoids metal fasteners and accessories. Aaron is a Southern farm boy whose father ran him off at gunpoint when his powers emerged. Aaron is Reese's best friend and the only one who knows she loves Declan, and he keeps trying to set them up.}

cardPool.title: Paloma Cifuentes
cardPool.value: {Paloma Cifuentes is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled energy reflection she cannot aim. She is loud, goofy, flirtatious, oblivious, and fearless, with short, wavy dark hair, brown skin, and a short, full-figured build. Paloma has broken Mr. Oyelaran's force fields before and brags about it. Paloma has a crush on Jonah, laughs off Declan's showing off and Emilio's lovesick copy, and has no idea Reese hates her for it.}

cardPool.title: Owen Barrett
cardPool.value: {Owen Barrett is a freshman at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that ages whatever he holds, rusting metal and withering fruit in seconds. He is withdrawn, lonely, polite, wistful, and romantic, with cropped black hair, pale skin, and a thin build and hollow cheeks; he never removes his protective gloves. Owen has not touched another person since his grandmother's hand turned to dust in his. Owen is falling for Winona, the one girl who can never touch him either, and Brother Anselm sits with him most evenings.}

cardPool.title: Sunwoo "Blue Orca" Baek
cardPool.value: {Sunwoo Baek is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Blue Orca Protector. He is blunt, loud, impulsive, brash, and cheerful, with a shaved head, light skin, a chipped tooth, and a heavyset build. Sunwoo is the freshman team's demolition specialist in the Orca Primalzord; he breaks things first and plans later. Sunwoo copies Daichi's worst habits, fights with Amira every day, and would do anything to impress her.}

cardPool.title: Amira "Red Kestrel" Zaidi
cardPool.value: {Amira Zaidi is a freshman at (PPP) and is the Red Kestrel Protector. She is fierce, proud, bossy, driven, and brave, with a dark undercut, olive skin, and a small, wiry build. Amira leads the freshman team in the Kestrel Primalzord; she was the first of her year chosen by the Nexus and will not let anyone forget it. Amira looks up to Cody and cannot stand Sunwoo, which is why everyone suspects she likes him.}

cardPool.title: Ms. Greta Lindholm
cardPool.value: {Ms. Greta Lindholm runs the armory and equipment room at (B) and has no powers. Blunt, territorial, and thorough, she is a woman with iron-gray hair, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, sturdy build. Greta tracks every piece of equipment a cadet carries; the one item she cannot account for is the rifle that went missing the night her son left for (A).}

cardPool.title: Dr. Boris Kalmar
cardPool.value: {Dr. Boris Kalmar teaches combat trauma and interrogation resistance at (B) and has no powers. Clinical, unnerving, and eerily calm, he is a man with short gray hair, pale skin, and a slight build. Boris runs relentless interrogation-resistance and mental-defense drills; he and Dr. Patrick of (P) worked the same black site, and Boris keeps the secret that could end Emory's career.}

cardPool.title: Coach Duke Halliwell
cardPool.value: {Coach Duke Halliwell runs conditioning and hand-to-hand training at (B) and has no powers. Harsh, loud, and demanding, he is a man with a gray flattop, weathered tan skin, a very broad, muscular build, and a gravelly voice. Duke runs cadets into the ground; he served with Coach Steel of (A) and left him behind on the mission that cost Steel his limbs, and he has been trying to outrun that choice ever since.}

cardPool.title: Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov
cardPool.value: {Leonid "Kilo-Kite" Sokolov is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in trap engineering and countermeasures. Inventive, skittish, vindictive, loyal, and impulsive, he has a brown short back-and-sides cut, pale skin, and a lean, narrow build. He rigs traps for the engineering division and sabotages Victor-Viper's clique's footlockers in retaliation for their treatment of Noor. Leonid explores the Underground with Colton and Noor and has a crush on Noor.}

cardPool.title: Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair
cardPool.value: {Anjali "Quebec-Quiet" Nair is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in cyber investigation and criminal-network analysis. Tenacious, discreet, analytical, conflicted, and compassionate, she has black hair in a neat single braid pinned above her collar, brown skin, and a small, lean athletic build. Anjali traces shell-company payments and is building a case against Von Vortex Industries. Victoria of (A) was her childhood best friend; despite what the case may do to Victoria, Anjali still answers her late-night messages.}

cardPool.title: Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Blake "Whiskey-Wing" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in field medicine and reconnaissance. Charismatic, calm, competitive, generous, and vain, she has dark curls in a close tapered pixie cut, tan skin, and a lean, athletic build. She has carried injured cadets off the obstacle course and enjoys the attention afterward. Blake won the recon slot her twin brother Bryce wanted; Hugo has a crush on her.}

cardPool.title: Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe
cardPool.value: {Imogen "Golf-Ghost" Thorpe is a junior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in electronic surveillance and signals intelligence. Skeptical, resourceful, impatient, vigilant, and loyal, she wears her dark hair in a low braided bun beneath a neatly secured headscarf; she has light brown skin and a lean, wiry build. She avoids networked devices and plants listening devices around (B), including Victor-Viper's common room. Aiden of (A) sends messages to every screen near her and claims to love her. Imogen trusts Sana more than anyone.}

cardPool.title: Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt
cardPool.value: {Vesper "Sierra-Silent" Arendt is a senior unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in stealth, infiltration, and escape. Taciturn, audacious, independent, curious, and exacting, she has a black tapered pixie cut, pale skin, and a lithe, athletic build. She slipped into (A) after dark; Christina caught her and let her go. Vesper is drawn to Christina and tests Noor's counter-surveillance skills, though Noor has caught her twice.}

cardPool.title: Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks
cardPool.value: {Bryce "Bolt-Four" Hendricks is a sophomore unpowered cadet at (B) specializing in intelligence and threat analysis. Observant, ambitious, resentful, strategic, and insecure, he has a dark curly taper fade, tan skin, and a compact, lean athletic build. He studies how (P) and (A) students fight and keeps an especially detailed file on his twin sister Blake. Bryce resents Blake for winning the recon slot he trained for and plays BattleForce with Yuki.}

cardPool.title: Mr. Julian Sorrell
cardPool.value: {Mr. Julian Sorrell teaches public relations at (PA) and coaches sidekicks to manage the press and public consequences around hero operations. Cynical, polished, and well-connected, he is a man with slicked-back dark hair, tan skin, and a slim build. Julian treats every class like a press briefing; he is Leonor Valencia's ex-fiancé, and every exposé the Dispatch runs feels personal.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Faye Aldridge
cardPool.value: {Dr. Faye Aldridge teaches field medicine at (PA) and treats training injuries. Brisk, sharp-tongued, and strict, she is a middle-aged woman with a graying bob, fair skin, and a lean build. Faye scolds students while she stitches them up and has repeatedly grounded Maren for draining herself; she is Mr. Bello's ex-wife, and they still bicker through every shared drill.}

cardPool.title: Dean Harriet Nwosu
cardPool.value: {Dean Harriet Nwosu leads (PA) and spent decades as Alpha Force's sidekick. Blunt, unimpressed, and protective, she is a short woman with silver hair, dark brown skin, and a sturdy build; she walks with a cane. Harriet insists a sidekick is a professional, not an accessory; she walked away from Alpha Force the day he took credit for the rescue that cost her leg, and she and Headmaster Green are close friends.}

cardPool.title: Sydney Booker
cardPool.value: {Sydney Booker is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She manages crisis communications, verifies reports from the field, and protects civilians from bad information during hero operations. Polished, strategic, and ruthless with a story, she has fair skin, a blonde ponytail, and a tall, slender build. Sydney wants to handle Arnie's press and knows about his relationship with Regina. A supervillain once kidnapped and injured her; she cannot explain how quickly her symptoms eased afterward. She loves Omar and resents his avoidance, and she openly criticizes Chloe's fixation on Adrianna.}

cardPool.title: Selina Marchetti
cardPool.value: {Selina Marchetti is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. She stabilizes trauma patients under fire, organizes evacuation for the wounded, and keeps teammates alive until hospital care is available. Calm and discreet, she has olive skin, tied-back dark curls, a medium, athletic build, and steady hands. Treating (P) seniors has given her their trust and knowledge of their injuries. She mentors Willa and repeatedly treats Johnny of (P), for whom she is developing feelings.}

cardPool.title: Riley Maddox
cardPool.value: {Riley Maddox is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) with night vision. She conducts low-light surveillance, documents threats, and guides teams through dark buildings, though her appetite for a story can compromise an investigation. Nosy and reckless, she has freckled fair skin, red hair, a small, lean build and a camera. Riley follows suspected (A) students and sells embarrassing photos to PowWow. She has fallen for Dallas of (A) and conceals those photographs from Harlow and Juno.}

cardPool.title: Charlie "Fixit" Dunbar
cardPool.value: {Charlotte "Charlie" "Fixit" Dunbar is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. A field engineer, she repairs damaged rescue equipment, improvises tools from available parts, and keeps a team operational after its gear fails. Inventive, warm, and distractible, she has fair skin, a frizzy brown ponytail, a short, rounded build with burns on her thumbs. Charlie wants a job at Darling Designs but struggles to finish long projects. She likes Ezra of (P) and does not know Micah has been stealing her designs.}

cardPool.title: Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett
cardPool.value: {Harlow "Eagleeye" Bennett is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) with telescopic sight. From concealed overwatch positions she tracks moving threats, guides teams around blind corners, and identifies safe approaches for rescuers. Aloof and observant, she has light brown skin, a long dark braid, and a tall, lean build. Her rooftop surveillance draws her into an exchange of notes with Colton of (B), whose wealth and clique challenge her judgment of him. She is falling for him despite herself.}

cardPool.title: Tobias "Casefile" Kwan
cardPool.value: {Tobias "Casefile" Kwan is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. He gathers evidence, reconstructs incidents, and handles the legal steps needed to turn a rescue or arrest into a durable case. Meticulous, principled, and smug about being right, he has light skin, neatly parted black hair, glasses, and a tall, lean build. He hopes to work with investigator Rachel Cross. His arguments with Juno often sharpen her theories, though neither admits their attraction; he is also friends with Zain.}

cardPool.title: Brooke "Commanda" Ellis
cardPool.value: {Brooke "Commanda" Ellis is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) without powers. An incident commander, she coordinates teams, maintains communications under pressure, and reallocates responders as threats change. Bossy, demanding, and cutthroat, she has fair skin, a short brown ponytail, a small, lean build. Brooke wants to lead Adrianna's command center after graduation and competes with Chloe for her sidekick assignment. Priya models her dispatch work on Brooke's; Brooke ignores Beckett's crush.}

cardPool.title: Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway
cardPool.value: {Beckett "Bulwark Boy" Holloway is a sophomore sidekick hero at (PA) who raises sturdy, stationary walls of earth to shield block an exit or cover a group. He holds evacuation routes against attacks and knows when to reposition before a barrier fails. Shy, steady, and protective, he has fair skin, sandy hair, and a very broad, muscular build. He wants (P) heroes to recognize him as a partner, especially Brooke, on whom he has a crush. Dmitri drives him home and teases him about it.}

cardPool.title: Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton
cardPool.value: {Chloe "Frost Mage" Barton is a junior sidekick hero at (PA) who rapidly freezes surfaces to immobilize opponents, seal breaches, and create safe routes through hazardous ground. Precise and resentful, she has pale skin, straight blonde hair, and a slim build. Chloe believes money kept her out of (P) and studies Adrianna's tactics to earn a place at her side. She despises Brittany's purchased ice powers and competes with Brooke for Adrianna's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Imani "Windana" Cole
cardPool.value: {Imani "Windana" Cole is a senior sidekick hero at (PA) whose controlled wind bursts deflect attacks, disrupt an opponent's footing, and cover evacuations. A seasoned close-quarters fighter, she pairs that power with reliable protection tactics. Blunt and loyal, she has deep brown skin, a shaved head, a broad, muscular build, and scarred forearms. Her sister died protecting a hero who never attended the funeral, so Imani challenges heroes who treat sidekicks as expendable. She looks after Kendra and does not recognize Zain's feelings for her.}

cardPool.title: Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri
cardPool.value: {Zain "Slipstream" Mansouri is a senior sidekick hero at (PA). He rides air currents to carry teammates and civilians across hazards, scout from above, and make rapid extractions. Talkative and generous but evasive about his home life, he has olive skin, short dark hair, a small, lean build. His work as a field courier gives him contacts across both campuses. He loves his longtime drill partner Imani and competes with Mikkel for Scotty's sidekick assignment.}

cardPool.title: Silas Calloway
cardPool.value: {Silas Calloway is the field recruiter for (M) and a mutant who wields fire. Quiet, steady, and determined, he is a weathered man with shaggy graying hair, sun-lined fair skin, and a tall, lean build. Silas chainsmokes and personally escorts many frightened new students to Meridian; he and Dr. Mercier were in love before she chose the school over him, and he stays on the road so he never has to stay long.}

cardPool.title: Dr. Evelyn Mercier
cardPool.value: {Dr. Evelyn Mercier is the founder and headmistress of (M) and a mutant with powerful telepathy. Composed, protective, and uncompromising, she is an elegant woman with silver hair, fair skin, and a slender build. Evelyn often knows what her students feel before they speak and refuses to let (M) become a recruiting ground for (P) or (A); she chose the school over Silas Calloway years ago, and she still hears his thoughts whenever he walks through the gate.}

cardPool.title: Jonah Whitlock
cardPool.value: {Jonah Whitlock is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled power amplification that pushes another mutant past their limits with a touch. He is affable, cocky, flirtatious, sharp, and careless, with short brown hair, fair skin, a disarming grin, and a muscular build in a leather jacket. Jonah is a strong hand-to-hand fighter, and both (P) and (A) want to recruit him. Since Nadya left him without explanation, Jonah has pursued other students. He does not know her baby is his, and Paloma’s crush on him angers Declan.}

cardPool.title: Everett Doyle
cardPool.value: {Everett Doyle is a junior at (M) and has fully controlled phasing through solid matter. Easygoing, friendly, playful, nosy, and compassionate, he is a young man with sandy hair, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Everett leans through walls into conversations he was not invited to and greets every student Silas brings in. Everett and Winona were in love until one accidental touch erased his memories of her; he is dating Nadine to move on, but their volatile relationship is difficult for him to leave, and he does not see that Chidera is falling for him.}

cardPool.title: Solveig Nyberg
cardPool.value: {Solveig Nyberg is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled pain transference, drawing an injury's pain into herself. She is serene, private, and self-sacrificing, with white-blonde hair, very pale skin, colorless eyes, and a tall, slender build. Solveig works the infirmary and takes the worst cases herself; she conceals the toll it takes on her. Solveig loves Brandon, and believes he deserves someone who is not always hurting, and she helps Nadya with the baby at night.}

cardPool.title: Brandon "Ironclad" Boone
cardPool.value: {Brandon "Ironclad" Boone is a senior at (M) and has fully controlled metal shaping. He is calm, dependable, and self-denying, with long brown hair in a ponytail, tan skin, and a broad-shouldered, muscular build with scars along his forearms. Brandon is a capable hand-to-hand fighter who shapes metal with precision; both (P) and (A) have offered to recruit him, and he has answered neither. Brandon mentors Oskar, Declan, and Aaron, and he loves Solveig but will not say so while she carries everyone else's pain.}

cardPool.title: Declan Boyd
cardPool.value: {Declan Boyd is a junior at (M) and has partially controlled fire that escapes him when he is angry or showing off. He is boastful, reckless, and vain, with blonde hair, fair skin covered in burns, and a broad build. Declan frequently sets something alight, usually while showing off for Paloma, who has a crush on Jonah. Declan is oblivious that Reese frosts the room every time he walks by, and he hates Jonah for existing.}

cardPool.title: Emilio Vargas
cardPool.value: {Emilio Vargas is a sophomore at (M) and has partially controlled duplication that sometimes splits him into up to six arguing copies. He is animated, anxious, chaotic, loud, and messy, with curly black hair, tan skin, a permanent grin, and a short, lean build. Emilio's copies blurt the things he hides, which has already cost him friendships; one copy refuses to merge back because it is openly in love with Paloma. Paloma finds this hilarious, and Emilio is horrified that the copy is only saying what he feels.}

cardPool.title: Reese Lawson
cardPool.value: {Reese Lawson is a junior at (M) and has a partially controlled heat drain that frosts the room whenever she is anxious. She is composed, disciplined, repressed, judgmental, and jealous, with curly dark hair tied back, brown skin, and a lean build. She wears a heavy coat even indoors. Reese trains relentlessly to control her heat drain and criticizes classmates she thinks are careless. Reese is secretly in love with Declan and frosts the room every time he shows off for Paloma, and only Aaron knows why.}

cardPool.title: Winona Castellano
cardPool.value: {Winona Castellano is a sophomore at (M) and has an uncontrolled touch that erases the memories of anyone whose bare skin she touches with her hands. She is guarded, dryly funny, lonely, and quietly ruthless, with dark hair, olive skin, and a slight build and sharp features; she wears protective gloves. Deeply in love with Everett, Winona is grieving over how she accidentally erased Everett's memories of her. Owen is falling for Winona.}

cardPool.title: Chidera Njoku
cardPool.value: {Chidera Njoku is a freshman at (M) with uncontrolled animal shapeshifting that triggers whenever she is startled. She is soft-spoken, cautious, frightened, kind, and lonely, with short, dark orange hair in a fade, bright orange skin, and a tall, lean build. Chidera eats after everyone leaves the hall, and classmates scare her for laughs; her family sent her away after she transformed and hurt her little brother. Everett is the only student who sits near Chidera, and she is falling for him.}

cardPool.title: Auntie Mele Fifita
cardPool.value: {Mele Fifita, called Auntie Mele, leads the pink path at (PPP) and trains cadets in shielding, healing, and ranged support. Warm, discreet, and guarded, she is a woman with long black hair in a bun, brown skin, and a soft, rounded build. Mele feeds visiting cadets and keeps their confidences; she knows Master Halvard loves her and keeps him at arm's length because she buried a husband once and will not do it again.}

cardPool.title: Master Bjorn "Tidebreaker" Halvard
cardPool.value: {Master Bjorn Halvard leads the green path at (PPP), known as Tidebreaker, and trains cadets in defense, endurance, and protection. Loud, cheerful, and hands-on, he is a man with a braided red beard, ruddy fair skin, and a broad, muscular build. Bjorn spars with his students and laughs loudest when he loses; he has loved Auntie Mele for years and forgave Master Vasquez for leaving him to die long before she forgave herself.}

cardPool.title: Haoyu "Green Tortoise" Liang
cardPool.value: {Haoyu Liang is a junior at (PPP) and is the Green Tortoise Protector. He is awkward, bashful, studious, jealous, and lovesick, with messy black hair, light skin, and a tall, lean build and stooped posture. Haoyu is the junior team's defensive specialist in the Tortoise Primalzord and writes Kexin notes he never sends. Haoyu hopes the senior team's breakup drama will finally make Kexin see him, and he confides in Elijah over BattleForce.}

cardPool.title: Maddie "Yellow Jackrabbit" Whitfield
cardPool.value: {Maddie Whitfield is a senior at (PPP) and is the Yellow Jackrabbit Protector. She is restless, cocky, trash-talking, competitive, and smitten, with a sandy ponytail, fair skin, and a lean, athletic build. Maddie scouts for the senior team in the Jackrabbit Primalzord and talks fast so nobody notices when she is scared. Maddie is dating Scotty of (P) after months of racing him, and she has no idea he is mostly using her to make his ex, Farah, jealous.}

cardPool.title: Kexin "Green Rhino" Zhou
cardPool.value: {Kexin Zhou is a senior at (PPP) and is the Green Rhino Protector. She is scrappy, bitter, stubborn, sarcastic, and overlooked, with a short black bob, light skin, and a short, sturdy build. Kexin repairs the Rhino Primalzord herself and holds the senior team together while nobody thanks her. Kexin is sick of the whole academy fawning over Minseo and forgiving her for wrecking the team, and she never notices that Haoyu adores her.}

cardPool.title: Rachel Cross
cardPool.value: {Rachel Cross is a prosecutor at the Vista Valley Municipal Court who prosecutes villains. Cold, calculating, and tireless, she is a sharp-featured woman with a sleek dark bun, fair skin, and a slim build. Rachel works late building airtight cases; she was Slick Danforth's sweetheart until he chose villain money over her, and she has made beating him in court her life's work.}

cardPool.title: Daniel "Slick" Danforth
cardPool.value: {Daniel "Slick" Danforth is a defense attorney for supervillains at the Vista Valley Municipal Court. Arrogant, sharp, and ruthless, he is an amoral man with silver hair, tanned skin, and a trim build. cardPool.title: Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy
cardPool.value:
{Primal Protectors Polytechnic Academy (PPP) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} built over the Primal Nexus to train the next generation of Primal Protectors. The school colors of (PPP) are black and the five path colors, the mascot is a Raptor, and cadets wear black uniforms accented with their path color. Cadets are chosen by the Nexus, wield the Primal Power, and pilot giant robots called Primalzords. Cadets are sorted into five color paths: red is the vanguard and leader path, blue is the strategist and specialist path, green is the guardian and heavy path, yellow is the scout and skirmisher path, and pink is the support, precision, and ranged path. Each class year fields one cadet of each path as a team.
(PPP) freshmen are Amira, Sunwoo, Kelechi, Sayo, and Jessie.
(PPP) sophomores are Elijah, Hanako, Ingrid, Alyson, and Haeun.
(PPP) juniors are Mateo, Sloane, Haoyu, Rinko, and Beatriz.
(PPP) seniors are Cody, Daichi, Kexin, Maddie, and Minseo.
(PPP) staff are Headmaster Okafor, Master Vasquez, Dr. Mokoena, Master Halvard, Coach Tamura, and Auntie Mele.
(PPP)'s major annual events are Primal Raptors PowerBall season, Legacy Day for Career Day, the annual play The Five Beasts, the Nexus Night Showcase talent show, the Nexus Ball, and the Primal Trials.
(PPP)'s main antagonists are Emperor Vorzakh and Empress Ruvalia, the alien rulers of the Hollow Crown Empire, who send a new monster every week to seize the Nexus, and Damon "The Void Keeper" Dantes, a fallen (PPP) cadet who pilots the Black Vulture Voidzord.}

cardPool.title: Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts
cardPool.value:
{Paragon Institute for Auxiliary Arts (PA) is a ${Choose between a "high school" or "university"} that shares a campus with Paragon Institute for Heroic Arts (P) and trains sidekicks: secondary heroes capable of fighting, rescuing civilians, investigating threats, and operating independently, while specializing in how to complement a primary hero during larger missions. The school colors of (PA) are blue and gold, the mascot is a Pegasus, and students wear blue and gold uniforms. (PA) selects students for judgment, nerve, teamwork, and practical heroism rather than raw power. Every student trains in combat, rescue, mobility, field judgment, and emergency response before developing a specialty. Graduates can lead routine rescues and handle many threats independently; experienced seniors can hold their own against many (P) freshmen and sophomores, while veteran heroes take the greatest threats. Students choose one of three tracks: field for direct combat, protection, pursuit, and extraction; operations for reconnaissance, communications, tactical coordination, and investigation; and support for field medicine, civilian rescue, de-escalation, and public-facing crisis work.
(PA) freshmen are Nia, Rafa, Priya, Deshawn, Lucia, and Franky.
(PA) sophomores are Beckett, Riley, Kaito, and Dmitri.
